questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can migrate data between AWS storage services?
questions.explanation:
AWS DataSync is a data transfer service specifically designed to move large volumes of data between AWS storage services (S3, EFS, FSx) and on-premises storage. It automates and accelerates data migration tasks with built-in validation and monitoring capabilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS service can migrate data between AWS storage services?

options.text: Realign teams to focus on products and value streams.
Create new value propositions with new products and services.
Use agile methods to rapidly iterate and evolve.
Use a new data and analytics platform to create actionable insights.

questions.explanation:
To become responsive to customer inquiries and feedback, organizations should realign teams around products and value streams (A) for customer focus, and adopt agile methodologies (C) to enable rapid iteration based on feedback. Creating new value propositions (B) addresses product strategy, new analytics platforms (D) focus on insights, and infrastructure migration (E) is a technical transition—none directly enable organizational responsiveness.

**Learn more:** [Business perspective: strategy and outcomes (AWS CAF)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/business-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A new AWS user needs to interact with AWS Support by using API calls.  
  
Which AWS Support plan will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Support API, which lets a user open and manage support cases programmatically, is only available on the Business, Enterprise On-Ramp, and Enterprise Support plans; the Basic and Developer plans do not expose the Support API. Of the plans that include API access, Business Support is the lowest-cost tier, making it the most cost-effective choice for this requirement.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Support Plans](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of using AWS serverless computing?

options.text: Application deployment and management are not required.
Application security will be fully managed by AWS.
Monitoring and logging are not needed.
Management of infrastructure is offloaded to AWS.

questions.explanation:
AWS serverless services shift management of the underlying infrastructure to AWS, including routine tasks such as capacity provisioning, scaling, and patching. Customers still retain responsibility for their application, security configuration, and operational observability.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Serverless Computing?](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/serverless-computing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of using AWS serverless computing?

options.text: Implement a strong foundation of identity and access management
Stop spending money on hardware infrastructure for data center operations.

questions.explanation:
Making frequent, small, reversible changes reduces the scope and impact of each change, supports faster troubleshooting and remediation, and allows changes to be rolled back. AWS identifies this as an Operational Excellence design principle.

**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework — Operational Excellence design principles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/operational-excellence-pillar/operational-excellence.html) · [AWS Well-Architected Framework — Make frequent, small, reversible changes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/ops_dev_integ_freq_sm_rev_chg.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate petabytes of data from its on-premises data center to AWS. The company does not want to use an internet connection for the migration.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Snowmobile provides offline, physical transport for very large data migrations, supporting tens of petabytes to exabytes. It is designed for moving data from an on-premises data center to AWS without transferring it over an internet connection.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Whitepaper: Unpicking Vendor Lock-in](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/unpicking-vendor-lock-in/how-the-aws-cloud-helps-to-eliminate-lock-in.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is connecting multiple VPCs and on-premises networks. The company needs to use an AWS service as a cloud router to simplify peering relationships.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Transit Gateway acts as a central hub or 'cloud router' that simplifies connections between multiple VPCs and on-premises networks, eliminating complex point-to-point peering relationships. Direct Connect provides connectivity but not routing, Amazon Connect is a contact center service, and Route 53 is DNS.\
\
**Learn more:** [How AWS Transit Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which perspective in the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) includes a capability for well-designed data and analytics architecture?
questions.explanation:
The AWS CAF Platform perspective includes capabilities for designing and implementing well-architected technology infrastructure, including data and analytics architecture. This perspective focuses on technical excellence across compute, storage, database, and analytics services. Security, Governance, and Operations perspectives handle different domains—security policies, business controls, and operational management respectively.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF Platform perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/platform-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service provides serverless compute for use with containers?
questions.explanation:
AWS Fargate is AWS's serverless container compute engine, designed specifically to run Docker containers without requiring you to manage EC2 instances, clusters, or infrastructure scaling. SQS is a messaging service, Elastic Beanstalk is a platform-as-a-service, and SageMaker is for machine learning—none provide serverless container compute.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Fargate](https://aws.amazon.com/fargate/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
An Amazon EC2 instance that was previously used for development is inaccessible and no longer displayed in the AWS Management Console.  
  
Which AWS service should be used to identify the action that made this EC2 instance inaccessible?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records actions performed by users, roles, and AWS services, including Amazon EC2 API calls and management-console actions. Its event history can be searched to determine the request made against an EC2 instance, who made it, and when it occurred.\
\
**Learn more:** [Log Amazon EC2 API calls using AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitor-with-cloudtrail.html) · [Working with CloudTrail event history](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/view-cloudtrail-events.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of these is a fully managed graph database service in AWS?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Neptune is AWS’s fully managed graph database service for applications that work with highly connected data. It supports graph query languages including Gremlin, openCypher, and SPARQL. [AWS Neptune documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/intro.html)\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is Amazon Neptune?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/intro.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can create a private connection between an on-premises workload and a workload in the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation:
AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated private network connection between an on-premises data center, office, or colocation environment and AWS. A private virtual interface can provide access to workloads in an Amazon VPC using private IP addresses.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to understand the existing on-premises usage and configuration. The company does not want to replicate its workloads to AWS, yet.  
  
Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Application Discovery Service collects detailed information about on-premises infrastructure, including server configurations, resource utilization, and dependencies, to aid in migration planning. Application Migration Service actually performs the migration, not the discovery phase. This service is perfect for understanding existing usage before replicating workloads.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to understand the existing on-premises usage and configuration. The company does not want to replicate its workloads to AWS, yet.  
  
Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?

options.text: Enable client-side encryption for objects that are stored in Amazon S3.
Configure IAM security policies to comply with the principle of least privilege.
Patch the guest operating system on an Amazon EC2 instance.
Apply updates to the Nitro Hypervisor.

questions.explanation:
AWS manages and controls the underlying cloud infrastructure, including the host operating system and virtualization layer. Updating the Nitro Hypervisor is therefore an AWS responsibility. Customers remain responsible for security in the cloud, including their EC2 guest operating systems, IAM policies, and data-encryption configuration choices.

**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/) · [Shared responsibility — AWS Well-Architected Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company operates an uninterruptible application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application continuously processes a backlog of files from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. This usage is expected to keep growing for years.  
  
What is the **MOST** cost-effective EC2 instance purchasing model that meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Savings Plans reduce Amazon EC2 costs in exchange for a commitment to consistent compute usage over a one- or three-year term. They are suited to steady-state, predictable workloads that require uninterrupted availability, whereas Spot Instances can be interrupted.

**Learn more:** [Choosing a purchasing option for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/decision-guides/latest/ec2-purchasing-options-aws-how-to-choose/ec2-purchasing-options-aws-how-to-choose.html) · [What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature determines whether an Amazon S3 bucket or an IAM role is shared with an external entity?
questions.explanation:
AWS IAM Access Analyzer identifies resources shared with external principals by analyzing resource-based policies and generating findings. Its external-access analysis supports both Amazon S3 buckets and IAM roles.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/what-is-access-analyzer.html) · [IAM Access Analyzer supported resource types for external and internal access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access-analyzer-resources.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which phase of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) cloud transformation journey focuses on showing how the cloud can accelerate business outcomes?
questions.explanation:
The AWS CAF **Envision** phase focuses on demonstrating how cloud can accelerate business outcomes by identifying and prioritizing transformation opportunities that align with strategic business objectives.\
\
**Learn more:** [Your cloud transformation journey — An Overview of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/your-cloud-transformation-journey.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which mechanism enables developers to access AWS services from application code?
questions.explanation:
AWS Software Development Kits (SDKs) provide the programming-language libraries and APIs that let application code call AWS services programmatically.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is SDK (Software Development Kit)](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/sdk/) · [AWS SDKs and Tools Reference Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/overview.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which of the following are capabilities in the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) security perspective? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
The AWS CAF Security perspective includes **Incident response**, which establishes mechanisms to respond to and mitigate security incidents, and **Infrastructure protection**, which protects systems and services from unintended or unauthorized access and vulnerabilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Adoption Framework: Security Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-security-perspective/aws-caf-security-perspective.html) · [Recommended security controls for implementing AWS CAF security capabilities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/security-controls-by-caf-capability/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs MySQL database workloads on self-managed servers in an on-premises data center. The company wants to migrate the database workloads to an AWS managed service.  
  
Which migration strategy should the company use?
questions.explanation:
Replatform (also called 'lift, tinker, and shift') involves migrating self-managed MySQL to AWS RDS for MySQL with some level of optimization to leverage cloud capabilities. Rehost (lift and shift) would be used for minimal-change migrations, but managed database services typically require configuration adjustments, making replatforming the appropriate strategy.\
\
**Learn more:** [About the migration strategies (7 Rs)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/large-migration-guide/migration-strategies.html) · [What is a Cloud Migration Strategy?](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/cloud-migration-strategy/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is developing an application that must be able to send, store, and receive messages between application components. The company also requires messages to be processed in first-in, first-out (FIFO) order.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use?
questions.explanation:
Amazon SQS FIFO queues provide durable messaging between application components and preserve the order in which messages are sent and received within each message group. FIFO queues also support exactly-once processing.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to evaluate its operational readiness. It also wants to identify and mitigate operational risks before launching a new product.  
  
Which AWS Support plan provides guidance and support for this type of event at no additional cost?
questions.explanation:
AWS Countdown supports product-launch and go-live events by assessing operational readiness, identifying and mitigating risks, and planning capacity. It is included with AWS Enterprise Support at no additional charge.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Support Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/aws-support-plans.html) · [Key AWS services – Financial Services Industry Lens](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/financial-services-industry-lens/opex-key-aws-services.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which of the following can the AWS Pricing Calculator do?

options.text: Provide in-depth information about AWS pricing strategies.
Provide users with access to their monthly bills.

questions.explanation:
The AWS Pricing Calculator projects estimated monthly costs for AWS services based on configuration selections. It does not calculate historical costs from bills, explain pricing strategies in detail, or provide access to actual billing—those are provided by the AWS Cost Explorer, documentation, and the AWS Billing Console respectively.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Pricing Calculator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pricing-calculator/latest/userguide/what-is-pricing-calculator.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following can the AWS Pricing Calculator do?

options.text: Elimination of the need to perform security auditing
Ability to deploy globally in minutes
Elimination of the cost of IT staff members
Redundancy by default for all compute services

questions.explanation:
Migrating to AWS lets a company reach customers across a global network of Regions and Availability Zones and provision new infrastructure in minutes rather than months, giving it increased global reach and agility and the ability to deploy globally in minutes. Security auditing and IT staffing responsibilities shift under the shared responsibility model rather than disappearing, and redundancy is not automatic for every compute service unless it is explicitly architected for high availability.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to use dashboards and charts to analyze insights from business data.  
  
Which AWS service will provide the dashboards and charts for these insights?
questions.explanation:
Amazon QuickSight is AWS's business intelligence service that creates interactive dashboards and visualizations from business data. Macie is for data security and privacy discovery, Aurora is a relational database, and CloudTrail logs API activity, none of which provide BI dashboards.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon QuickSight](https://aws.amazon.com/quicksight/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is building a web application using AWS.  
  
Which AWS service will help prevent network layer DDoS attacks against the web application?
questions.explanation:
AWS Shield provides protection against DDoS attacks at the network and transport layers (Layer 3 and Layer 4). AWS WAF protects web applications at Layer 7, Firewall Manager centrally manages firewall policies, and GuardDuty detects threats through behavioral analysis. For network layer DDoS prevention, Shield is the correct service.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shield](https://aws.amazon.com/shield/) · [AWS Shield Standard overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-standard-summary.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company is building a web application using AWS.  
  
Which AWS service will help prevent network layer DDoS attacks against the web application?
questions.explanation:
Customers are responsible for protecting and configuring their data and access controls in AWS, including client-side data encryption and IAM credentials. AWS is responsible for the global infrastructure and edge locations. For Amazon RDS, AWS manages the underlying managed-service infrastructure and provides the database patching process; customers can control maintenance scheduling and facilitate updates when required.

**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility — Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html) · [Data protection in Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/DataDurability.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to identify who accessed an AWS service and what action was performed for a given time period.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail logs and records API calls and user actions across AWS services, providing visibility into who accessed what and when. CloudWatch monitors performance metrics, Security Hub aggregates security findings, and Inspector performs vulnerability scans. CloudTrail is the audit and compliance tracking tool.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service enables users to discover and protect sensitive data stored in Amazon S3 buckets?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Macie discovers, classifies, and helps protect sensitive data in Amazon S3 buckets, including personally identifiable information and other sensitive data types.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon Macie User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can an organization use to visually design and create serverless applications?
questions.explanation:
AWS Application Composer provides a browser-based visual canvas for dragging, dropping, and connecting AWS services to architect, configure, and build serverless applications, while generating deployment-ready infrastructure as code.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Application Composer is now generally available](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2023/03/aws-application-composer-generally-available/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can an organization use to visually design and create serverless applications?
questions.explanation:
AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) is the primary tool for migrating databases to AWS, supporting heterogeneous and homogeneous migrations including NoSQL databases to Amazon DynamoDB. DMS handles data replication and supports schema conversion for NoSQL workloads. Migration Hub tracks migration progress, Migration Evaluator creates business cases, and Application Migration Service handles server migration—none specialize in database migration.

**Learn more:** [Using DynamoDB as a target for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.DynamoDB.html) · [What is AWS Database Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has multiple SQL-based databases located in a data center. The company needs to migrate all database servers to the AWS Cloud to reduce the cost of operating physical servers.  
  
Which AWS service or resource will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service that provisions, patches, backs up, and scales SQL-based database engines automatically, letting the company migrate its on-premises SQL databases without continuing to operate physical servers or manage database administration tasks. Running the databases on EC2 would still require the company to install and maintain the database software itself, while DynamoDB and OpenSearch are not relational, SQL-based data stores.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to securely store Amazon RDS database credentials and automatically rotate user passwords periodically.  
  
Which AWS service or capability will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built to securely store credentials such as database passwords and can automatically rotate them on a schedule, with native integration for Amazon RDS. Parameter Store can hold secrets but lacks Secrets Manager's built-in automatic rotation workflow for RDS, and S3 and CloudTrail are not credential management services.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Secrets Manager](https://aws.amazon.com/secrets-manager/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company stores sensitive customer data in an Amazon S3 bucket and wants to safeguard the data against accidental deletion or overwriting.  
  
Which S3 feature should the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 Versioning preserves prior object versions. Deleting an object creates a delete marker, and overwriting it creates a new version, so an earlier version can be restored after an accidental deletion or overwrite.\
\
**Learn more:** [Retaining multiple versions of objects with S3 Versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company stores sensitive customer data in an Amazon S3 bucket and wants to safeguard the data against accidental deletion or overwriting.  
  
Which S3 feature should the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Pricing Calculator provides direct cost estimation for services, while Migration Evaluator analyzes on-premises infrastructure and delivers right-sizing recommendations for accurate TCO calculation. Together they enable comprehensive cost assessment. Application Discovery Service (D) collects data without cost analysis, Support Center (C) provides support rather than cost modeling, and DMS (E) handles database migration specifically.

**Learn more:** [AWS Pricing Calculator](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/aws-pricing-calculator/) · [AWS Migration Evaluator](https://aws.amazon.com/migration-evaluator/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],How does the AWS Cloud help companies build agility into their processes and cloud infrastructure?

options.text: Companies can avoid provisioning too much capacity when they do not know how much capacity is required.
Companies can expand into new geographic regions.
Companies can access a range of technologies to experiment and innovate quickly.
Companies can pay for IT resources only when they use the resources.

questions.explanation:
AWS enables agility by providing a broad range of technologies and services that organizations can rapidly experiment with, test, and deploy. This rapid experimentation capability—from trying new databases to machine learning services to analytics platforms—accelerates innovation cycles and enables faster response to market changes compared to on-premises infrastructure constraints.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to migrate its on-premises SQL Server database to the AWS Cloud. The company wants AWS to handle the day-to-day administration of the database.  
  
Which AWS service will meet the company's requirements?

options.text: Amazon EC2 for Microsoft SQL Server

questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS is the managed relational database service that handles SQL Server and automates administration tasks like patching, backups, and maintenance. While Aurora (D) reduces administration further, it doesn't support SQL Server. EC2 (A) requires manual administration, and DynamoDB (B) is a NoSQL database unsuitable for SQL Server migration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Migrate an on-premises Microsoft SQL Server database to Amazon RDS for SQL Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/migrate-an-on-premises-microsoft-sql-server-database-to-amazon-rds-for-sql-server.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is moving its workloads to the AWS Cloud. The company must maintain complete control over patch management for the guest operating systems that run its applications.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 gives customers responsibility and control for managing the guest operating system, including applying updates and security patches. AWS manages the underlying cloud infrastructure, while the customer manages the EC2 instance operating system and applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework: Shared responsibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to operate its workloads effectively in the AWS Cloud, reduce management overhead, and enhance processes.  
  
Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar addresses these requirements?
questions.explanation:
The Operational Excellence pillar focuses on effectively running workloads, gaining insight into operations, and continuously improving supporting processes and procedures to deliver business value.\
\
**Learn more:** [Operational excellence — AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2023-10-03/framework/a-operational-excellence.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: What does the Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class provide?

options.text: Payment flexibility by reserving storage capacity
Long-term retention of data by copying the data to an encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
Automatic cost savings by moving objects between tiers based on access pattern changes
Secure, durable, and lowest cost storage for data archival

questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically monitors object access patterns and moves objects between access tiers to optimize storage costs as those patterns change.\
\
**Learn more:** [Managing storage costs with Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs a managed NFS file system that the company can use with its AWS compute resources.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) is a fully managed, scalable NFS file system that can be mounted concurrently by multiple EC2 instances and other AWS compute resources. EBS provides block storage attached to a single instance, Storage Gateway Tape Gateway virtualizes tape backups, and S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is archival object storage, none of which is an NFS file system.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EFS](https://aws.amazon.com/efs/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS security service safeguards applications against distributed denial-of-service attacks by using always-on detection and automatic inline mitigations?
questions.explanation:
AWS Shield is the managed AWS service for DDoS protection. It provides always-on detection and automatic mitigation for DDoS attacks, including inline mitigation systems for applicable protected resources.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS WAF or AWS Shield?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/decision-guides/latest/waf-or-shield/waf-or-shield.html) · [AWS Shield detection logic for infrastructure layer threats](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-event-detection-infrastructure.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can be used to monitor for potential disk write spikes on a system that is running on Amazon EC2?
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudWatch collects and tracks metrics for EC2 instances, including disk write and read operations, and lets you configure alarms to detect spikes in real time. AWS CloudTrail logs API activity rather than performance metrics, and Trusted Advisor and the AWS Health Dashboard are not designed for real-time resource-level performance monitoring.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using Amazon CloudWatch metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/working_with_metrics.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can be used to monitor for potential disk write spikes on a system that is running on Amazon EC2?
questions.explanation:
An Application Load Balancer sits in front of a fleet of EC2 instances, providing a single DNS endpoint for clients while distributing incoming HTTP/HTTPS traffic across registered targets and performing health checks. VPC endpoints, NAT gateways, and internet gateways handle routing and connectivity, not load distribution across compute targets.

**Learn more:** [What is an Application Load Balancer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company is designing its AWS workloads to enable components to be updated regularly and allow changes to be made in small, reversible increments.  
  
Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar does this design support?
questions.explanation:
Operational Excellence includes the design principle of making frequent, small, reversible changes. Workloads should allow components to be updated regularly so that changes limit their blast radius and can be rolled back quickly if needed.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework — Operational Excellence design principles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/operational-excellence-pillar/operational-excellence.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to run relationship databases in the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use a managed service that will install the database and run regular software updates.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service that automates installation, patching, backups, and other administrative tasks, letting customers run relational databases without operating the underlying software themselves. S3, EBS, and DynamoDB are not relational database services.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon RDS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has a group of ecommerce applications that must be able to send messages to one another.  
  
Which AWS service fulfills this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon SQS is a managed message-queuing service that lets distributed application components exchange messages and operate independently of one another. It is designed to move data between components while decoupling senders from receivers.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Simple Queue Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Why are AWS CloudFormation templates used?

options.text: To reduce provisioning time by using automation.
To transfer existing infrastructure to another company.
To reuse on-premises infrastructure in the AWS Cloud.
To deploy large infrastructure with no cost implications.

questions.explanation:
AWS CloudFormation automates infrastructure provisioning through declarative infrastructure-as-code templates, significantly reducing deployment time. CloudFormation cannot transfer existing infrastructure to other companies, reuse on-premises infrastructure (it is cloud-specific), nor eliminate infrastructure costs—it reduces provisioning time and helps enforce consistency across environments.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS CloudFormation?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which option represents a customer responsibility in the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Maintenance of underlying hardware of Amazon EC2 instances

questions.explanation:
Customers are responsible for security in the cloud, including securing their data and applications. AWS is responsible for the underlying hardware and the physical security of its facilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework – Shared responsibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company is using AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).  
  
Who can manage the access keys of the AWS account root user?

options.text: IAM users in the same account that have been granted permission
IAM roles in any account that have been granted permission
IAM users and roles that have been granted permission

questions.explanation:
Access keys for the AWS account root user can only be created, viewed, and managed by the account owner who has the root credentials; AWS best practice is to avoid creating root access keys at all. IAM users and roles, no matter what permissions they are granted, have no ability to manage the root user's own access keys.\
\
**Learn more:** [Root user best practices for your AWS account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html) · [AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company requires a customized assessment of its existing on-premises environment. The company wants to understand its projected operating costs in the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which AWS service or tool meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Migration Evaluator creates a data-driven migration business case from an on-premises environment assessment and projects AWS costs using measured on-premises provisioning and utilization.\
\
**Learn more:** [Migration Evaluator features](https://aws.amazon.com/migration-evaluator/features/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar focuses on structured and streamlined allocation of computing resources?
questions.explanation:
Performance Efficiency is the AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar that focuses on structured and streamlined allocation of computing resources to meet requirements while optimizing for cost and maintenance as demands change. It covers instance sizing, auto-scaling, and resource optimization. Reliability ensures availability, Operational Excellence focuses on management practices, and Sustainability addresses environmental impact.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Performance Efficiency Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/performance-efficiency-pillar/welcome.html) · [Performance efficiency - Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/performance-efficiency.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has migrated its workload to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to optimize existing Amazon EC2 resources.  
  
Which AWS services or tools provide this functionality? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes historical utilization metrics and recommends optimal EC2 instance types and sizes, while AWS Cost Explorer's rightsizing recommendations highlight over-provisioned or idle instances to cut costs; together these directly address optimizing existing EC2 resource usage. Elastic Beanstalk is an application deployment and orchestration service, Amazon Detective is a security investigation tool, and AWS Billing Conductor manages custom billing groups, none of which optimize EC2 resource usage.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Compute Optimizer](https://aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company's application is running on Amazon EC2 instances. The company is planning a partial migration to a serverless architecture in the next year and wants to pay for resources up front.  
  
Which AWS purchasing option will optimize the company's costs?
questions.explanation:
Compute Savings Plans apply automatically across EC2, AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda usage regardless of instance family, size, or region, so the upfront commitment continues to deliver savings as workloads shift from EC2 to serverless services. Convertible Reserved Instances and EC2 Instance Savings Plans only discount EC2 usage and would lose value once workloads move to Lambda or Fargate.\
**Learn more:** [Compute Savings Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has a website on AWS. The company wants to deliver the website to a worldwide audience and provide low-latency response times for global users.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) that caches and serves content from edge locations around the world, providing low-latency access for a globally distributed audience. CloudFormation is for infrastructure provisioning, ElastiCache is for in-memory caching of application data, and DynamoDB is a NoSQL database, none of which are CDN services.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to purchase Amazon EC2 instances to support an application that will run continuously for more than 1 year.  
  
Which EC2 instance purchasing option meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances offer the deepest discounts (up to 72% versus On-Demand) for workloads with steady, predictable usage over a 1- or 3-year term, making them the most cost-effective option for an application that runs continuously for more than a year. Dedicated Instances address compliance/tenancy needs rather than cost, Spot Instances can be interrupted, and On-Demand pricing carries no long-term discount.\
**Learn more:** [Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is using AWS for all its IT infrastructure. The company's developers are allowed to deploy applications on their own. The developers want to deploy their applications without having to provision the infrastructure themselves.  
  
Which AWS service should the developers use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk abstracts away infrastructure provisioning by automatically handling capacity planning, load balancing, auto-scaling, and application deployment. Developers can focus on application code while Elastic Beanstalk manages the underlying infrastructure.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company needs to run some of its workloads on premises to comply with regulatory guidelines. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud to run workloads that are not required to be on premises. The company also wants to be able to use the same API calls for the on-premises workloads and the cloud workloads.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Outposts extends AWS infrastructure and APIs to on-premises facilities, enabling hybrid deployments with consistent API calls across cloud and on-premises environments. Dedicated Hosts (A) reserve EC2 instances but don't extend AWS infrastructure on-premises, Availability Zones (C) are cloud regions, and Wavelength (D) brings AWS to edge locations.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Outposts](https://aws.amazon.com/outposts/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to run a data warehouse to analyze data without having to manage the data warehouse infrastructure.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Redshift Serverless is a serverless data warehouse service that automatically provisions and scales data warehouse capacity, allowing data analysis without managing the underlying warehouse infrastructure.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Redshift Serverless?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/serverless-whatis.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS team or offering helps users accelerate cloud adoption through paid engagements in any of several specialty practice areas?
questions.explanation:
AWS Professional Services is the global team of AWS experts that engages with customers through paid, scoped consulting engagements across specialty practice areas, such as migration, data and analytics, and security, to help accelerate cloud adoption. AWS Solutions Architects and account managers provide pre-sales and account guidance rather than paid delivery engagements, and Enterprise Support is a support subscription tier, not a consulting offering.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Professional Services](https://aws.amazon.com/professional-services/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service provides cloud security posture management (CSPM) by aggregating alerts from multiple AWS services and partner products in a standardized format?
questions.explanation:
AWS Security Hub CSPM centralizes findings from integrated AWS services and third-party products and normalizes them using the AWS Security Finding Format (ASFF), providing a consolidated view of security posture.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Security Finding Format (ASFF)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/securityhub-findings-format.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to perform an audit of recent AWS account activity. The audit will investigate who initiated an event and what actions were performed.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records account activity as a history of API calls and console actions, capturing who made the request, when it happened, the source, and what action was performed, which is exactly the audit trail the company needs. AWS Config tracks resource configuration changes rather than caller identity, and Amazon Rekognition and Amazon SNS are unrelated to activity auditing.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudTrail User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can be used to send alerts when a specific Amazon CloudWatch alarm is invoked?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) is commonly integrated with CloudWatch alarms to send notifications, emails, and SMS alerts to subscribers when alarms are triggered. CloudTrail logs API calls, SQS queues messages, and EventBridge routes events—while SNS is the primary alerting mechanism for CloudWatch alarms.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using Amazon CloudWatch alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Alarms.html) · [Setting up Amazon SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/US_SetupSNS.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which Amazon S3 storage class is the **MOST** cost-effective choice for unknown access patterns?

options.text: S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

questions.explanation:
S3 Intelligent-Tiering monitors access patterns and automatically moves objects to the most cost-effective access tier as their access frequency changes, making it the recommended class for unknown or unpredictable access patterns.\
\
**Learn more:** [Managing storage costs with Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which Amazon S3 storage class is the **MOST** cost-effective choice for unknown access patterns?
questions.explanation:
AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) handles the data migration process, while the AWS Schema Conversion Tool converts database schemas from proprietary formats to open-source-compatible schemas. Together they enable seamless migration from commercial databases like Oracle to open-source alternatives like PostgreSQL or MySQL. SDKs, Systems Manager, and EMR do not directly support database schema migration.

**Learn more:** [Converting database schemas using DMS Schema Conversion](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_SchemaConversion.html) · [What is the AWS Schema Conversion Tool?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is moving its development and test environments to AWS to increase agility and reduce cost. Because these are not production workloads and the servers are not fully utilized, occasional unavailability is acceptable.  
  
What is the MOST cost-effective Amazon EC2 pricing model that will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances let a customer bid on unused EC2 capacity at up to a 90% discount versus On-Demand rates, with the tradeoff that AWS can reclaim the instance with a two-minute warning. That tradeoff is a non-issue for dev/test workloads that can tolerate occasional interruption, making Spot the most cost-effective choice. Reserved Instances and Dedicated Hosts require longer-term commitments that don't fit variable, non-production usage, and On-Demand costs more than Spot for interruptible work.

**Learn more:** [Spot Instances - Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following statements describes some of Amazon S3's core functionality?

options.text: Amazon S3 is a high-performance block storage service that is designed for use with Amazon EC2.
Amazon S3 is an object storage service that provides high-level performance, security, scalability, and data availability.
Amazon S3 is a fully managed, highly reliable, and scalable file storage system that is accessible over the industry-standard SMB protocol.
Amazon S3 is a scalable, fully managed elastic NFS for use with AWS Cloud services and on-premises resources.

questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 is an object storage service that provides industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance. [AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon S3?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to run its application's code without having to provision and manage servers.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Lambda is the serverless compute service that runs application code without requiring users to provision or manage servers. It automatically scales based on demand, handles infrastructure management, and charges only for actual execution time.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which design principle aligns with performance efficiency pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
questions.explanation: AWS explicitly lists \"use serverless architectures\" as one of the named design principles of the Performance Efficiency pillar, alongside going global in minutes, experimenting more often, and considering mechanical sympathy. Horizontal scaling is a general elasticity practice but is not one of the pillar's documented design principles. **Learn more:** [Performance Efficiency Pillar Design Principles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/performance-efficiency-pillar/design-principles.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company needs to prevent SQL injection attacks.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should it use to satisfy this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS WAF can inspect web requests and block SQL injection attempts through SQL injection match conditions and managed rule groups.\
\
**Learn more:** [SQL injection attack rule statement - AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following represents a recommended design principle in the AWS Well-Architected Framework?

options.text: Reduce downtime by making infrastructure changes infrequently and in large increments.
Invest the time to configure infrastructure manually.
Learn to improve from operational failures.
Use monolithic application design for centralization.

questions.explanation:
The AWS Well-Architected Framework’s Operational Excellence pillar recommends learning from operational events and failures, using the resulting lessons to continually improve workloads and operations.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework – Operational Excellence design principles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/oe-design-principles.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has a MariaDB database on premises. The company wants to move the data to the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which AWS service will host this database with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service that supports MariaDB and automatically handles patching, backups, failover, and scaling, minimizing operational overhead compared to self-managed databases. Neptune is for graphs, S3 for object storage, and DynamoDB for NoSQL—none are suitable relational database replacements.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon RDS for MariaDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_MariaDB.html) · [Amazon RDS for MariaDB product page](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/mariadb/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which choice represents a physical location within the AWS global infrastructure?
questions.explanation:
An AWS Region is a physical geographic location in which AWS clusters data centers across multiple Availability Zones. AWS DataSync, Amazon Connect, and AWS Organizations are services, not infrastructure locations.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-infrastructure/latest/regions/aws-regions.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which pricing model can interrupt a running Amazon EC2 instance when capacity is temporarily unavailable?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 Spot Instances use spare capacity and can be interrupted when EC2 needs to reclaim that capacity, including when Spot capacity is unavailable.\
\
**Learn more:** [Spot Instance interruptions - Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-interruptions.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service gives users the ability to deploy highly repeatable infrastructure configurations?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudFormation enables infrastructure-as-code by defining AWS resources in reusable templates. This allows highly repeatable and automated infrastructure deployments. AWS CodeDeploy handles application deployment, CodeBuild compiles code, and Systems Manager provides operational capabilities—none provide infrastructure templating.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is CloudFormation?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to let users authenticate and authorize access to multiple AWS accounts using one set of credentials.  
  
Which AWS service or resource satisfies this requirement?

options.text: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)

questions.explanation:
AWS IAM Identity Center provides single sign-on access to assigned AWS accounts and centrally manages users, groups, and permission sets across multiple accounts in an AWS Organization. It was formerly named AWS Single Sign-On.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html) · [Configure access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-accounts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company with multiple accounts and teams wants to set up a new multi-account AWS environment.  
  
Which AWS service supports this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Control Tower provides a managed service for setting up, governing, and managing multi-account AWS environments based on AWS best practices. It automates account creation, applies guardrails, and enforces organizational policies across multiple accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS multi-account strategy for your Control Tower landing zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/aws-multi-account-landing-zone.html) · [How AWS Control Tower works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/how-control-tower-works.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company needs to have the ability to set up infrastructure for new applications in minutes.  
  
Which advantage of cloud computing will help the company meet this requirement?

options.text: Trade fixed expense for variable expense

questions.explanation:
Increased speed and agility is the AWS cloud value proposition that describes provisioning new resources and infrastructure within minutes instead of the weeks typically required on-premises. Trading fixed for variable expense addresses cost structure, going global in minutes addresses geographic reach, and neither directly speaks to rapid provisioning time.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Value Framework](https://aws.amazon.com/economics/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company stores monthly reports in an Amazon S3 bucket and exports the report data as comma-separated values (.csv) files. A developer needs to write a simple query that reads all these files and produces a summary report.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should the developer use to meet these requirements with the **LEAST** operational overhead?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Athena is a serverless interactive query service that uses standard SQL to analyze data directly in Amazon S3, including CSV data. It can query the report files without provisioning or managing database servers or compute infrastructure, providing the lowest operational overhead.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon Athena documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company frequently does not use all of its existing Amazon EC2 capacity for running stateless workloads. The company wants to optimize its EC2 costs.  
  
Which EC2 instance type meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances provide access to unused EC2 capacity at substantial discounts and are well suited to stateless, interruption-tolerant workloads, making them the appropriate option for reducing EC2 costs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Best practices for Amazon EC2 Spot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html) · [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: What is the total volume of data that can be stored in Amazon S3?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 offers virtually unlimited storage capacity with no maximum limit on total data volume. Each object can be up to 5 TB, and you can store as many objects as needed. The specific storage limits listed (A-C) are far exceeded by real-world S3 deployments.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon S3 FAQs](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/faqs/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service enables users to audit API activity across their AWS account?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records AWS API calls and provides an account-activity history for auditing and security analysis.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to engage third-party consultants to help maintain and support its AWS environment and meet the company’s business needs.  
  
Which AWS service or resource meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Partner Network (APN) is AWS’s community of third-party organizations that provide solutions and services to customers. Its consulting and managed service partners can provide specialized expertise, ongoing environment management, and support aligned to business needs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Work with an AWS Partner](https://aws.amazon.com/partners/work-with-partners/) · [AWS Partner Network](https://aws.amazon.com/partners/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework aligns with the ability to make frequent, small, and reversible changes to AWS Cloud architecture?
questions.explanation:
The Operational Excellence pillar's design principles include making frequent, small, reversible changes so that any issues can be quickly identified and rolled back with minimal impact. Security, cost optimization, and performance efficiency address different concerns (protecting data, minimizing spend, and using resources efficiently) rather than the cadence and reversibility of architectural changes.\
\
**Learn more:** [Operational Excellence Pillar - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/operational-excellence-pillar/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool gives users the ability to connect with AWS and deploy resources programmatically?
questions.explanation:
AWS SDKs (Software Development Kits) enable programmatic access to AWS services across multiple programming languages (Python, Java, Node.js, Go, etc.), allowing developers to deploy resources, manage infrastructure, and integrate AWS into applications. QuickSight is a BI tool, PrivateLink provides private connectivity, and Direct Connect establishes dedicated network connections—none support resource deployment programmatically.\
\
**Learn more:** [Authentication and access using AWS SDKs and tools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/access.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to monitor and block malicious HTTP and HTTPS requests that its Amazon CloudFront distributions receive.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall) monitors and blocks malicious HTTP and HTTPS requests at the application layer. It can be integrated with CloudFront to protect web applications. GuardDuty detects account threats, Inspector finds vulnerabilities, and Detective investigates security issues—none provide real-time HTTP request filtering.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using AWS WAF with Amazon CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/cloudfront-features.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service tracks, records, and audits configuration changes to AWS resources?
questions.explanation:
AWS Config records the configurations of AWS resources and tracks configuration changes, providing configuration history for auditing and compliance purposes.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html) · [AWS Config product page](https://aws.amazon.com/config/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which options are recommended for the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) cloud transformation journey? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS CAF recommends four iterative, incremental cloud transformation phases: Envision, Align, Launch, and Scale. Therefore, Envision and Align are the listed AWS CAF recommendations.\
\
**Learn more:** [Your cloud transformation journey — AWS Cloud Adoption Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/your-cloud-transformation-journey.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to set up dedicated network connectivity between its on-premises data center and the AWS Cloud. The network cannot use the public internet.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network connection between an on-premises data center and AWS that bypasses the public internet, meeting security and reliability requirements. Transit Gateway connects multiple networks but uses existing connections; VPN still traverses the internet; and CloudFront is a content delivery network.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to log in securely to Linux Amazon EC2 instances.  
  
How can the company accomplish this goal?
questions.explanation: SSH key pairs provide secure, certificate-based authentication for logging into Linux EC2 instances without transmitting a reusable password, and are the standard AWS-recommended method. A VPN secures network paths but is not itself a login mechanism, end-to-end encryption protects data in transit generically, and Route 53 is a DNS service unrelated to instance login. **Learn more:** [Connect to your Linux instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/AccessingInstances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to manage deployed IT services and govern its infrastructure-as-code (IaC) templates.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Service Catalog centrally manages approved IT service offerings and governs their provisioning through products, portfolios, constraints, permissions, and versioned infrastructure templates. It supports governing and distributing IaC templates, including AWS CloudFormation templates.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Service Catalog — Introduction to DevOps on AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/introduction-devops-aws/aws-service-catalog.html) · [AWS Service Catalog Administrator Guide: Overview of Service Catalog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/what-is_concepts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company requires a time-series database service that simplifies storing and analyzing trillions of events every day.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Timestream is a fully managed, purpose-built time-series database that is designed to store and analyze trillions of time-series data points per day.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Timestream for LiveAnalytics?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/what-is-timestream.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to provide low latency to its users around the world.  
  
Which feature of the AWS Cloud meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS's global infrastructure of Regions, Availability Zones, and edge locations lets a company place resources physically close to end users anywhere in the world, minimizing the network distance data must travel and thereby reducing latency. Pay-as-you-go pricing, managed services, and economies of scale are cost and operational benefits of the cloud, not features that directly reduce latency.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Global Infrastructure](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants its AWS usage to be more sustainable. The company wants to track, measure, review, and forecast polluting emissions that result from its AWS applications.  
  
Which AWS service or tool can the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Customer Carbon Footprint Tool tracks, measures, reviews, and forecasts carbon emissions generated from AWS usage. The Health Dashboard monitors service health, Support Center provides technical support, and QuickSight creates dashboards—only the Carbon Footprint Tool directly addresses emissions tracking.\
\
**Learn more:** [Understanding the Customer Carbon Footprint Tool](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ccft-overview.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company needs to monitor security groups that are misconfigured to permit unrestricted access to specific ports.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Trusted Advisor includes the Security Groups – Specific Ports Unrestricted check, which identifies security-group rules that permit unrestricted access to designated ports.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Trusted Advisor check reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor-check-reference.html) · [Security checks in AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/security-checks.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to migrate a company’s on-premises container infrastructure to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to prevent unplanned administration and operation cost and adapt to a serverless architecture.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Fargate is the serverless container orchestration service that eliminates the need to manage underlying infrastructure, addressing the requirement to prevent unplanned administration costs. It handles scaling and infrastructure management automatically. Amazon Connect is for contact centers, Amazon Lightsail is for simple applications, and Amazon EC2 requires manual infrastructure management.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Fargate (serverless compute engine)](https://aws.amazon.com/fargate/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to migrate a company’s on-premises container infrastructure to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to prevent unplanned administration and operation cost and adapt to a serverless architecture.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?

options.text: When an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances requires access to other AWS services
When the company creates AWS access credentials for individuals
When the company creates an application that runs on a mobile phone that makes requests to AWS
When the company needs to add users to IAM groups
When users are authenticated in the corporate network and want to be able to use AWS without having to sign in a second time

questions.explanation:
IAM users are intended for individual people who need long-term AWS credentials, such as a console password or access keys, so creating access credentials for individuals is the classic scenario for an IAM user rather than a role. Applications on EC2, mobile apps calling AWS, and users federated from a corporate directory should instead assume an IAM role, which provides temporary credentials without long-term secrets.

**Learn more:** [When do I use IAM?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/when-to-use-iam.html) · [IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_users.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company must transfer data between an Amazon S3 bucket and an on-premises application.  
  
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, who is responsible for securing this data?
questions.explanation:
AWS customers are responsible for security in the cloud, including protecting their data and configuring the controls used to secure access and data transfers. AWS is responsible for the security of the underlying cloud infrastructure. \
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/) · [Security in Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company must transfer data between an Amazon S3 bucket and an on-premises application.  
  
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, who is responsible for securing this data?
questions.explanation:
The AWS CAF Platform perspective includes Data engineering and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), alongside platform architecture, platform engineering, data architecture, provisioning and orchestration, and modern application development. Performance and capacity management and change and release management are Operations perspective capabilities; infrastructure protection is a Security perspective capability.

**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Adoption Framework: Platform perspective — Introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/aws-caf-platform-perspective/introduction.html) · [AWS CAF Platform perspective: infrastructure and applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/platform-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service supports a company's ability to treat infrastructure as code?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudFormation lets you define and provision AWS infrastructure using declarative templates (JSON/YAML), which is the essence of infrastructure as code. CodeDeploy automates application deployments, Elastic Beanstalk is a PaaS for running applications, and API Gateway manages APIs — none of these are infrastructure-as-code provisioning tools.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudFormation](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudformation/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company operates a fleet of cargo ships. The ships have sensors that gather data at sea, where internet connectivity is intermittent or unavailable. The company must collect, format, and process the data at sea, and transfer the data to AWS later.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Snowball Edge provides local storage and EC2-compatible compute for edge locations with inconsistent or no network connectivity. It can collect and process sensor data locally, after which the device can transfer the accumulated data to AWS.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Snowball Edge Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to deploy a PostgreSQL database into Amazon RDS. The database must be highly available and fault tolerant.  
  
Which AWS solution should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.text: Amazon RDS with a single Availability Zone
Amazon RDS with multiple Availability Zones

questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS with multiple Availability Zones provides high availability and automatic failover. In a Multi-AZ deployment, a standby replica is maintained in a different AZ and automatically promoted if the primary fails.
