Single AZ deployment has no failover capability, snapshots are for backup/recovery only, and DMS is for data migration, not availability.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configuring and managing a Multi-AZ deployment for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which Amazon EC2 instance pricing option may offer discounts of up to 90%?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances use spare, interruptible Amazon EC2 capacity and can provide discounts of up to 90% compared with On-Demand prices.\
\
**Learn more:** [Best practices for Amazon EC2 Spot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which Amazon EC2 instance pricing option may offer discounts of up to 90%?

options.text: Use AWS Organizations and create one account for each business unit.
Use a spreadsheet to control the owners and cost of each resource.
Use an Amazon DynamoDB table to record costs for each business unit.
Use the AWS Billing console to assign owners to resources and track costs.

questions.explanation:
AWS Organizations supports separate member accounts for business units and consolidated billing. Costs can be tracked by member account while billing is centrally managed, providing built-in cost separation without maintaining a manual spreadsheet or custom DynamoDB cost-tracking solution.

**Learn more:** [Benefits of using multiple AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/welcome-multiple-accounts.html) · [Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to manage multiple logins across AWS accounts within the same organization in AWS Organizations.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: AWS IAM Identity Center lets a company manage sign-in centrally for multiple AWS accounts within an AWS Organizations structure, giving users a single set of credentials for one-click access to assigned accounts. VPC, GuardDuty, and Cognito address networking, threat detection, and customer app authentication, none of which manage cross-account console logins. **Learn more:** [What Is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: What does "security of the cloud” refer to in the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Availability of AWS services such as Amazon EC2
Security of the cloud infrastructure that runs all the AWS services
Implementation of password policies for IAM users
Security of customer environments by using AWS Network Firewall partners

questions.explanation:
In the AWS shared responsibility model, 'security of the cloud' refers to AWS's responsibility to protect the physical and virtual infrastructure running all AWS services. This includes protecting hardware, software, data center facilities, and networking infrastructure. This is distinct from 'security in the cloud,' which is the customer's responsibility for securing their applications and data.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to securely access an Amazon S3 bucket from an Amazon EC2 instance without accessing the internet.  
  
What should the company use to accomplish this goal?
questions.explanation:
A VPC endpoint (specifically a gateway endpoint for S3) allows resources inside a VPC to privately access Amazon S3 over the AWS network backbone without traversing the public internet. A VPN connection, internet gateway, and NAT gateway all route traffic through, or require, internet connectivity, which the requirement explicitly rules out.\
\
**Learn more:** [VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company uses Amazon EC2 instances to run its application. The application needs to be available and running continuously for three or more years.  
  
What type of EC2 instance should the company purchase for a discount on the EC2 pricing?
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances are designed for steady-state workloads that will run continuously for a committed 1- or 3-year term, in exchange for a significant discount over On-Demand pricing, which fits an application that must run continuously for three or more years. Spot Instances target interruptible, fault-tolerant workloads and On-Demand pricing offers no long-term commitment discount, so neither fits this scenario as well.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/reserved-instances/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A user has a stateful workload that will operate on Amazon EC2 for the next 3 years.  
  
What is the **MOST** cost-effective pricing model for this workload?
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances reduce Amazon EC2 costs in exchange for a one- or three-year commitment to a consistent instance configuration. A three-year Reserved Instance is therefore the cost-effective listed option for a continuously running stateful workload; Spot Instances can be interrupted and are not appropriate for it.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html) · [Reserved Instances for Amazon EC2 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_us/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/normalization-factor-for-dedicated-ec2-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A user has a stateful workload that will operate on Amazon EC2 for the next 3 years.  
  
What is the **MOST** cost-effective pricing model for this workload?
questions.explanation:
Pay-as-you-go pricing (B) allows the company to scale spending based on actual usage, while Auto Scaling policies (D) automatically adjust capacity to handle demand spikes without manual intervention. Together, these features manage seasonal workloads cost-effectively. Cross-Region deployment, CloudTrail auditing, and centralized logging do not directly address seasonal scaling.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html) · [What is Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service helps users plan and track their server and application inventory migration data to AWS?
questions.explanation:
AWS Migration Hub provides a single location to discover, plan, track, and monitor the progress of application migrations to AWS. It collects server and application inventory data for migration assessment and planning, offering visibility across multiple migration tools and solutions. Application Migration Service (MGN) automates the migration execution itself.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Migration Hub?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/migrationhub/latest/ug/whatishub.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following are pillars in the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS identifies Performance Efficiency and Cost Optimization as two of the six pillars of the Well-Architected Framework. The other pillars are Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, and Sustainability.\
\
**Learn more:** [The pillars of the framework - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/the-pillars-of-the-framework.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which choice is a shared control between AWS and the customer under the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation:
Configuration management is a shared control because AWS maintains the configuration of its infrastructure devices, while customers configure their guest operating systems, databases, and applications. [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which choice is a shared control between AWS and the customer under the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation:
AWS Transit Gateway provides a centralized transit hub for interconnecting VPCs and on-premises networks. It scales to large numbers of VPCs and can integrate with AWS Direct Connect through a Direct Connect gateway and transit virtual interface, avoiding separate connectivity management for each VPC.

**Learn more:** [What is AWS Transit Gateway for Amazon VPC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html) · [Direct Connect gateways and Transit Gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-transit-gateways.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is reviewing its AWS Business Support plan to decide whether it continues to meet the company’s requirements. The company is considering moving to AWS Enterprise Support.  
  
Which extra benefit will the company receive with AWS Enterprise Support?

options.text: A full set of AWS Trusted Advisor checks
Phone, email, and chat access to cloud support engineers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
A designated technical account manager (TAM) to assist in monitoring and optimization
A consultative review and architecture guidance for the company’s applications

questions.explanation:
AWS Enterprise Support includes a designated Technical Account Manager (TAM) who provides proactive, personalized assistance, including monitoring and optimization guidance. Full Trusted Advisor checks, 24/7 access to Cloud Support Engineers, and consultative architecture guidance are already available with AWS Business Support.

**Learn more:** [AWS Support Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/aws-support-plans.html) · [Compare AWS Support plans](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company wants its Amazon EC2 instances to be in different locations but share the same geographic area. The company also wants to use multiple power grids and independent networking connectivity for the EC2 instances.  
  
Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use EC2 instances in multiple edge locations in the same AWS Region.
Use EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones in the same AWS Region.
Use EC2 instances in multiple Amazon Connect locations in the same AWS Region.
Use EC2 instances in multiple AWS Artifact locations in the same AWS Region.

questions.explanation:
Availability Zones within a single region provide the exact infrastructure required: different physical locations sharing the same geographic area, each with independent power grids and networking. This ensures fault tolerance and high availability. Edge locations are for CloudFront content distribution, Amazon Connect is for contact centers, and AWS Artifact is for compliance documentation.

**Learn more:** [AWS Regions and Availability Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-infrastructure/latest/regions/aws-regions-availability-zones.html) · [Global Infrastructure: Regions & AZs](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/regions_az/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can determine when an Amazon EC2 instance was terminated?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail logs Amazon EC2 API management events, including `TerminateInstances`, with details such as the event time and request information. This enables auditing of an instance termination.\
\
**Learn more:** [Log Amazon EC2 API calls using AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitor-with-cloudtrail.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company has acquired another corporation and now has two AWS accounts.  
  
Which AWS service or tool can the company use to consolidate billing for these two accounts?
questions.explanation:
AWS Organizations provides consolidated billing and payment for multiple AWS accounts. Its management account receives and pays the combined bill for member accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to build a globally accessible ecommerce platform for its customers. The company wants to use a highly available, scalable DNS web service to connect users to the platform.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Route 53 is AWS’s highly available and scalable managed DNS web service. It routes users to internet applications and supports DNS routing policies and health checks.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon Route 53 product page](https://aws.amazon.com/route53/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to identify Amazon S3 buckets that are shared with a different AWS account.  
  
Which AWS service or feature meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
IAM Access Analyzer generates external-access findings for Amazon S3 buckets shared with external entities, including other AWS accounts. It can therefore identify buckets with cross-account access.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/what-is-access-analyzer.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to use a serverless compute service for an application.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Lambda is the primary serverless compute service—it executes code without requiring server provisioning or management. CloudFormation is an infrastructure templating service, Elastic Beanstalk is a platform-as-a-service for web applications, and Elastic Load Balancing handles request distribution.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or resource can a company use to deploy AWS WAF rules?
questions.explanation:
AWS WAF can be deployed on Application Load Balancers, CloudFront distributions, and API Gateways to filter HTTP(S) traffic using custom rules. The Application Load Balancer is the only option that supports WAF rule deployment; EC2 instances and Network Load Balancers do not natively support WAF integration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Associating a web ACL with an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl-associating-aws-resource.html) · [Configuring protection in AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: A company has migrated its workloads to AWS. It wants to adopt AWS at scale and operate more efficiently and securely. Which AWS service or framework should the company use for operational support?
questions.explanation:
AWS Managed Services (AMS) provides ongoing infrastructure operations management and operational support, including monitoring, incident management, security, patching, backups, and automation. It is specifically intended to help organizations adopt AWS at scale and operate more efficiently and securely.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Managed Services](https://aws.amazon.com/managed-services/) · [What is AWS Managed Services?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/managedservices/latest/userguide/what-is-ams.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to consolidate billing across multiple AWS accounts. The company must use a single account to pay for all the other accounts.  
  
Which AWS service or tool should the company use to fulfill this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Organizations supports consolidated billing for multiple AWS accounts. The organization’s management account is responsible for paying the charges incurred by its member accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which option is AWS responsible for under the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation:
Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, AWS is responsible for the security of the cloud infrastructure—including hardware, software, networking, and facilities. Customers are responsible for security in the cloud, including network configuration, client-side encryption, and user permission management. This is a fundamental distinction in cloud security responsibility.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service enables users to create interactive business intelligence dashboards that include machine learning insights?
questions.explanation:
Amazon QuickSight is a cloud business intelligence service that creates interactive dashboards and provides machine-learning-powered insights.\
\
**Learn more:** [QuickSight ML Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/user/making-data-driven-decisions-with-ml-in-quicksight.html) · [Amazon QuickSight AI-powered BI](https://aws.amazon.com/quicksight/features-ml/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must plan, schedule, and execute hundreds of thousands of computing jobs on AWS.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to satisfy this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Batch is a fully managed batch-computing service that plans, schedules, and runs containerized compute workloads at scale. It is specifically designed to run hundreds of thousands of batch computing jobs while provisioning compute resources according to job requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Batch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html) · [Loosely coupled scenarios – High Performance Computing Lens](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/high-performance-computing-lens/loosely-coupled-scenarios.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service uses a publisher-and-subscriber combination?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) provides a publish/subscribe messaging model in which publishers send messages to a topic and subscribers receive notifications from that topic.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html) · [Publishing an Amazon SNS message](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-publishing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company has deployed applications on Amazon EC2 instances. The company must assess application vulnerabilities and identify infrastructure deployments that fail to follow best practices.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Inspector automatically discovers and scans Amazon EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure, generating findings to help identify security issues and deployments that deviate from security best practices.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html) · [Amazon Inspector Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has deployed applications on Amazon EC2 instances. The company must assess application vulnerabilities and identify infrastructure deployments that fail to follow best practices.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Application Migration Service is specifically designed for migrating entire servers and virtual machines from on-premises infrastructure to AWS. It automatically converts the workload to run on AWS-native infrastructure and handles the replatforming transparently. AWS DataSync transfers data, AWS Database Migration Service migrates databases, and AWS Application Discovery Service analyzes servers for migration planning.

**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Application Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/what-is-application-migration-service.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service uses edge locations to cache content?
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudFront is AWS's content delivery network, which caches content at globally distributed edge locations to reduce latency for end users. Kinesis handles streaming data, SQS is a message queuing service, and Route 53 is DNS, none of which cache content at edge locations.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which option represents a benefit of economies of scale among the advantages of cloud computing?

options.text: The ability to trade variable expense for fixed expense
Lower variable costs over fixed costs
Increased operational costs across data centers

questions.explanation:
Cloud providers aggregate demand across many customers and operate at very large scale, which reduces the per-unit variable cost of computing resources compared with operating equivalent infrastructure independently.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials training](https://aws.amazon.com/training/learn-about/cloud-practitioner/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must centrally configure and manage Amazon VPC security groups across multiple AWS accounts in an AWS Organizations organization.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Firewall Manager uses AWS Organizations to apply centrally controlled security group policies across an organization or selected accounts and resources. It can also continuously manage and audit those VPC security group policies as accounts and resources change.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using security group policies in Firewall Manager to manage Amazon VPC security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/security-group-policies.html) · [AWS Firewall Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/fms-chapter.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature provides a firewall at the subnet level within a VPC?
questions.explanation:
Network Access Control Lists (NACLs) provide subnet-level firewall functionality within a VPC using stateless filtering rules. Security groups operate at the instance level, elastic network interfaces are virtual network cards, and AWS WAF protects web applications from layer 7 attacks—only NACLs serve as subnet-level firewalls.\
\
**Learn more:** [Control subnet traffic with network ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service is used to temporarily provide federated security credentials to access AWS resources?
questions.explanation:
AWS Security Token Service (STS) provides temporary security credentials for federated access, allowing users authenticated through external identity providers to assume roles and access AWS resources with limited permissions. GuardDuty detects threats; Secrets Manager stores long-term credentials; and Certificate Manager manages SSL/TLS certificates.\
\
**Learn more:** [Temporary security credentials in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp.html) · [AWS STS API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS service is used to temporarily provide federated security credentials to access AWS resources?
questions.explanation:
Rightsizing is the process of analyzing and matching EC2 instance types and sizes to actual workload requirements to optimize both performance and cost. It involves identifying underutilized or over-provisioned instances and adjusting to optimal configurations. Auto Scaling adjusts capacity dynamically, Storage tiering optimizes storage costs, and Instance scheduling manages availability—all cost-reduction techniques but not specifically for matching performance requirements.

**Learn more:** [Optimizing your cost with rightsizing recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-rightsizing.html) · [Right Sizing - AWS Cost Optimization](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/aws-cost-optimization/right-sizing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service lets customers audit API calls in their AWS accounts?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records AWS API calls for an account and provides their history for auditing, including who made the call, when it occurred, and the source IP address.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudTrail Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudtrail/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company with multiple business units wants to centrally manage and govern its AWS Cloud environments. The company needs to automate AWS account creation, apply service control policies (SCPs), and simplify billing processes.  
  
Which AWS service or tool should the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Organizations provides centralized multi-account management and governance. It supports programmatic account creation, lets organizations apply SCPs for centralized permission guardrails, and offers consolidated billing across member accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Organizations?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company needs to monitor the performance of its workloads. The company must ensure its cloud services are delivered at a level that satisfies its business needs.  
  
Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
The AWS CAF Operations perspective covers monitoring workload performance and capacity, and it focuses on delivering cloud services at a level agreed with business stakeholders.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF Operations perspective: health and availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/operations-perspective.html) · [AWS CAF Operations perspective: Performance and capacity management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-operations-perspective/performance-and-capacity-management.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can an administrator use to deliver desktop environments to several employees?
questions.explanation:
Amazon WorkSpaces provisions managed, virtual cloud-based desktops for users, making it the AWS service for providing employee desktop environments.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon WorkSpaces?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces/latest/adminguide/amazon-workspaces.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to continuously improve processes and procedures to deliver business value.  
  
Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework does this goal represent?
questions.explanation:
Operational Excellence is the AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar focused on continuously improving processes and procedures to deliver business value. It emphasizes automation, documentation, best practices, and learning from failures. Performance Efficiency focuses on resource utilization, Reliability on system resilience, and Sustainability on environmental impact.\
\
**Learn more:** [Operational excellence pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/operational-excellence.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is running big data analytics and massive parallel computations on its AWS test and development servers. The company can tolerate occasional downtime.  
  
What is the MOST cost-effective Amazon EC2 purchasing option for the company to use?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances offer up to 90% cost savings compared to On-Demand pricing and are ideal for workloads that can tolerate interruptions. Big data analytics and batch computations on test/development servers are classic use cases for Spot Instances. Reserved Instances require longer commitments and higher upfront costs, making them less suitable for this scenario.\
\
**Learn more:** [Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company is running big data analytics and massive parallel computations on its AWS test and development servers. The company can tolerate occasional downtime.  
  
What is the MOST cost-effective Amazon EC2 purchasing option for the company to use?

options.text: Realign teams to focus on products and value streams.
Create new value propositions with new products and services.
Use a new data and analytics platform to create actionable insights.

questions.explanation: Under the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework's People Perspective, realigning teams around products and value streams and adopting agile ways of working is the recommended action for becoming more responsive and customer-centric during organizational transformation. Creating new value propositions, adopting analytics platforms, and modernizing legacy infrastructure are valid CAF activities but fall under the Business and Platform perspectives, not the people/organizational-responsiveness goal described. **Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Adoption Framework](https://aws.amazon.com/professional-services/CAF/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature requires an internet service provider (ISP) and a colocation facility to be implemented?
questions.explanation:
AWS Direct Connect requires both an ISP/network provider and a colocation facility to establish a dedicated network connection between on-premises infrastructure and AWS. This contrasts with AWS VPN (which uses public internet), Amazon Connect (cloud contact center), and Internet Gateway (VPC component).\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html) · [Requesting cross connects at Direct Connect locations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Colocation.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: What is the MOST secure way to store passwords on AWS?

options.text: Store passwords in an Amazon S3 bucket.
Store passwords as AWS CloudFormation parameters.
Store passwords in AWS Storage Gateway.
Store passwords in AWS Secrets Manager.

questions.explanation: AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built to securely store, encrypt, and automatically rotate credentials such as passwords, with fine-grained IAM access control and audit logging. S3, CloudFormation parameters, and Storage Gateway are not designed for secret storage and lack rotation and secure-retrieval capabilities. **Learn more:** [What Is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: What is a benefit of using an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer with applications running in the AWS Cloud?

options.text: An ELB will automatically scale resources to meet capacity needs.
An ELB can balance traffic across multiple compute resources.
An ELB can span multiple AWS Regions.
An ELB can balance traffic between multiple internet gateways.

questions.explanation:
Elastic Load Balancing automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets, such as EC2 instances, containers, and IP addresses, within one or more Availability Zones. An ELB itself does not scale compute capacity (that is Auto Scaling's role), does not span multiple Regions, and does not balance traffic between internet gateways.\
\
**Learn more:** [Elastic Load Balancing](https://aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: When designing AWS workloads to be operational even when there are component failures, what is an AWS best practice?

options.text: Place the main component on the us-east-1 Region.
Design for automatic failover to healthy resources.
Design workloads to fit on a single Amazon EC2 instance.

questions.explanation:
Designing for automatic failover to healthy resources ensures workloads remain operational when components fail, enabling fault tolerance without manual intervention. Quarterly DR tests are insufficient, single-region deployment increases risk, and fitting workloads on one instance creates a single point of failure.\
\
**Learn more:** [REL11-BP02 Fail over to healthy resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/rel_withstand_component_failures_failover2good.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to receive alerts to monitor its total operating costs for its AWS public-cloud infrastructure.  
  
Which AWS offering meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Budgets tracks AWS costs and usage and can send notifications when actual or forecasted costs exceed defined budget thresholds, providing alerts for overall cloud operating costs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Logging and monitoring in AWS Cost Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/billing-security-logging.html) · [AWS Budgets best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A social media company needs to safeguard its web application against common web attacks, including SQL injection and cross-site scripting.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS WAF protects web applications by inspecting HTTP(S) requests and applying rules that can detect and block malicious SQL code associated with SQL injection and malicious scripts associated with cross-site scripting.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS WAF rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rules.html) · [What is AWS WAF?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which task is a customer responsibility when using AWS Lambda under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Managing the code within the Lambda function
Confirming that the hardware is working in the data center
Shutting down Lambda functions when they are no longer in use

questions.explanation:
AWS manages the underlying infrastructure, hardware, and operating system for Lambda. Customers are responsible for their function code, including updating code and dependencies to address vulnerabilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [Lambda runtimes — AWS Lambda Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html) · [Security in AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-functions-chapter.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following is a software development framework a company can use to define cloud resources as code and provision those resources through AWS CloudFormation?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) is an open-source software development framework for defining cloud infrastructure in code and provisioning it through AWS CloudFormation.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is the AWS CDK?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/home.html?pg=cloudessentials)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has an application with demanding hardware requirements. Students using lightweight, low-cost laptops must be able to access the application.  
  
Which AWS service helps the company deploy the application without investing in backend infrastructure or high-end client hardware?
questions.explanation:
Amazon AppStream 2.0 is a fully managed application-streaming service that runs the application on AWS streaming instances and delivers its interface to users’ devices. Compute-intensive processing therefore occurs in AWS, allowing access from lightweight laptops without the company managing the underlying infrastructure.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using Microsoft Power BI Desktop in the AWS Cloud](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/using-power-bi-with-aws-cloud/using-microsoft-power-bi-desktop-in-the-aws-cloud.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must assess its AWS environment and deliver best-practice recommendations across five categories: cost, performance, service limits, fault tolerance, and security.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Trusted Advisor inspects an AWS environment and provides best-practice recommendations across cost optimization, performance, security, fault tolerance, and service limits.\
\
**Learn more:** [Get started with Trusted Advisor Recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/get-started-with-aws-trusted-advisor.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company must assess its AWS environment and deliver best-practice recommendations across five categories: cost, performance, service limits, fault tolerance, and security.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances provide discounted spare EC2 capacity and are well suited to stateless, fault-tolerant batch workloads that can tolerate interruption and rescheduling. AWS specifically identifies Spot Instances as a cost-optimized option for AWS Batch and other flexible, interruption-tolerant workloads.

**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 On-Demand or Amazon EC2 Spot — AWS Batch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/bestpractice5.html) · [Select the best pricing model — AWS Well-Architected Cost Optimization Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/cost-optimization-pillar/select-the-best-pricing-model.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company requires a fully managed file server with native support for Microsoft workloads and file systems. The file server must also support the SMB protocol.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to satisfy these requirements?

options.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

questions.explanation:
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server provides fully managed Microsoft Windows file servers with native Windows file-system support and SMB access, making it suitable for Microsoft workloads.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is FSx for Windows File Server?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants an AWS service that can automate software deployment in Amazon EC2 instances and on-premises instances.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS CodeDeploy automates software deployment to any compute resource, including EC2 instances and on-premises servers, supporting multiple deployment strategies and rollback capabilities. CodeCommit is a source control service; CodeBuild compiles and tests code; CodePipeline orchestrates CI/CD workflows.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is CodeDeploy?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html) · [Deployments on an EC2/On-Premises Compute Platform](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-steps-server.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which option is an advantage of AWS Cloud computing that minimizes variable costs?
questions.explanation:
Economies of scale is the key advantage that minimizes variable costs—AWS aggregates demand from millions of customers to achieve lower per-unit costs than individual organizations could obtain. High availability (A), global reach (C), and agility (D) are cloud benefits but don't directly reduce variable costs through volume-based pricing advantages.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS tool or feature acts as a VPC firewall at the subnet level?
questions.explanation:
Network Access Control Lists (NACLs) operate at the subnet level, acting as a stateless firewall that can allow or deny both inbound and outgoing traffic. Security groups operate at the instance level, Traffic Mirroring copies network traffic, and Internet Gateways enable internet connectivity—only NACLs provide subnet-level firewall protection.\
\
**Learn more:** [Control subnet traffic with network ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS tool or feature acts as a VPC firewall at the subnet level?
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances and Savings Plans reduce EC2 cost in exchange for a one- or three-year commitment to consistent usage. They suit steady, predictable workloads while avoiding the interruption risk of Spot Instances. AWS specifically identifies Savings Plans as suitable for steady-state, predictable usage requiring uninterrupted availability, and Reserved Instances as a commitment-based discount for a consistent instance configuration.

**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html) · [Choosing a purchasing option for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/decision-guides/latest/ec2-purchasing-options-aws-how-to-choose/ec2-purchasing-options-aws-how-to-choose.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service provides a fully managed graph database for highly connected datasets?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Neptune is AWS's fully managed graph database service, designed for highly connected datasets (social networks, recommendation engines, knowledge graphs). It stores data as nodes and edges and supports graph queries. DynamoDB is key-value/document, RDS and Aurora are relational databases—none are optimized for graph traversals.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is Amazon Neptune?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/intro.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A developer needs AWS users to access AWS services using temporary security credentials.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should the developer use to supply these credentials?

options.text: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)

questions.explanation:
AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) creates and provides temporary, limited-privilege security credentials for access to AWS resources. These credentials are dynamically issued and expire after their configured lifetime.\
\
**Learn more:** [Temporary security credentials in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp.html) · [AWS Security Token Service API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to search text within documents stored in Amazon S3.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Kendra can use an Amazon S3 bucket as a data source, index the documents it contains, and search the indexed document text.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon S3 data source for Amazon Kendra](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kendra/latest/dg/data-source-s3.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to receive a notification when a particular AWS cost threshold is met.  
  
Which AWS services or tools can the company use to fulfill this requirement? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS Budgets can send alerts when actual or forecasted spending reaches a configured budget threshold. Amazon CloudWatch can create billing alarms for estimated AWS charges that cross a specified amount.\
\
**Learn more:** [Managing your costs with AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances term commitment will give users the MOST cost savings?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances are offered only in 1-year and 3-year terms; AWS does not sell a 2-year or 5-year Reserved Instance term. Because the discount increases with the length of the commitment, the 3-year term provides the greatest cost savings of the available options.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/reserved-instances/pricing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has created an Amazon EC2 instance. The company needs to control incoming and outgoing network traffic at the instance level.  
  
Which AWS resource or service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Security groups act as virtual firewalls for associated Amazon EC2 instances. Their inbound rules control traffic entering an instance, and their outbound rules control traffic leaving it.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 security groups for your EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-security-groups.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A user has limited familiarity with AWS services but needs to rapidly deploy a scalable Node.js application in the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which service should be used to deploy the application?
questions.explanation:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk supports Node.js applications and provides a simplified deployment experience while automatically handling infrastructure tasks such as capacity provisioning, load balancing, scaling, and application health monitoring.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Elastic Beanstalk Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elastic-beanstalk/) · [What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to run some of its workload in the AWS Cloud. The company needs to keep some of the workload in its own on-site data center due to compliance reasons.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Outposts extends AWS infrastructure, services, APIs, and management tools to a customer's own on-premises data center, allowing part of a workload to run locally on AWS-managed hardware while remaining integrated with the AWS Cloud, which satisfies compliance requirements that keep certain data or processing on-site. AWS Config tracks resource configuration compliance, Amazon Lightsail is a simplified virtual private server offering, and Amazon Connect is a cloud contact center service, none of which extend AWS to an on-premises facility.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Outposts](https://aws.amazon.com/outposts/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to onboard new employees that will be working remotely. The company needs to set up Windows virtual desktops to create a working environment for the new employees. The employees must be able access the working environment from anywhere and by using their computer or a web browser.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon WorkSpaces is a managed Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) solution that provisions Windows or Linux virtual desktops accessible from anywhere via web browsers or native clients. It meets all requirements: remote access, multiple device types, and managed infrastructure.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon WorkSpaces?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces/latest/adminguide/amazon-workspaces.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which task is the customer responsible for under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Management of the guest operating systems
Maintenance of the configuration of infrastructure devices
Management of the host operating systems and virtualization
Maintenance of the software that powers Availability Zones

questions.explanation:
Customers manage the guest operating system, including its updates and security patches. AWS manages the host operating system and virtualization layer, as well as the underlying cloud infrastructure and Availability Zones.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which task is the customer responsible for under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Integrate functional testing as part of AWS deployment.
Deploy the application to multiple locations.

questions.explanation:
Microservices divide a monolithic workload into smaller, independent components with defined interfaces. This creates looser coupling, so components can be changed and scaled independently, improving maintainability and scalability. AWS identifies avoiding monolithic workloads and implementing loosely coupled dependencies as Well-Architected guidance.

**Learn more:** [REL04-BP02 Implement loosely coupled dependencies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2023-10-03/framework/rel_prevent_interaction_failure_loosely_coupled_system.html) · [REL03-BP01 Choose how to segment your workload](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2025-02-25/framework/rel_service_architecture_monolith_soa_microservice.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can a company use to manage encryption keys in the cloud?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudHSM is a hardware security module that allows customers to manage their own encryption keys in the cloud. License Manager manages software licenses, ACM manages SSL/TLS certificates, and Directory Service manages user directories. CloudHSM is specifically designed for encryption key management.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS CloudHSM?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudhsm/latest/userguide/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs an application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances. The application uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for sending messages.  
  
Which AWS service or feature grants the application permission to access the required AWS services?
questions.explanation:
IAM roles attached to Amazon EC2 instances provide the applications with temporary credentials and the permissions specified in the role’s policies, allowing them to call required AWS services such as Amazon SNS. An EC2 instance uses an instance profile to make the role credentials available to its applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use an IAM role to grant permissions to applications running on Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs an application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances. The application uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for sending messages.  
  
Which AWS service or feature grants the application permission to access the required AWS services?
questions.explanation:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk is a managed platform-as-a-service designed for non-containerized applications. It automatically handles capacity provisioning, load balancing, auto-scaling, and application health monitoring for Java, Python, Node.js, and other supported runtimes. ECS and EKS require container orchestration; Lambda is serverless and event-driven, not suitable for traditional web applications.

**Learn more:** [AWS Elastic Beanstalk](https://aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/) · [What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to store and retrieve files in Amazon S3 from its existing on-premises applications by using industry-standard file system protocols.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 File Gateway exposes Amazon S3 objects through industry-standard NFS and SMB file protocols, allowing existing on-premises applications to store and retrieve them as files.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company’s website is undergoing DDoS attacks.  
  
Which AWS service can help safeguard the company website from these attacks?
questions.explanation:
AWS Shield is a managed DDoS-protection service that helps protect AWS applications and resources against distributed denial-of-service attacks.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shield Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/shield/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to organize its users so that the company can grant permissions to the users as a group.  
  
Which AWS service or tool can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) enables organizing users into groups and assigning permissions to those groups. This simplifies access control at scale. Security groups manage network access to resources, Resource groups organize AWS resources by attributes, and Security Hub provides security posture dashboards.\
\
**Learn more:** [IAM user groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_groups.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to organize its users so that the company can grant permissions to the users as a group.  
  
Which AWS service or tool can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances provide a discount compared with On-Demand pricing in exchange for a one-year or three-year commitment to a specified EC2 instance configuration. They are appropriate for predictable, continuous one-year usage. Spot Instances are interruptible, while Dedicated Hosts are intended for dedicated-hardware and eligible license-use requirements.

**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html) · [Reserved Instances for Amazon EC2 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_us/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/normalization-factor-for-dedicated-ec2-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate to AWS and wants to use the same security software it uses on premises. The security software vendor provides its security software as a service on AWS.  
  
Where can the company buy the security solution?
questions.explanation:
AWS Marketplace is a curated catalog for finding, buying, deploying, and managing third-party software, including software-as-a-service offerings and security solutions.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Marketplace?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/what-is-marketplace.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A user needs to securely automate the management and rotation of credentials shared by applications, while minimizing time spent on administrative tasks.  
  
Which AWS service or feature can accomplish this?
questions.explanation:
AWS Secrets Manager securely stores application credentials and can automatically rotate secrets on a schedule, reducing manual credential-management work. AWS documents that Secrets Manager supports automatic secret rotation.\
\
**Learn more:** [Rotation schedules - AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_schedule.html) · [AWS Secrets Manager best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, for which of the following is the customer responsible for applying the most recent security updates and patches?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 gives the customer responsibility for the guest operating system, installed applications, and their security updates and patches. AWS manages the underlying cloud infrastructure. Amazon S3 and Amazon DynamoDB are more abstracted managed services, and Amazon RDS is a managed database service.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared responsibility — AWS Well-Architected Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature enables users to create new AWS accounts, group multiple accounts to organize workflows, and apply policies to account groups?
questions.explanation:
AWS Organizations centrally manages multiple AWS accounts. It supports creating accounts, grouping them into organizational units (OUs), and applying governance policies to those OUs or accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Organizations?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is launching a mobile app in the AWS Cloud. The company wants the app's users to sign in through social media identity providers (IdPs).  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Cognito is a fully managed identity service that enables user authentication and federation with social identity providers (Facebook, Google, Amazon, Apple) and enterprise providers (SAML, OpenID Connect). This is the standard AWS service for mobile and web applications requiring social sign-in. Lambda is compute, Secrets Manager stores credentials, and CloudFront is content distribution—none handle identity federation.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using social identity providers with a user pool](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-social-idp.html) · [Amazon Cognito](https://aws.amazon.com/cognito/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A user needs to rapidly deploy a nonrelational database on AWS. The user does not want to manage the underlying hardware or database software.  
  
Which AWS service can accomplish this?
questions.explanation:
Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed, serverless NoSQL database service. AWS manages the hardware provisioning, setup, configuration, maintenance, and scaling, so users do not manage the underlying infrastructure or database software.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon DynamoDB?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud characteristic enables users to eliminate underutilized CPU capacity?
questions.explanation:
Elasticity enables compute capacity to scale out when demand increases and scale in when demand falls, avoiding over- and under-provisioned resources. AWS documents that elastic scaling dynamically matches capacity to demand.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework: Scale your compute resources dynamically](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/perf_compute_hardware_scale_compute_resources_dynamically.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Using AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to grant access only to the resources required to perform a task is a concept known as:
questions.explanation:
The principle of least privilege grants only the minimum permissions and resource access needed to complete a specific task.\
\
**Learn more:** [Grant least privilege access - AWS Well-Architected](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/sec_permissions_least_privileges.html) · [Security best practices in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which of the following is a responsibility of the customer?

options.text: Shred disk drives before they leave a data center.
Prevent customers from gathering packets or collecting traffic at the hypervisor level.
Patch the guest operating system with the latest security patches.
Maintain security systems that provide physical monitoring of data centers.

questions.explanation:
Patching the guest operating system is a customer responsibility for unmanaged compute resources such as EC2 instances, since the customer controls the OS layer. AWS is responsible for physical media destruction, preventing packet sniffing at the hypervisor level, and physical data center security, all of which fall under security \"of\" the cloud.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which cloud concept does AWS Compute Optimizer demonstrate?
questions.explanation:
AWS Compute Optimizer provides recommendations for AWS resources based on utilization data to help select appropriately sized resource configurations. This practice is rightsizing.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Compute Optimizer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/what-is-compute-optimizer.html) · [AWS Compute Optimizer](https://aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A user needs to let applications running on an Amazon EC2 instance call other AWS services. The granted access must be secure.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should be used?
questions.explanation:
An IAM role attached to an Amazon EC2 instance supplies applications with temporary credentials and the permissions defined by its IAM policies, avoiding the storage and management of long-term credentials on the instance. AWS documents this as the mechanism for granting applications on EC2 access to other AWS services.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use an IAM role to grant permissions to applications running on Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature allows a company to have its own logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation:
Amazon VPC lets a customer provision a logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud where they define their own virtual network, IP address range, subnets, and routing. AWS VPN provides connectivity into a network rather than isolation itself, and Availability Zones and Regions are physical infrastructure groupings, not customer-defined isolated networks.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon VPC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/what-is-amazon-vpc.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS network services or features allow CIDR block notation when providing an IP address range? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Both security groups (A) and network access control lists (C) use CIDR block notation to define IP address ranges for network rules. Security groups define ingress and egress rules at the instance level, while NACLs operate at the subnet level. AMI, AWS Budgets, and EBS do not use CIDR notation.\
\
**Learn more:** [Control traffic with security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-security-groups.html) · [Control subnet traffic with network ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which options are AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspectives? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
The six AWS Cloud Adoption Framework perspectives are Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security, and Operations. Security and Business are two of these six core perspectives. Cloud fluency, Change acceleration, and Architecture are not official CAF perspectives.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Adoption Framework](https://aws.amazon.com/cloud-adoption-framework/) · [AWS CAF: Business Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-business-perspective/aws-caf-business-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company requires fully managed, highly reliable, scalable file storage that can be accessed through the Server Message Block (SMB) protocol.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?

options.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

questions.explanation:
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server provides fully managed Windows file storage with native SMB support. It supports scalable capacity and Multi-AZ deployments for high availability and failover.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is FSx for Windows File Server?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html) · [Availability and durability: Single-AZ and Multi-AZ file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/high-availability-multiAZ.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service should a company use to organize, characterize, and search large numbers of images?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Rekognition is an AI-powered image recognition and analysis service that can automatically organize, characterize, and search large image collections. Amazon Transcribe (A) handles speech-to-text conversion, Aurora (C) is a relational database, and QuickSight (D) is for business intelligence—none provide image analysis capabilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Rekognition?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/what-is.html) · [Amazon Rekognition Image Features](https://aws.amazon.com/rekognition/image-features/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate its on-premises NFS workload to AWS.  
  
Which AWS Storage Gateway type should the company use to fulfill this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 File Gateway provides on-premises applications with NFS file-share access while storing the files as objects in Amazon S3. It supports NFS versions 3 and 4.1, making it the appropriate gateway type for an NFS workload.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html) · [CreateNFSFileShare - AWS Storage Gateway API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/APIReference/API_CreateNFSFileShare.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate its application from on premises to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to gather usage and configuration data for the application components.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Application Discovery Service collects configuration, usage, and performance data from on-premises servers and applications, helping a company plan and correctly size a migration to AWS. AWS DMS migrates databases, AWS Transfer Family moves files over SFTP/FTPS/FTP, and Global Accelerator improves network performance for global end users, none of which gather infrastructure discovery data.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Application Discovery Service](https://aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which benefit is always free of charge with AWS, regardless of a user’s AWS Support plan?
questions.explanation:
AWS Developer Forums (now part of AWS re:Post) are available to all customers at no cost regardless of Support plan tier. AWS Developer Support, programmatic case management, and a Technical Account Manager are benefits reserved for paid Support plans (Developer/Business and above, with a TAM specifically requiring Enterprise support).\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Support plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/aws-support-plans.html) · [Compare AWS Support plans](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which benefit is always free of charge with AWS, regardless of a user’s AWS Support plan?

options.text: Create a read replica of the DB instance.
Create a template of the DB instance by using AWS CloudFormation.
Take frequent snapshots of the DB instance. Store the snapshots in Amazon S3.
Modify the DB instance to be a Multi-AZ deployment.

questions.explanation:
An Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment maintains a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone and automatically fails over to it during an infrastructure outage. Typical failover time is 60–120 seconds, satisfying a recovery-time objective of less than five minutes.

**Learn more:** [Failing over a Multi-AZ DB instance for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html) · [Multi-AZ DB instance deployments for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company plans to make an upfront commitment to keep using its production Amazon EC2 instances in return for a lower overall cost.  
  
Which pricing options satisfy these requirements at the **LOWEST** cost? *(Choose two.)*
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances and Savings Plans reduce Amazon EC2 costs in exchange for a one- or three-year commitment. Reserved Instances commit to a consistent instance configuration, while Savings Plans commit to a consistent hourly usage amount. Both suit steady, continued production usage and provide discounted pricing compared with On-Demand pricing.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html) · [What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is building a new application on AWS. The company needs the application to remain available if an individual application component fails.  
  
Which design principle should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Loose coupling architecture makes components independent so that failure or changes in one component do not cascade to others, ensuring application availability despite individual failures. Disposable resources enable easy replacement but don't prevent failure impact, automation reduces manual work, and rightsizing optimizes resource costs.\
\
**Learn more:** [REL04-BP02 Implement loosely coupled dependencies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/rel_prevent_interaction_failure_loosely_coupled_system.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must migrate a PostgreSQL database from on premises to Amazon RDS.  
  
Which AWS service or tool should the company use to fulfill this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) supports migrating data from an on-premises PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL instance.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using a PostgreSQL database as an AWS DMS source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.PostgreSQL.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which Amazon EC2 pricing model is **MOST** cost-efficient for an uninterruptible workload that runs for 24 hours once each year?
questions.explanation:
On-Demand Instances are billed only for the capacity used and have no long-term commitment. A workload that runs only 24 hours per year would not use enough capacity to justify a Reserved Instance commitment, while Spot Instances can be interrupted by Amazon EC2 and therefore do not meet the uninterrupted-workload requirement.\
\
**Learn more:** [How Spot Instances work - Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-spot-instances-work.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A global company plans to migrate its third-party applications to the AWS Cloud. The company requires assistance from a global team of experts to complete the migration more quickly and reliably, in line with AWS internal best practices.  
  
Which AWS service or resource meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Professional Services provides a global team of AWS experts that helps organizations design, build, migrate, and manage AWS workloads. Its migration offerings use proven methodologies and AWS best practices to accelerate projects and reduce delivery risk.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Professional Services](https://aws.amazon.com/professional-services/) · [AWS Professional Services - Public Sector Cloud Transformation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/public-sector-cloud-transformation/aws-professional-services.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud design principle is a company using when the company implements AWS CloudTrail?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records API calls and account activity, giving full visibility into who did what and when — directly implementing the \"activate traceability\" design principle of the Operational Excellence pillar. Serverless architectures, infrastructure/operations as code, and global deployment relate to other design principles and are not what CloudTrail itself provides.\
\
**Learn more:** [Design principles - Operational Excellence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/oe-design-principles.html) · [Operational Excellence Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/operational-excellence-pillar/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which of the following are capabilities of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) security perspective? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS CAF’s Security perspective includes the capabilities **incident response**, for responding to and mitigating security incidents, and **infrastructure protection**, for protecting systems and services from unauthorized access and vulnerabilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Adoption Framework: Security Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-security-perspective/aws-caf-security-perspective.html) · [Recommended security controls for implementing AWS CAF security capabilities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/security-controls-by-caf-capability/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS Support plan provides the full set of AWS Trusted Advisor checks at the LOWEST cost?
questions.explanation:
AWS Business Support is the lowest-cost plan providing access to the full set of AWS Trusted Advisor checks. Developer Support only includes limited Trusted Advisor checks, while Enterprise plans cost significantly more. Business Support offers the best value for comprehensive security and performance recommendations.\
\
**Learn more:** [Compare AWS Support Plans](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/) · [AWS Support Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/aws-support-plans.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
