questions.question: Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar concerns a system’s ability to recover from infrastructure or service disruptions and dynamically obtain computing resources to meet demand?
questions.explanation:
The Reliability pillar covers resiliency: recovering from infrastructure or service disruptions and dynamically acquiring computing resources to meet demand.\
\
**Learn more:** [Resiliency, and the components of reliability — AWS Well-Architected Reliability Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/resiliency-and-the-components-of-reliability.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to implement detailed tracking of its cloud costs by department and project.  
  
Which AWS feature or service should the company use?
questions.explanation:
Cost allocation tags enable granular cost tracking by custom dimensions like department and project, allowing detailed analysis of spending patterns. Consolidated billing combines accounts but doesn't track costs by department, AWS Marketplace is for third-party software purchases, and AWS Budgets sets alerts but doesn't provide detailed tracking by categories.\
\
**Learn more:** [Organizing and tracking costs using AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can create a private network connection from on premises to the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation:
AWS Direct Connect provides a private, dedicated network connection from on-premises infrastructure to AWS that does not route traffic over the public internet. AWS Config manages configuration compliance; VPC is the AWS network but does not connect to on-premises networks; Route 53 is a DNS service.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company uses Amazon S3 to store records that may contain personally identifiable information (PII). The company needs a solution that monitors all S3 buckets for PII and immediately alerts staff to vulnerabilities.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Macie monitors Amazon S3 for security and access-control issues and produces policy findings when an event reduces a bucket’s security or privacy. It can also inspect S3 objects for sensitive data, including PII, and generate sensitive-data findings for notification and remediation.\
\
**Learn more:** [Monitoring data security and privacy with Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/monitoring-s3.html) · [Types of Macie findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-types.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool enables users to visualize, understand, and manage spending and usage over time?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cost Explorer provides cost and usage visualizations, historical trend analysis, filtering, and forecasting to help users understand and manage AWS spending over time.\
\
**Learn more:** [Analyzing your costs and usage with AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to run a NoSQL database on Amazon EC2 instances.  
  
Which task is AWS responsible for in this scenario?

options.text: Update the guest operating system of the EC2 instances.
Maintain high availability at the database layer.
Patch the physical infrastructure that hosts the EC2 instances.

questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model for Amazon EC2, AWS is responsible for security *of* the cloud, including the physical infrastructure that hosts EC2 instances. The customer is responsible for the guest operating system, database-layer availability, and security-group configuration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared responsibility - Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has a managed IAM policy that does not provide the permissions users need to complete required tasks.  
  
How can this issue be resolved?

options.text: Use a third-party web application firewall (WAF) managed rule from the AWS Marketplace.
Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create a customer-managed key.

questions.explanation:
A custom customer-managed IAM policy lets an organization define and attach the specific permissions required by its users. AWS-managed policies cannot be modified to add missing permissions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Define custom IAM permissions with customer managed policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_create.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to use AWS. The company has stringent requirements about low-latency access to on-premises systems and data residency.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to design a solution that meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Outposts brings AWS infrastructure and services on-premises, enabling low-latency access to on-premises systems and ensuring data residency compliance by keeping data in the customer's data center. Wavelength provides 5G edge computing, Transit Gateway connects networks, and Ground Station serves satellite communication—none address on-premises data residency requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/network-userguide/what-is-outposts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which options are AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) people perspective capabilities? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Organizational alignment and Organization design are core People perspective capabilities in the AWS CAF, focusing on workforce structure, culture transformation, and organizational readiness for cloud adoption. Portfolio management (Business), Risk management (Governance), and Modern application development (Platform) belong to different perspectives.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF Organizational alignment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-people-perspective/organizational-alignment.html) · [AWS CAF Organization design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-people-perspective/organization-design.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company requires Amazon EC2 instances for a workload that tolerates interruptions.  
  
Which EC2 instance purchasing option fulfills this requirement while providing the **LARGEST** discount compared with On-Demand prices?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances provide interruptible spare EC2 capacity at discounts of up to 90% compared with On-Demand prices. They are intended for flexible, fault-tolerant workloads that can handle EC2 reclaiming capacity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Best practices for Amazon EC2 Spot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html) · [Choosing a purchasing option for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/decision-guides/latest/ec2-purchasing-options-aws-how-to-choose/ec2-purchasing-options-aws-how-to-choose.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A solutions architect must maintain a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances so that any impaired instances are replaced by new instances.  
  
Which AWS service should the solutions architect use?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling uses EC2 health checks to monitor instances in an Auto Scaling group. It treats impaired instances as unhealthy and automatically replaces them to preserve the group’s desired capacity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Health checks for instances in an Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-health-checks.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A solutions architect must maintain a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances so that any impaired instances are replaced by new instances.  
  
Which AWS service should the solutions architect use?

options.text: Encrypt data and maintain data integrity.
Patch the Amazon RDS operating system.
Maintain identity and access management controls.

questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, the customer is responsible for security "in" the cloud, which includes encrypting data and maintaining data integrity, as well as managing identity and access management controls. AWS handles security "of" the cloud, including securing the virtualization layer, patching the underlying OS of managed services like RDS, and securing Availability Zones.

**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/) · [Shared responsibility - Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs a fully managed Windows file server for its Windows-based applications.  
  
Which AWS service satisfies this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server provides fully managed file storage built on Windows Server and is optimized for Windows-based applications and workloads.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is FSx for Windows File Server?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to automatically add and remove Amazon EC2 instances so that the instances dynamically adapt to changing workloads.  
  
Which service or feature meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling automatically increases or decreases the number of EC2 instances as demand changes, allowing capacity to dynamically match workload requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [Tutorial: Set up a scaled and load-balanced application](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/tutorial-ec2-auto-scaling-load-balancer.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to safeguard its AWS Cloud information, systems, and assets while carrying out risk assessment and mitigation activities.  
  
Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar supports these objectives?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Well-Architected Framework Security pillar covers protecting information, systems, and assets while using risk assessments and mitigation strategies to deliver business value.\
\
**Learn more:** [The pillars of the Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/migration-lens/well-architected-framework-pillars.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company has multiple AWS accounts. The company needs to receive a consolidated bill from AWS and must centrally manage security and compliance.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Organizations is the service for managing multiple AWS accounts with consolidated billing and centralized security/compliance controls. It provides Service Control Policies (SCPs) for central governance and a single consolidated bill across all member accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Organizations?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_introduction.html) · [Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which design principle is related to the reliability pillar according to the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
questions.explanation:
Testing recovery procedures is one of the design principles listed under the Reliability pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework, alongside automatically recovering from failure and scaling horizontally. \"Experiment more often\" is a general Well-Architected design principle, \"go global in minutes\" belongs to the Performance Efficiency pillar, and \"analyze and attribute expenditure\" belongs to the Cost Optimization pillar.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework - Reliability Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/design-principles.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to acquire resources when the resources are necessary. The company also needs the ability to release those resources when the resources are no longer necessary.  
  
Which architecture concept of the AWS Cloud meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Elasticity is the AWS architecture concept that lets a company automatically acquire resources as demand increases and release them when they are no longer needed, so it only pays for what it uses. Availability, reliability, and durability describe how consistently accessible or how well data is preserved, not the ability to scale resources up and down on demand.\
\
**Learn more:** [Elasticity - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://wa.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2020-07-02T19-33-23/wat.concept.elasticity.en.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) capability belongs to the business perspective?
questions.explanation:
Data science falls under the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework Business perspective, which focuses on business-level capabilities such as data science, digital innovation, and strategy. Program and project management belongs to the Operations perspective, observability aligns with Platform, and change management falls under Operations.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF Business Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-business-perspective/aws-caf-business-perspective.html) · [Business perspective overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/business-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) capability belongs to the business perspective?

options.text: Granting the broadest permissions to all IAM roles
Running application code with AWS Cloud
Enabling multi-factor authentication (MFA) with Amazon Cognito
Using AWS Trusted Advisor security checks

questions.explanation:
Enabling multi-factor authentication (MFA) with Amazon Cognito adds an extra layer of security for user authentication. AWS Trusted Advisor security checks identify configuration gaps and compliance risks. Both are direct security improvements. AWS Artifact is for compliance documentation, not security hardening; granting broad permissions and simply running code on AWS do not improve security.

**Learn more:** [Adding MFA to a User Pool (Amazon Cognito)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/managing-security.html) · [AWS Trusted Advisor Security Checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/security-checks.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company must run an experimental workload continuously on an Amazon EC2 instance and stop the instance after 12 hours.  
  
Which instance purchasing option meets this requirement in the MOST cost-effective way?
questions.explanation:
On-Demand Instances are appropriate for short-term workloads that cannot be interrupted: the customer controls when the instance stops and pays only while it runs. Spot Instances can be reclaimed by Amazon EC2, while Reserved Instances require a one- or three-year commitment.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchasing On-Demand Instances for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-on-demand-instances.html) · [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to set up a secure network connection from on premises to the AWS Cloud within 1 week.  
  
Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Site-to-Site VPN is the appropriate solution for rapid connectivity within one week. It uses IPSec tunnels and can be configured quickly without physical infrastructure deployment. AWS Direct Connect requires weeks or months of provisioning involving third-party carriers. Amazon VPC is a foundational service but not the connection mechanism, and edge locations are for content delivery.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: What does agility mean in AWS Cloud computing? (Choose two.)

options.text: The speed at which AWS resources are implemented
The speed at which AWS creates new AWS Regions
The low cost of entry into cloud computing

questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud agility means that resources and technology services can be provisioned and implemented quickly, allowing organizations to experiment and test new ideas rapidly. Eliminating excess capacity relates to elasticity, while low entry cost relates to cloud cost savings.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html) · [What is Cloud Computing?](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is-cloud-computing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework focuses on the ability to recover automatically from service interruptions?
questions.explanation:
Reliability is the AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar that focuses on a system's ability to automatically recover from service interruptions and continue operating. Security (A) protects against unauthorized access, performance efficiency (B) optimizes resource utilization, and operational excellence (C) enhances operations management—none address automatic recovery from failures.\
\
**Learn more:** [Reliability Pillar - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/welcome.html) · [Design principles - Reliability Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/design-principles.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs an application on AWS that performs batch jobs. The application is fault-tolerant and can handle interruptions. The company wants to optimize the cost to run the application.  
  
Which AWS offering will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 Spot Instances let you use spare EC2 capacity at up to a 90% discount compared to On-Demand prices, which is ideal for fault-tolerant, interruption-tolerant batch workloads. Amazon Macie and Neptune are unrelated services (security/data classification and graph database, respectively), and On-Demand instances cost more than Spot for this use case.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 Spot Instances](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/spot/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to host an application in a specific geographic area to comply with regulations.  
  
Which feature of the AWS global infrastructure will help the company meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
The AWS global footprint encompasses multiple AWS Regions distributed worldwide, allowing organizations to select and host applications in specific geographic areas for data residency and compliance requirements. Each Region is geographically isolated and independently operated.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Global Infrastructure – Regions & AZs](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/regions_az/) · [Global infrastructure overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/global-infrastructure.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs the ability to acquire resources when the resources are needed. The company also needs the ability to release the resources when the resources are no longer needed.  
  
Which AWS concept represents the company's goals?
questions.explanation:
Elasticity is the cloud principle of acquiring resources on-demand and releasing them when no longer needed, often automatically based on workload. Scalability refers to the ability to handle increased load, sustainability relates to environmental impact, and operational excellence is a pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework.\
\
**Learn more:** [Elasticity - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://wa.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2020-07-02T19-33-23/wat.concept.elasticity.en.html) · [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which task is the responsibility of AWS, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Apply guest operating system patches to Amazon EC2 instances.
Provide monitoring of human resources information management (HRIM) systems.
Perform automated backups of Amazon RDS instances.
Optimize the costs of running AWS services.

questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, AWS manages the operation, maintenance, and automated backup of the underlying infrastructure for managed services such as Amazon RDS. Patching guest operating systems on EC2, monitoring internal HR systems, and optimizing a customer's own service costs are all customer responsibilities, not AWS's.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to strengthen its security posture by reviewing user activity made through API calls.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records AWS API calls and associated audit details, including the identity of the user or role, request time, source IP address, request parameters, and response elements. This enables review of user activity performed through API calls.\
\
**Learn more:** [Welcome - AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to deploy an application that stores data in a relational database. The company wants database tasks, such as automated backups and database snapshots, to be managed by AWS.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service that automatically handles operational tasks such as automated backups, database snapshots, patching, and failover, removing that burden from the customer. Amazon EBS snapshots back up block storage volumes rather than managing a relational database engine, and DocumentDB and S3 are not relational database services.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon RDS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to provision uninterruptible Amazon EC2 instances, when needed, and pay for compute capacity by the second.  
  
Which EC2 instance purchasing option will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
On-Demand Instances provide uninterruptible compute capacity with no long-term commitments and billing by the second. Unlike Spot Instances (which can be interrupted), Reserved Instances (which require commitments), or Dedicated Instances (which are for compliance), On-Demand meets these requirements exactly.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchasing On-Demand Instances for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-on-demand-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs a firewall that will control network connections to and from a single Amazon EC2 instance. This firewall will not control network connections to and from other instances that are in the same subnet.  
  
Which AWS service or feature can the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
A security group operates at the instance level and controls inbound and outbound traffic for a single EC2 instance independently from other instances. Network ACLs operate at the subnet level affecting all instances, AWS WAF protects web applications, and route tables control traffic routing, not per-instance firewalling.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-security-groups.html) · [Control traffic with security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-security-groups.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS storage type is ephemeral and deleted when an Amazon EC2 instance is stopped or terminated?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 instance store is temporary block storage whose data exists only for the lifetime of its associated instance. AWS erases its data when the instance is stopped or terminated.\
\
**Learn more:** [Data persistence for Amazon EC2 instance store volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to design its cloud architecture so that it can support development innovations, and continuously improve processes and procedures.  
  
This is an example of which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
questions.explanation:
Operational excellence pillar emphasizes continuous improvement, innovation in processes, and enabling teams to deliver business value through optimization. Security focuses on data protection, Performance efficiency on resource utilization, and Reliability on system availability—none directly address development innovation and continuous process improvement.\
\
**Learn more:** [Operational excellence - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/operational-excellence.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to deploy an application in multiple Availability Zones in a single AWS Region.  
  
Which benefit will this deployment provide to the company?

options.text: Improved connection performance for global customers
Resilient architecture and a highly available solution
Ability to shut down an Availability Zone during periods of low demand

questions.explanation:
Deploying across multiple Availability Zones within a single region provides high availability and fault tolerance. If one AZ experiences an outage, the application continues running in other AZs, creating a resilient architecture that minimizes downtime and ensures business continuity.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Regions and Availability Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-infrastructure/latest/regions/aws-regions-availability-zones.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS value proposition describes a user’s ability to scale infrastructure according to demand?
questions.explanation:
Resource elasticity is the ability to add or remove infrastructure resources as demand changes, enabling capacity to scale up or down as needed.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html) · [AWS Cloud Economics](https://aws.amazon.com/economics/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS value proposition describes a user’s ability to scale infrastructure according to demand?

options.text: Installation of the computer language runtime.
Providing AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) access to the Lambda service.

questions.explanation:
Under AWS's shared responsibility model, Lambda is a managed service where AWS handles the underlying infrastructure, operating system, and runtime. The customer is responsible for writing the business logic code (C) and configuring IAM permissions to grant Lambda access (E). AWS manages the infrastructure and runtime, so options A, B, and D are AWS responsibilities.

**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/) · [AWS Lambda Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which action can help improve security in the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Enable programmatic access for all IAM users.
Use IAM users instead of IAM roles to delegate permissions.
Rotate access keys on a reoccurring basis.
Use inline policies instead of customer managed policies.

questions.explanation:
Regularly rotating access keys limits the time that a compromised credential remains usable and is an AWS IAM security best practice.\
\
**Learn more:** [IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which action can help improve security in the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Contact the AWS Support team, and ask the team to sell the Standard RIs
Sell the Standard RIs on the Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance Marketplace
Sell the Standard RIs as a third-party seller on the AWS Marketplace
Convert the Standard RIs to Savings Plans

questions.explanation:
The EC2 Reserved Instance Marketplace allows customers to sell unused Standard RIs to other AWS customers. This is the official mechanism for monetizing or repurposing RIs when workload needs change, offering more flexibility than contacting support or converting to Savings Plans.

**Learn more:** [Sell Reserved Instances in the Reserved Instance Marketplace](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ri-market-general.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: What is the purpose of using an internet gateway in a VPC?

options.text: To create a VPN connection to the VPC
To allow communication between the VPC and the internet
To impose bandwidth constraints on internet traffic
To load balance traffic from the internet across Amazon EC2 instances

questions.explanation:
An internet gateway enables communication between a VPC and the internet by serving as the route-table target for internet-routable traffic. It supports inbound and outbound internet connectivity for appropriately addressed and routed resources. [AWS: Enable internet access for a VPC using an internet gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS: Enable internet access for a VPC using an internet gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following are benefits of the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)

options.text: Trade variable expenses for capital expenses

questions.explanation:
AWS provides high economies of scale by aggregating demand across many customers, which can reduce variable costs. Its global infrastructure also enables customers to deploy applications in multiple regions around the world within minutes.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials training](https://aws.amazon.com/training/learn-about/cloud-practitioner/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which of the following are benefits of the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)

options.text: S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

questions.explanation:
S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves objects between access tiers (frequent, infrequent, and archive) based on changing access patterns without additional cost. This is ideal when access patterns are unpredictable or mixed—such as data accessed sometimes daily and sometimes yearly. The other options require knowing access patterns in advance.

**Learn more:** [Understanding Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html) · [How S3 Intelligent-Tiering works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which programming languages does AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) currently support? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) provides first-class support for Python and TypeScript among the options listed. CDK also supports JavaScript, Java, C#, and Go, but does not support Swift, Ruby, or PHP for infrastructure-as-code definitions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Supported programming languages for the AWS CDK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/languages.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud deployment model includes AWS Outposts as part of an application's deployment infrastructure?
questions.explanation:
AWS Outposts brings AWS infrastructure and services to on-premises locations while integrating with an AWS Region, providing a hybrid cloud environment. [AWS Outposts documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html)\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html) · [AWS hybrid cloud solutions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/hybrid-cloud-with-aws/aws-hybrid-cloud-solutions.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has deployed several public applications behind Application Load Balancers. The company wants to improve the performance of the applications.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Global Accelerator improves application performance for globally distributed users by routing traffic through AWS's optimized global network, reducing latency and improving availability. It's particularly effective for applications behind load balancers serving geographically dispersed audiences.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: In the AWS Cloud, what does elasticity refer to? (Choose two.)

options.text: How quickly an Amazon EC2 instance can be restarted
The ability to rightsize resources as demand shifts
The maximum amount of RAM an Amazon EC2 instance can use
How easily resources can be procured when they are needed

questions.explanation:
Elasticity is the ability to obtain and release cloud resources in response to demand. It enables resources to be procured when needed and adjusted to an appropriate size as demand changes.\
\
**Learn more:** [Elastic - Reactive Systems on AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/reactive-systems-on-aws/elastic.html) · [Support dynamic scaling for static .NET Framework apps](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/optimize-costs-microsoft-workloads/net-static.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to run an application on Amazon EC2 instances without interruption.  
  
Which EC2 instance purchasing option will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation:
Because the application must run continuously without being interrupted, Spot Instances are ruled out since AWS can reclaim that capacity at any time. Standard Reserved Instances provide a capacity reservation and up to roughly 72% discount over On-Demand pricing for steady-state, always-on workloads, making them the most cost-effective purchasing option for uninterrupted usage. Convertible Reserved Instances allow attribute changes but yield a smaller discount than Standard Reserved Instances.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/reserved-instances/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to build, train, and deploy machine learning (ML) models.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon SageMaker is a fully managed machine learning service providing end-to-end tools for building, training, and deploying ML models at scale. Amazon Personalize (A) and Amazon Comprehend (B) are specialized AI services for specific use cases rather than general ML development, and Amazon Forecast (C) is optimized for time-series forecasting only.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon SageMaker AI](https://aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/) · [Train a Model with Amazon SageMaker](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/how-it-works-training.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following is a capability in the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) Platform perspective?
questions.explanation:
AWS CAF lists Data architecture as a Platform perspective capability. It covers designing and evolving a fit-for-purpose data and analytics architecture.\
\
**Learn more:** [Data architecture - AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/aws-caf-platform-perspective/data-arch.html) · [Platform perspective: infrastructure and applications - AWS CAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/platform-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to provide customer service by using voice calls and web chat features.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Connect is a fully managed cloud contact center service that provides voice calling and web chat capabilities for customer service operations. Aurora is a relational database, WorkSpaces provides virtual desktops, and Organizations manages AWS account relationships. Connect is specifically built for customer service interaction channels.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/adminguide/what-is-amazon-connect.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to provide customer service by using voice calls and web chat features.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Personal Health Dashboard provides account-specific health events and affected-resource information, while AWS Service Health Dashboard displays public service events and regional service availability. These provide visibility into both events affecting the company’s AWS environment and the general operational status of AWS services and infrastructure.

**Learn more:** [AWS Health Dashboard – Service health](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/aws-health-dashboard-status.html) · [Concepts for AWS Health](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/aws-health-concepts-and-terms.html)

How does the AWS Cloud provide a lower total cost of ownership (TCO) for computing resources than on-premises data centers? (Choose two.)

options.text: AWS replaces upfront capital expenditures with pay-as-you-go costs.
AWS is designed for high availability, which eliminates user downtime.
AWS eliminates the need for on-premises IT staff.
AWS uses economies of scale to continually reduce prices.
AWS offers a single pricing model for Amazon EC2 instances.

questions.explanation:
AWS lets organizations exchange large fixed capital expenses for variable, consumption-based costs, paying only for the resources they use. AWS’s large-scale aggregation of customer demand also produces economies of scale that translate to lower pay-as-you-go prices.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing — Overview of Amazon Web Services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html) · [AWS Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/pricing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: A company intends to deploy containers on AWS. The company requires full control over the compute resources that host those containers. Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 provides direct control of the underlying instances, including instance selection, configuration, and maintenance. AWS identifies EC2 instances as the option for maximum control of underlying container infrastructure, whereas Fargate is serverless and ECS/EKS are container orchestration services that can use different compute options.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon ECS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to run its application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs to keep the application on-premises to meet a compliance requirement.  
  
Which AWS offering will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Outposts extends AWS infrastructure and services to on-premises data centers, enabling compliance with data residency or latency requirements while maintaining AWS management and control. It allows running EC2 instances and other AWS services locally while managing them through the AWS console.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which group shares responsibility with AWS for security and compliance of AWS accounts and resources?
questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, AWS manages security \"of\" the cloud while customers manage security \"in\" the cloud, meaning customers share responsibility for securing their own accounts, data, and configurations. Third-party vendors, reseller partners, and internet providers are not parties to this AWS-customer security partnership.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to use an AWS networking solution that can act as a centralized gateway between multiple VPCs and on-premises networks.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Transit Gateway acts as a central hub connecting multiple VPCs and on-premises networks through a hub-and-spoke architecture. Gateway VPC endpoints (A) provide private access to specific services, Direct Connect (B) establishes dedicated network connections, and PrivateLink (D) enables private service access across accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Transit Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to use an AWS networking solution that can act as a centralized gateway between multiple VPCs and on-premises networks.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances provide discounted pricing in exchange for a one- or three-year commitment to a defined EC2 instance configuration, making them suitable for stable, predictable, continuously running workloads. Spot capacity can be reclaimed by Amazon EC2 and is therefore unsuitable when uninterrupted availability is required.

**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html) · [Reserved Instances for Amazon EC2 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/normalization-factor-for-dedicated-ec2-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is migrating an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. It needs to move 50 petabytes of file storage data to AWS with the lowest possible operational overhead.  
  
Which AWS service or resource should the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Snowmobile is an AWS-managed, truck-based data-transfer service for moving very large datasets—up to 100 PB per Snowmobile—offline to AWS. It is intended for multi-petabyte and exabyte-scale migrations and data-center shutdowns, minimizing the operational work of coordinating many smaller transfer devices.\
\
**Learn more:** [Big Data Analytics Options on AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/big-data-analytics-options/amazon-machine-learning.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which feature of Amazon RDS provides the ability to automatically create a primary database instance and to synchronously replicate data to an instance in another Availability Zone?
questions.explanation:
Multi-AZ deployment automatically creates a primary database instance and a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone. This provides high availability and automatic failover. Read replicas are asynchronous and used for scaling read operations, not failover.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon RDS Multi-AZ Deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to migrate all of its on-premises infrastructure to the AWS Cloud. Before migration, the company wants estimate of costs for running its as-is infrastructure.  
  
Which AWS service or principle should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Pricing Calculator lets customers model their existing on-premises infrastructure and estimate the cost of running equivalent workloads on AWS before migrating. The Well-Architected Framework and shared responsibility model are guidance/security concepts, not cost-estimation tools, and the AWS CAF focuses on organizational readiness for cloud adoption rather than cost estimation.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Pricing Calculator](https://calculator.aws/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs stateless network filtering for its VPC.  
  
Which AWS service, tool, or feature will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Network Access Control Lists (NACLs) provide stateless filtering at the subnet level, requiring explicit allow rules for both inbound and outbound traffic. Security groups (B) are stateful and maintain connection state automatically, PrivateLink (A) enables private service access, and WAF (D) protects web applications from attacks.\
\
**Learn more:** [Control subnet traffic with network access control lists](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which responsibility is AWS responsible for when a company runs its databases on Amazon EC2 instances?
questions.explanation:
Under the shared responsibility model, once a database runs on self-managed EC2 instances, the customer owns every guest-level task — applying OS patches, patching the database software, and taking backups — while AWS's role is limited to the underlying infrastructure, including building and publishing the base Amazon Machine Images that already have an operating system installed. Because AWS performs that initial OS installation when it creates its AMIs, operating system installation (at the AMI level) is the one item in this list that falls to AWS rather than the customer.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS shared responsibility model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A systems administrator wants to monitor the CPU utilization of a company's Amazon EC2 instances.  
  
Which AWS service can provide this information?
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudWatch collects and visualizes metrics including CPU utilization for EC2 instances in real-time. AWS Config tracks configuration changes, Trusted Advisor provides optimization recommendations, and CloudTrail logs API activities—none provide performance metrics like CPU utilization.\
\
**Learn more:** [CloudWatch metrics available for your instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/viewing_metrics_with_cloudwatch.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS compute service enables users to run containers securely and reliably at scale?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) is a managed container orchestration service for deploying, running, and scaling containerized applications securely and reliably.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Elastic Container Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company uses a physical tape library to store data backups, but the library is running out of capacity. The company needs to extend the tape library’s capacity to the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to satisfy this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway extends on-premises tape backup environments with a cloud-backed virtual tape library. It presents virtual tape drives and a media changer to existing backup software, providing scalable cloud capacity while preserving tape-based backup workflows.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Tape Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html) · [How Tape Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
An ecommerce company has deployed a new web application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to distribute incoming HTTP traffic evenly across all running instances.  
  
Which AWS service or resource will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Application Load Balancer (ALB) operates at Layer 7 (application layer) and is specifically designed for HTTP/HTTPS traffic distribution. It can distribute traffic based on hostnames, paths, and other application-level criteria. Network Load Balancer operates at Layer 4 for extreme performance with TCP/UDP, Gateway Load Balancer is for third-party appliances, and EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts instance counts rather than distributing traffic.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is an Application Load Balancer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, which task is the customer's responsibility?

options.text: Maintaining the infrastructure needed to run AWS Lambda
Updating the operating system of Amazon DynamoDB instances
Updating the guest operating system on Amazon EC2 instances

questions.explanation:
In the AWS shared responsibility model, customers manage the guest operating system on their EC2 instances, including patching and updates. AWS manages the underlying infrastructure for Lambda, the DynamoDB instances themselves, and S3 infrastructure—these are fully managed services where AWS assumes OS patching responsibility.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service lets companies deploy an application nearer to end users?
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network that uses a global network of edge locations to deliver application content close to end users with low latency.\
\
**Learn more:** [How CloudFront delivers content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/HowCloudFrontWorks.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to provide its on-premises workloads with access to Windows file shares in AWS. The company does not want to deploy any additional infrastructure or applications in its data center.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon FSx File Gateway provides on-premises workloads with low-latency, seamless SMB access to file shares hosted in Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. The gateway can be deployed outside the data center, avoiding the need to provision additional on-premises infrastructure or applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which action should a company take to improve security in its AWS account?

options.text: Require multi-factor authentication (MFA) for privileged users.
Create an access key for the AWS account root user.
Create an access key for each privileged user.

questions.explanation:
Requiring multi-factor authentication for privileged users adds a second, independent verification factor beyond a password, greatly reducing the risk that a compromised credential leads to account takeover. Removing the root user is not possible, creating access keys for the root account or for every privileged user actually increases risk by expanding long-lived credential exposure.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Multi-factor authentication](https://aws.amazon.com/iam/features/mfa/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company must prevent SQL injection attacks.  
  
Which AWS service or feature can satisfy this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS WAF inspects HTTP(S) web requests and can block requests containing SQL injection attack patterns through managed rules or custom rules.\
\
**Learn more:** [SQL injection attack rule statement - AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: How does the AWS Enterprise Support Concierge team assist users?

options.text: Answering questions regarding technical support cases

questions.explanation:
The AWS Enterprise Support Concierge team helps Enterprise Support customers with billing and account inquiries, including account administration and billing-related assistance.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Enterprise Support plan](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/enterprise/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can a user configure to restrict network access at the subnet level?
questions.explanation:
A Network ACL controls inbound and outbound traffic for its associated subnet. It provides subnet-level allow and deny rules, unlike security groups, which apply to associated resources such as EC2 instances.\
\
**Learn more:** [Control subnet traffic with network access control lists - Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS service is provided at no charge in all cases?
questions.explanation:
AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) is an AWS account feature offered at no additional charge. Charges can apply to other AWS services accessed through IAM, but IAM itself does not have a usage charge.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is IAM?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can a company use to enforce security rules on particular Amazon EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: Security groups act as virtual firewalls for Amazon EC2 instances, controlling allowed inbound and outbound traffic through rules associated with those instances.

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which maintenance task is the customer responsible for?

options.text: Amazon EC2 updates and security patches

questions.explanation:
For Amazon EC2, customers manage the guest operating system and software running on their instances, including applying updates and security patches. AWS maintains the underlying cloud infrastructure, such as physical networking hardware and its firmware.\
\
**Learn more:** [Security in Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-security.html) · [Shared responsibility — AWS Well-Architected Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which maintenance task is the customer responsible for?
questions.explanation:
Auto Scaling groups automatically adjust the number of EC2 instances based on demand metrics (e.g., CPU utilization), scaling up during peak hours and scaling down during low-usage periods. This directly addresses the requirement to minimize cost for variable, time-of-day-dependent workloads. Multiple AZs provide resilience but not cost optimization; placement groups and private subnets affect network performance or security, not cost.

**Learn more:** [What is Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to discover, prepare, move, and integrate data from multiple sources for data analytics and machine learning.  
  
Which AWS serverless data integration service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Glue is a fully managed, serverless ETL service that discovers, catalogs, prepares, and integrates data from multiple sources for analytics and machine learning workloads. It simplifies the data integration pipeline without requiring infrastructure management.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Glue?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to store infrequently used data for data archives and long-term backups.  
  
Which AWS service or storage class will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is specifically designed for archival and long-term backup storage at minimal cost. It provides the lowest per-gigabyte storage price while supporting retrieval when needed. FSx and EBS are for active workloads, and EFS is a shared file system—none are cost-optimized for infrequent archival access.\
\
**Learn more:** [Understanding archival storage in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/archival-storage.html) · [Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is in the initial planning phase of a migration to AWS. It wants to determine the predicted monthly total AWS cost of ownership for future Amazon EC2 instances and their associated storage.  
  
Which AWS service or tool should the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Pricing Calculator creates projected cost estimates for planned AWS usage. An Amazon EC2 estimate can include the selected instance configuration and associated Amazon EBS storage, and displays total monthly costs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and configure an estimate — AWS Pricing Calculator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pricing-calculator/latest/userguide/create-configure-estimate.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which option represents a business perspective capability in the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)?
questions.explanation:
Data monetization is an AWS CAF Business perspective capability. It focuses on using data to achieve measurable business benefits.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Adoption Framework: Business Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-business-perspective/aws-caf-business-perspective.html) · [Data monetization – AWS Cloud Adoption Framework: Business Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-business-perspective/data-monetization.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to automate infrastructure deployments by using infrastructure as code (IaC). The company needs to scale production stacks so that they can be deployed across multiple AWS Regions.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudFormation provides infrastructure as code through templates. CloudFormation StackSets extend this capability by deploying and managing stacks across specified AWS Regions with a single operation.\
\
**Learn more:** [Managing stacks across accounts and Regions with StackSets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/what-is-cfnstacksets.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants the ability to automatically acquire resources as needed and release the resources when they are no longer needed.  
  
Which cloud concept describes this functionality?
questions.explanation:
Elasticity is the cloud computing concept describing the ability to automatically acquire resources as demand increases and release them when they are no longer needed, avoiding both over- and under-provisioning. Availability, durability, and reliability describe uptime and data resilience rather than dynamic resource scaling.\
\
**Learn more:** [Elasticity - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://wa.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2020-07-02T19-33-23/wat.concept.elasticity.en.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which component must be attached to a VPC to enable inbound internet access?
questions.explanation:
An Internet Gateway is the VPC component that enables inbound internet traffic. It serves as both a NAT device for IPv4 and an egress-only internet gateway for IPv6. A NAT Gateway only enables outbound traffic from private subnets, VPC endpoints provide private access to AWS services, and VPN connections are for hybrid connectivity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Enable internet access for a VPC using an internet gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following are advantages of AWS Trusted Advisor? (Choose two.)

options.text: Access to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS)
Hourly refresh of the service limit checks
AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) approval management

questions.explanation:
AWS Trusted Advisor analyzes an AWS environment against AWS best practices and supplies cost-optimization recommendations to identify potential savings, as well as security checks that identify security configuration risks.\
\
**Learn more:** [Get started with AWS Trusted Advisor Recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/get-started-with-aws-trusted-advisor.html) · [AWS Trusted Advisor check reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor-check-reference.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services use global edge locations? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudFront delivers content through a worldwide network of edge locations. AWS Global Accelerator accepts traffic at the AWS edge location closest to the user and routes it across the AWS global network to the configured endpoint.\
\
**Learn more:** [How CloudFront delivers content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/HowCloudFrontWorks.html) · [How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is building AWS architecture to deliver real-time data feeds from an on-premises data center into an application that runs on AWS. The company needs a consistent network connection with minimal latency.  
  
What should the company use to connect the application and the data center to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Direct Connect establishes a dedicated, private network connection between on-premises data centers and AWS, providing consistent low-latency connectivity ideal for real-time data feeds. Public internet is unreliable, VPN adds latency, and Amazon Connect is a contact center service unrelated to network connectivity.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which cloud-computing benefit is a company using when it uses AWS Regions to increase application availability for users in different countries?
questions.explanation:
AWS Regions enable applications to be deployed in multiple geographic locations, improving availability for users across different countries and providing global reach.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Global Infrastructure Regions & AZs](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/regions_az/) · [AWS Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-infrastructure/latest/regions/aws-regions.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A library wants to automate the categorization of electronic books according to the books’ contents.  
  
Which AWS service should the library use to satisfy this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Comprehend uses natural language processing to derive insights from document content and supports custom classification that organizes documents into categories defined by the customer.\
\
**Learn more:** [Custom classification - Amazon Comprehend](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/how-document-classification.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to use SQL syntax to perform a direct query of objects in an Amazon S3 bucket.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Athena is a serverless, interactive query service that enables SQL queries directly on objects stored in Amazon S3 using standard SQL syntax. Athena is ideal for ad-hoc analysis and data exploration without requiring data movement or complex ETL pipelines.\
\
**Learn more:** [Run SQL queries in Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-athena-tables.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A research team will collect data at remote sites worldwide. Many of these sites lack internet connectivity. The team must capture the data in the field and transfer it to the AWS Cloud afterward.  
  
Which AWS service supports these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Snow Family provides portable physical devices for collecting and storing data in remote or disconnected locations, then transferring that data to AWS after the device is returned or connectivity is available.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Snowball Edge Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to modernize a monolithic application by converting it into microservices. The company wants to migrate the application to AWS.  
  
Which migration strategy should the company use?
questions.explanation:
The refactor (re-architect) strategy modifies an application’s architecture to use cloud-native capabilities. It is the appropriate strategy for decomposing a monolithic application into microservices.\
\
**Learn more:** [About the migration strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/large-migration-guide/migration-strategies.html) · [Re-architecting as microservices in Linux containers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/modernization-net-applications/refactor-linux-micro.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to modernize a monolithic application by converting it into microservices. The company wants to migrate the application to AWS.  
  
Which migration strategy should the company use?
questions.explanation:
The stated incompatibility rules out a true lift-and-shift, since Rehost by definition moves the application unchanged, which is not possible for a workload that cannot run in a cloud environment at all. Refactor would resolve the incompatibility but demands the most redevelopment effort, and Retire abandons the application rather than migrating it, so neither satisfies the requirement. Repurchase (replacing it with a cloud-native or SaaS CMS) and Replatform (making the minimal changes needed to run the workload in the cloud) both work around the incompatibility while requiring comparatively little engineering effort.

**Learn more:** [6 Strategies for Migrating Applications to the Cloud](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/enterprise-strategy/6-strategies-for-migrating-applications-to-the-cloud/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Which option is a responsibility of AWS under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Patch management for applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances
Patch management of the underlying infrastructure for managed services

questions.explanation:
For AWS managed services (such as RDS, DynamoDB, or Lambda), AWS extends its side of the shared responsibility model to include patching the underlying infrastructure and platform software, not just the physical hardware and hypervisor. Application data security, patching customer-run software on EC2, and application-level identity and access management all remain the customer's responsibility regardless of which service is used.

**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/) · [Shared responsibility - Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A developer needs to use a standardized template to create copies of a company's AWS architecture for development, test, and production environments.  
  
Which AWS service should the developer use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudFormation is the standard AWS service for defining infrastructure templates that can be instantiated across multiple environments (dev, test, production). The template-based approach ensures consistency and repeatability. Cloud Map is for service discovery; CloudFront is a CDN; CloudTrail is for logging and audit—none provide templated infrastructure deployment.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS CloudFormation?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants an Amazon S3 solution that provides access to object storage within single-digit milliseconds.  
  
Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS markets S3 Express One Zone specifically as the storage class \"purpose-built to deliver consistent single-digit millisecond data access\" for latency-sensitive applications, offering up to 10x faster access than S3 Standard. S3 Standard provides low-latency, high-throughput access but is not marketed or engineered to guarantee single-digit millisecond retrieval, and the Glacier tiers are archival classes with much higher retrieval latency. **Learn more:** [S3 Express One Zone](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/express-one-zone/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate its applications to the AWS Cloud. It wants to identify and prioritize business-transformation opportunities and assess its readiness for the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which AWS service or tool should the company use to fulfill these requirements?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) provides best-practice guidance for identifying and prioritizing transformation opportunities, evaluating and improving cloud readiness, and evolving a cloud transformation roadmap.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Adoption Framework: Business Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-business-perspective/aws-caf-business-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company has a workload that will run continuously for 1 year. The workload cannot tolerate service interruptions.  
  
Which Amazon EC2 purchasing option will be MOST cost-effective?
questions.explanation:
All Upfront Reserved Instances offer the lowest per-hour cost for EC2 instances with a one-year commitment that requires no service interruptions. Partial Upfront RIs cost more; Dedicated Instances are more expensive and serve specialized use cases; and On-Demand Instances are the most expensive option for sustained workloads.\
\
**Learn more:** [Reserved Instances for Amazon EC2 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company is requesting Payment Card Industry (PCI) reports that validate the operating effectiveness of AWS security controls.  
  
How should the company obtain these reports?

options.text: Download reports from AWS Security Hub.
Contact an AWS technical account manager (TAM).

questions.explanation:
AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS security and compliance documentation, including PCI DSS attestations and SOC 2 reports. It enables companies to download compliance reports directly to meet regulatory and audit requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Artifact?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/what-is-aws-artifact.html) · [Latest PCI DSS Compliance Package in AWS Artifact](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/latest-pci-dss-v4-0-compliance-package-available-in-aws-artifact/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to establish a private network connection between AWS and its corporate network.  
  
Which AWS service or feature meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network connection from an on-premises corporate network to AWS, enabling private connectivity to AWS resources and VPCs without using the public internet path.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company needs to establish a private network connection between AWS and its corporate network.  
  
Which AWS service or feature meets this requirement?

options.text: Users eliminate the need to guess about infrastructure capacity requirements.
Users decrease their variable costs by maintaining sole ownership of IT hardware.
Users maintain control of underlying IT infrastructure hardware.
Users maintain control of operating systems for managed services.

questions.explanation:
A key benefit of cloud computing is that it removes the need to guess and over-provision infrastructure capacity in advance, since resources can be scaled up or down on demand to match actual usage. The other options describe traits of traditional on-premises IT (ownership of hardware, control of underlying infrastructure, and OS management for managed services), which cloud computing specifically eliminates.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

A retail company is building a new mobile app. The company is evaluating whether to build the app at an on-premises data center or in the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which of the following are benefits of building this app in the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)

options.text: A large, upfront capital expense and low variable expenses
Increased speed for trying out new projects
Complete control over the physical security of the infrastructure
Flexibility to scale up in minutes as the application becomes popular
Ability to pick the specific data centers that will host the application servers

questions.explanation:
Building in AWS enables rapid experimentation and iteration (speed to market), and provides elastic scaling to handle application growth in minutes. Option A is backwards—cloud reduces upfront capital. Option C is incorrect because customers don't control AWS physical security. Option E is false—customers select regions/AZs, not specific data centers.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs and manages its own Docker environment on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants an alternative that helps manage cluster size, scheduling, and environment maintenance.
