Which AWS service satisfies these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Fargate is serverless compute for containers. It eliminates the need to provision, configure, scale, and maintain the underlying virtual-machine infrastructure, while container orchestration services can schedule workloads onto Fargate capacity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Simplify compute management with AWS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to define a central data protection policy that works across AWS services for compute, storage, and database resources.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Backup is a fully managed service that centralizes and automates backup policies across AWS services. It supports compute (EC2), storage (EBS, FSx), and databases (RDS, DynamoDB), enabling a single data protection policy across all resources. AWS Batch is for batch processing, Elastic Disaster Recovery manages failover and recovery, and FSx is a managed file system—none provide centralized backup policy management.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Backup](https://aws.amazon.com/backup/) · [What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company’s application developers must rapidly provision and manage AWS services by using scripts.  
  
Which AWS offering should the developers use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS CLI enables scripts to call AWS service APIs for provisioning, configuration, and management of AWS resources.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CLI](https://aws.amazon.com/cli/) · [Getting started with the AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-chap-getting-started.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company’s application developers must rapidly provision and manage AWS services by using scripts.  
  
Which AWS offering should the developers use to satisfy these requirements?

options.text: Hard code an IAM user’s secret key and access key directly in the application, and upload the file.
Store the IAM user’s secret key and access key in a text file on the EC2 instance, read the keys, then upload the file.
Have the EC2 instance assume a role to obtain the privileges to upload the file.
Modify the S3 bucket policy so that any service can upload to it at any time.

questions.explanation:
An EC2 instance should use an IAM role attached through an instance profile to obtain temporary credentials and only the S3 permissions it needs. This avoids exposing or managing long-term IAM user access keys in application code or files on the instance.

**Learn more:** [IAM roles for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html) · [Grant an EC2 instance access to an S3 bucket](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/ec2-instance-access-s3-bucket)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Which statements accurately describe the relationships among components of AWS global infrastructure? (Choose two.)

options.text: There are more AWS Regions than Availability Zones.
There are more edge locations than AWS Regions.
An edge location is an Availability Zone.
There are more AWS Regions than edge locations.
There are more Availability Zones than AWS Regions.

questions.explanation:
AWS operates far more edge locations (hundreds, for CloudFront and Route 53) than Regions, and each Region contains multiple Availability Zones, so the total number of AZs across all Regions exceeds the number of Regions. An edge location is a separate point-of-presence facility, not an Availability Zone, and there are always far fewer Regions than either AZs or edge locations.

**Learn more:** [AWS Global Infrastructure](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/) · [AWS Regions and Availability Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-infrastructure/latest/regions/aws-regions-availability-zones.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company that operates on-premises servers decides to start a new line of business. The company determines that additional servers are required for the new workloads.  
  
Which advantage of cloud computing can help the company to provision additional infrastructure as quickly as possible?

options.text: Benefit from massive economies of scale
Trade fixed expense for variable expense

questions.explanation:
Cloud computing's primary advantage for rapid infrastructure provisioning is speed and agility. Unlike on-premises infrastructure that requires physical procurement, delivery, and setup (potentially taking weeks), AWS allows provisioning of servers and resources in minutes. This directly addresses the need to respond quickly to new business demands.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
An ecommerce company has moved its IT infrastructure from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which cost is directly the company’s responsibility?

options.text: Cost of the hardware infrastructure on AWS
Cost of power for the AWS servers
Cost of physical security for the AWS data center

questions.explanation:
AWS bears the costs of the underlying physical cloud infrastructure, including server hardware, electrical power, and data-center physical security. The customer is responsible for licensing and managing its own application software.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company is building an application that uses multiple AWS services. The application must use temporary, limited-privilege credentials to authenticate with other AWS APIs.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should the company use to satisfy these authentication requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) issues temporary, limited-privilege security credentials that can be used to make authenticated calls to AWS APIs. The credentials are time-limited and can be scoped through the permissions of the assumed role or session policy.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Security Token Service API Reference — Welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html) · [Temporary security credentials in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services can host PostgreSQL databases? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Amazon Aurora and Amazon EC2 both support PostgreSQL databases. Aurora provides a managed relational database engine with PostgreSQL compatibility. EC2 allows self-managed PostgreSQL installation on compute instances. Amazon S3 is object storage, OpenSearch is for search/analytics, and EFS is a shared file system—none are database hosting services.\
\
**Learn more:** [Working with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.AuroraPostgreSQL.html) · [What is Amazon EC2?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which of the following functions as an instance-level firewall that controls inbound and outbound access?
questions.explanation:
Security groups act as virtual firewalls for EC2 instances, with inbound rules controlling incoming traffic and outbound rules controlling outgoing traffic. Network ACLs apply at the subnet level rather than the instance level. See [Amazon EC2 security groups for your EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-security-groups.html).\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 security groups for your EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-security-groups.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which of the following functions as an instance-level firewall that controls inbound and outbound access?

options.text: Maintain the configuration of infrastructure devices.
Maintain patching and updates within the hardware infrastructure.
Maintain the configuration of guest operating systems and applications.

questions.explanation:
AWS is responsible for the underlying cloud infrastructure, including its hardware, infrastructure-device configuration, and infrastructure patching. Customers are responsible for managing and configuring guest operating systems and applications, and for managing their data, including encryption options. [AWS Shared Responsibility—Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility—Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate its custom marketing application and order-processing application to AWS. The company needs to deploy the applications on different types of instances with various configurations of CPU, memory, storage, and networking capacity.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 offers a wide variety of instance types with different configurations of CPU, memory, storage, and networking capacity to support diverse application requirements. Each instance family is optimized for specific workload types, enabling cost-effective deployment of applications with varying resource needs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 instance types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-types.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate its custom marketing application and order-processing application to AWS. The company needs to deploy the applications on different types of instances with various configurations of CPU, memory, storage, and networking capacity.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.text: Deliver the content through Amazon CloudFront.
Store the content on Amazon S3 and enable S3 cross-region replication.
Implement a VPN across multiple AWS Regions.
Deliver the content through AWS PrivateLink.

questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudFront is a global CDN that caches static and media content at edge locations and routes viewers to a low-latency location. This provides efficient worldwide delivery of images and videos while reducing origin requests and transfer costs.

**Learn more:** [What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html) · [Implement services to reduce data transfer costs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/cost_data_transfer_implement_services.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A user needs to perform a one-time backup of an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is attached to an Amazon EC2 instance.  
  
What is the MOST operationally efficient way to perform this backup?

options.text: Attach another EBS volume to the EC2 instance, and copy the contents.
Copy the EBS volume to a server that is running outside AWS and is connected with AWS Direct Connect.
Create an EBS snapshot of the volume.
Create a custom script to copy the EBS file contents to Amazon S3.

questions.explanation:
An EBS snapshot is a built-in, point-in-time backup of the volume that AWS manages automatically and stores in Amazon S3, requiring no manual scripting or extra infrastructure. Attaching another volume and copying data, running a server outside AWS, or writing a custom script to copy files to S3 all require significantly more manual setup and ongoing operational effort.

**Learn more:** [Amazon EBS snapshots](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-snapshots.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A customer operates an On-Demand Amazon Linux EC2 instance for 3 hours, 5 minutes, and 6 seconds.  
  
For what duration will the customer be billed?
questions.explanation:
On-Demand Amazon Linux EC2 instances are billed per second, with a minimum charge of 60 seconds. Because the instance ran longer than one minute, billing covers its exact 3 hours, 5 minutes, and 6 seconds of runtime.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 On-Demand Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/on-demand/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which option is a perspective that encompasses foundational capabilities in the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)?
questions.explanation:
AWS CAF groups its foundational capabilities into six perspectives: Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security, and Operations. Governance is therefore an AWS CAF perspective; the other listed terms are AWS Well-Architected Framework pillars.\
\
**Learn more:** [Foundational capabilities — AWS Cloud Adoption Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/foundational-capabilities.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or component enables inbound internet traffic to access a VPC?
questions.explanation:
An internet gateway attaches to a VPC and provides the route-table target that enables communication with the internet. With public addressing, appropriate routing, and permitted security rules, internet hosts can initiate connections to VPC resources. A NAT gateway is intended for outbound access from private subnets without unsolicited inbound connections.\
\
**Learn more:** [Enable internet access for a VPC using an internet gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html) · [Plan your VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-getting-started.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS service or component enables inbound internet traffic to access a VPC?

options.text: Build a single application component that can handle all the application functionality.
Make large changes on fewer iterations to reduce chances of failure.
Avoid monolithic architecture by segmenting workloads.

questions.explanation:
AWS recommends segmenting workloads to avoid monolithic architectures where possible. Smaller, appropriately separated services improve scalability, reliability, agility, and isolation of failures. AWS Well-Architected guidance also favors loosely coupled components and frequent, small, reversible changes.

**Learn more:** [REL03-BP01 Choose how to segment your workload — AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/rel_service_architecture_monolith_soa_microservice.html) · [Design principles — AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2023-10-03/framework/oe-design-principles.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.explanation:
Amazon Neptune is a fully managed graph database designed for storing and querying highly connected data, making it ideal for fraud detection use cases that require analyzing relationships between users, addresses, and transactions. DocumentDB handles documents, Timestream stores time-series data, and DynamoDB is a key-value store—none are optimized for relationship queries and graph traversal.

**Learn more:** [Amazon Neptune](https://aws.amazon.com/neptune/) · [Getting started with Amazon Neptune](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/graph-get-started.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A developer who has no AWS Cloud experience wants to use AWS technology to build a web application.  
  
Which AWS service should the developer use to start building the application?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Lightsail is a virtual private server (VPS) service designed for developers with little or no cloud experience. It provides an easy entry point to AWS with simplified management. SageMaker is for machine learning, Lambda requires programming expertise, and ECS requires containerization knowledge. Lightsail abstracts complexity for beginners.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Lightsail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lightsail/latest/userguide/what-is-amazon-lightsail.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company runs Amazon EC2 instances in a research lab. The instances run for 3 hours each week and cannot be interrupted.  
  
What is the MOST cost-effective instance purchasing option to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
On-Demand Instances are recommended for short-term, low-usage workloads that cannot be interrupted, since you pay only for the compute time actually used with no long-term commitment — ideal for an instance that runs just 3 hours a week. Savings plans and reserved/convertible options require a 1- or 3-year usage commitment that would go largely unused at only 3 hours per week, and Spot Instances can be reclaimed by AWS, which conflicts with the requirement that the workload cannot be interrupted.\
**Learn more:** [On-Demand Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-on-demand-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS benefit is illustrated by on-demand technology services that allow companies to replace upfront fixed expenses with variable expenses?
questions.explanation:
Pay-as-you-go pricing converts capital-intensive, upfront infrastructure costs into variable operating costs based on actual resource consumption. AWS describes this model as trading fixed expenses for variable expenses and paying only for the IT resources consumed.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Financial Management](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company uses AWS security services and tools. It needs a service that helps manage security alerts and organizes those alerts into one dashboard.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Security Hub centralizes security findings from integrated AWS security services, including Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, and Amazon Macie, and provides a consolidated dashboard for managing and prioritizing security alerts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Introduction to AWS Security Hub CSPM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html) · [Working with the dashboard in Security Hub CSPM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/dashboard.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service can be used to obtain compliance reports on demand?
questions.explanation:
AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS security and compliance documents and reports, including SOC, PCI, and ISO-related materials.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Artifact?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/what-is-aws-artifact.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature is a browser-based, pre-authenticated service that can be launched directly from the AWS Management Console?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudShell provides a browser-based shell that is pre-authenticated with the credentials used to sign in to the AWS Management Console, so it can be launched directly from the console without separately configuring command-line credentials.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS CloudShell?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudshell/latest/userguide/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can a company use to securely store and encrypt database passwords?
questions.explanation:
AWS Secrets Manager securely stores database credentials and encrypts secret values using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). It also supports managing and rotating database credentials.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Secrets Manager Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/) · [Secret encryption and decryption in AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/security-encryption.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which choice represents a shared responsibility of AWS and its customers under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Configuration of Amazon EC2 instance operating systems

questions.explanation:
Patch management is a shared control: AWS patches and remediates flaws in its cloud infrastructure, while customers patch their guest operating systems and applications. Configuration of EC2 guest operating systems and application encryption settings are customer responsibilities, whereas physical infrastructure security is AWS’s responsibility.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared responsibility — AWS Well-Architected Framework Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company that is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud is based in an isolated area that has limited internet connectivity. The company needs to perform local data processing on premises. The company needs a solution that can operate without a stable internet connection.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Snowball Edge is a physical device with onboard compute and storage that performs local data processing and machine learning at disconnected or bandwidth-constrained sites, functioning independently of a stable internet connection. Amazon S3, AWS Storage Gateway, and AWS Backup all depend on ongoing internet or network connectivity to AWS to operate.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Snowball Edge](https://aws.amazon.com/snowball/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: What is the primary use case for Amazon GuardDuty?

options.text: Automatic monitoring for threats to AWS workloads

questions.explanation:
Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service that automatically monitors AWS accounts and workloads for malicious activity and security threats. DDoS prevention is Shield's function, SQL injection protection is provided by AWS WAF, and resource provisioning is handled by CloudFormation. GuardDuty focuses on threat detection and response.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: What is a customer responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model when using AWS Lambda?

options.text: Maintenance of the underlying Lambda hardware.
Maintenance of the Lambda networking infrastructure.
The code and libraries that run in the Lambda functions.

questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model for Lambda, AWS manages the underlying infrastructure, networking, and Lambda runtime. Customers are responsible for the code and libraries they deploy in their Lambda functions. AWS handles all maintenance of hardware, networking infrastructure, and the Lambda service itself.\
\
**Learn more:** [Security in AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-security.html) · [Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following are pillars in the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS defines six Well-Architected Framework pillars, including Performance Efficiency and Operational Excellence. Resource scalability, system elasticity, and agile development are not pillars.\
\
**Learn more:** [The pillars of the framework — AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2025-02-25/framework/the-pillars-of-the-framework.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which VPC component can a company use to set up a virtual firewall at the Amazon EC2 instance level?
questions.explanation:
Security Groups act as virtual firewalls at the EC2 instance level, controlling inbound and outbound traffic. Network ACLs operate at the subnet level, route tables control traffic routing between subnets, and NAT gateways enable instances without public IPs to access external networks. For instance-level firewalling, Security Groups are the correct choice.\
\
**Learn more:** [Control traffic to your AWS resources using security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-security-groups.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to manage its cloud resources by using infrastructure as code (IaC) templates. The company needs to meet compliance requirements.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Service Catalog allows organizations to centrally manage and govern infrastructure as code templates, enforcing compliance and standardization. It lets customers deploy pre-approved CloudFormation or Terraform templates, ensuring only compliant resources are provisioned.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Service Catalog?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service enables a hybrid architecture that lets users extend AWS infrastructure, AWS services, APIs, and tools to data centers, co-location environments, or on-premises facilities?
questions.explanation:
AWS Outposts provides AWS-managed infrastructure at customer premises, enabling supported AWS services to run locally while using the same AWS APIs and tools as AWS Regions.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company has several AWS accounts containing compute workloads that cannot be interrupted. The company wants to receive billing discounts based on its use of AWS services.  
  
Which AWS feature or purchasing option meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Organizations consolidated billing combines usage across member accounts to qualify for and share volume-pricing discounts, Reserved Instance discounts, and Savings Plans discounts. It does not require workloads to use interruptible capacity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service helps a company plan its migration to AWS by gathering configuration, usage, and behavior data from on-premises data centers?
questions.explanation:
AWS Application Discovery Service collects and presents configuration, usage, and behavior data from on-premises servers to support workload assessment and AWS migration planning.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Migration and Transfer Overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/migration-services.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: What does Amazon CloudFront offer?

options.text: Automatic scaling for all resources to power an application from a single unified interface
Secure delivery of data, videos, applications, and APIs to users globally with low latency
Ability to directly manage traffic globally through a variety of routing types, including latency-based routing, geo DNS, geoproximity, and weighted round robin
Automatic distribution of incoming application traffic across multiple targets, such as Amazon EC2 instances, containers, IP addresses, and AWS Lambda functions

questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudFront is a global content delivery network that securely delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs to users worldwide with low latency and high transfer speeds.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon CloudFront Documentation](https://aws.amazon.com/documentation-overview/cloudfront/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service supports the delivery of highly available applications with rapid failover in multi-Region and Multi-AZ architectures?
questions.explanation:
AWS Global Accelerator continuously monitors endpoint health and rapidly routes new connections to healthy endpoints. It supports endpoints across multiple AWS Regions, providing high availability and failover for multi-Region and Multi-AZ application architectures.\
\
**Learn more:** [How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html) · [Resilience in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can host a managed PostgreSQL database for online transaction processing (OLTP)?
questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service that supports PostgreSQL and is designed for transactional database workloads, including OLTP.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_PostgreSQL.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has deployed a web application to Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances have low usage.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should the company use to rightsize the EC2 instances?
questions.explanation:
AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes EC2 instance usage metrics and provides rightsizing recommendations based on workload characteristics, helping companies identify underutilized instances and recommend appropriately sized alternatives. AWS Config tracks configuration changes, Cost Anomaly Detection identifies unusual spending patterns, and Budgets sets cost alerts—none provide rightsizing recommendations.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Compute Optimizer](https://aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/) · [Optimize EC2 costs with AWS Compute Optimizer right sizing](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/optimize-ec2-costs-with-aws-compute-optimizer-right-sizing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company uses Amazon DynamoDB as its application database.  
  
Which tasks fall under AWS responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)

options.text: Provide public endpoints to store and retrieve data.
Manage the infrastructure layer and the operating system.

questions.explanation:
For abstracted services such as Amazon DynamoDB, AWS operates the infrastructure layer, operating system, and platform, and makes service endpoints available for storing and retrieving data. The customer is responsible for data classification, IAM permissions, and encryption options.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/) · [Security and compliance in Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/security.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool provides a visualization of historical AWS spending patterns and projections of future AWS costs?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cost Explorer provides interactive graphs and tables that visualize historical AWS spending patterns and can forecast future costs based on that usage history. AWS Cost and Usage Report only exports raw billing data, AWS Budgets sets and alerts on spending thresholds rather than visualizing trends, and Amazon CloudWatch monitors operational metrics, not billing.\
\
**Learn more:** [Analyzing your costs with AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants its Amazon EC2 instances to run in a highly available environment, including when a natural disaster affects a specific geographic area.  
  
Which approach will accomplish this objective?

options.text: Use EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions.
Use EC2 instances in multiple Amazon CloudFront locations.
Use EC2 instances in multiple edge locations.
Use EC2 instances in AWS Local Zones.

questions.explanation:
AWS Regions are physically isolated and independent from one another; this isolation limits failures to a single Region. Operating EC2 workloads in multiple AWS Regions therefore provides geographic resilience against a disaster affecting one geographic area.\
\
**Learn more:** [Regions – AWS Fault Isolation Boundaries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-fault-isolation-boundaries/regions.html) · [Resilience in Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service is designed to help users handle large amounts of data in a data warehouse environment?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Redshift is a fully managed data warehouse optimized for large-scale analytical processing (OLAP), supporting complex queries over large datasets. RDS and Aurora are relational databases optimized for transactional workloads, and DynamoDB is a NoSQL database not designed for warehouse-scale analytics.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html) · [Amazon Redshift (cloud data warehouse)](https://aws.amazon.com/redshift/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services are serverless? (Choose two.)

options.text: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka

questions.explanation:
AWS Fargate (A) is a serverless container orchestration service that requires no server management, and Amazon S3 (D) is a serverless object storage service. Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka, EMR, and EC2 all require infrastructure management and are not classified as serverless services.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Fargate or AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/decision-guides/latest/fargate-or-lambda/fargate-or-lambda.html) · [Amazon S3 Serverless examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/service_code_examples_s3_serverless_examples.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate to the AWS Cloud. It wants to identify measurable business outcomes that explain the value of its decision to migrate.  
  
Which phase of the cloud transformation journey includes these activities?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Cloud Adoption Framework Envision phase focuses on showing how the cloud can accelerate business outcomes. It includes identifying and prioritizing transformation opportunities and associating them with stakeholders and measurable business outcomes to demonstrate value throughout the transformation journey.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Adoption Framework: Your cloud transformation journey](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/your-cloud-transformation-journey.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature supplies log data for inbound and outbound traffic on network interfaces within a VPC?
questions.explanation:
VPC Flow Logs captures information about IP traffic traveling to and from network interfaces in a VPC. The flow-log records can be delivered to destinations such as Amazon CloudWatch Logs, Amazon S3, or Amazon Data Firehose.\
\
**Learn more:** [Logging IP traffic using VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must run data processing once per week, and it usually takes approximately 5 hours to finish.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use for this workload?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 instances can run long-duration processing workloads, including a job that lasts about 5 hours. AWS Lambda executions are limited to 15 minutes, while AWS CodeDeploy and AWS Wavelength do not provide the required long-running compute capability.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html) · [Amazon EC2 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: For which use case are Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances MOST cost-effective?

options.text: Compute-intensive video transcoding that can be restarted if necessary
An instance in continual use for 1 month to conduct quality assurance tests
An instance that runs a web server that will run for 1 year
An instance that runs a database that will run for 3 years

questions.explanation:
On-Demand Instances are most cost-effective for short-term, unpredictable workloads. A one-month continuous QA testing period is ideal for On-Demand pricing; longer commitments for one year or three years are better suited for Reserved Instances. Video transcoding workloads would be more cost-effective with Spot Instances.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchasing On-Demand Instances for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-on-demand-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to explore and analyze data in Amazon S3 by using a programming language.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Athena is a fully managed, serverless query service that enables interactive analysis of data stored in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. It requires no infrastructure setup and is ideal for exploratory data analysis, making it the clear fit for this requirement.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company has batch workloads that need to run for short periods of time on Amazon EC2. The workloads can handle interruptions and can start again from where they ended.  
  
What is the MOST cost-effective EC2 instance purchasing option to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances provide up to 90% cost savings compared to On-Demand instances, making them the most cost-effective option. They are ideal for batch workloads that can tolerate interruptions and resume from where they stopped. Reserved Instances require upfront commitment; Dedicated and On-Demand Instances are significantly more expensive.\
\
**Learn more:** [Spot Instances - Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A user has been granted permission to change their own IAM user password.  
  
Which AWS services can the user use to change the password? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: An IAM user with permission to change their own password can do so either through the AWS Management Console (My Security Credentials page) or via the AWS CLI using the iam change-password command. AWS KMS, RAM, and Secrets Manager manage encryption keys, resource sharing, and secret storage respectively, and provide no interface for an IAM user to update their own console password. **Learn more:** [Managing passwords for IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_admin-change-user.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A user has been granted permission to change their own IAM user password.  
  
Which AWS services can the user use to change the password? (Choose two.)

options.text: Set up multi-factor authentication (MFA) for each WorkSpaces user account.
Ensure the environmental safety and security of the AWS infrastructure that hosts WorkSpaces.
Provide security for WorkSpaces user accounts through AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).
Configure AWS CloudTrail to log API calls and user activity.

questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, AWS is responsible for the physical infrastructure, environmental controls, and security of the data center housing WorkSpaces. Customer responsibilities include setting up MFA, managing IAM policies, and configuring monitoring—options A, C, and D are customer tasks.

**Learn more:** [AWS shared responsibility model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/) · [Shared responsibility model - Amazon WorkSpaces Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces-core/latest/pg/shared-model.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs a legacy workload in an on-premises data center. The company wants to migrate the workload to AWS. The company does not want to make any changes to the workload.  
  
Which migration strategy should the company use?
questions.explanation:
Rehosting, also known as 'lift-and-shift,' is the migration strategy for moving workloads to AWS without making any changes to the application itself. Replatform involves making some optimization changes, refactor requires significant code changes, and repurchase means switching to a different SaaS solution entirely.\
\
**Learn more:** [About the migration strategies (the 6 R's)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/large-migration-guide/migration-strategies.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which architectural concept refers to the ability to deploy resources on demand and release them when they are no longer required?
questions.explanation:
Elasticity enables resources to be provisioned when demand requires them and released when they are no longer needed, matching capacity to workload demand. AWS defines elasticity as the ability to acquire resources as needed and release them when they are no longer needed.\
\
**Learn more:** [Elastic – Reactive Systems on AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/reactive-systems-on-aws/elastic.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which guideline represents a Well-Architected design principle for developing cloud applications?

options.text: Keep static data closer to compute resources.
Design for automated recovery from failure.

questions.explanation:
Cloud applications should be designed to automatically recover from failures by monitoring for failure conditions and triggering automated remediation or recovery actions. This is an AWS Well-Architected Reliability Pillar design principle.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework — Reliability Pillar design principles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/design-principles.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs an AWS service that can collect and process 10 TB of data locally, then transfer that data to AWS. The company has intermittent network connectivity.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Snowball Edge supplies local storage and compute for processing data at the edge, and it can transfer data to AWS by physically shipping the device rather than relying on continuous network connectivity. Its storage capacity readily accommodates 10 TB of data.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Snowball Edge?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html) · [AWS Snowball Edge Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs an AWS service that can collect and process 10 TB of data locally, then transfer that data to AWS. The company has intermittent network connectivity.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?

options.text: S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

questions.explanation:
S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is an archival storage class for long-lived, infrequently accessed data. Its Bulk retrieval option typically completes within 5–12 hours, satisfying a 12-hour retrieval requirement while offering lower per-GB storage cost than the online S3 Standard and Infrequent Access classes.

**Learn more:** [Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html) · [Understanding archive retrieval options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. It is collecting information about its on-premises infrastructure and needs details such as the hostname, IP address, and MAC address.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Application Discovery Service discovers on-premises infrastructure for migration planning and collects server inventory and network details, including hostnames, IP addresses, and MAC addresses.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Application Discovery Service — Discovery Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/discovery-agent.html) · [AgentInfo — AWS Application Discovery Service API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/APIReference/API_AgentInfo.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. It is collecting information about its on-premises infrastructure and needs details such as the hostname, IP address, and MAC address.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?

options.text: AWS Trusted Advisor with AWS Developer Support
AWS Health Dashboard with AWS Enterprise Support
AWS Trusted Advisor with AWS Business Support
AWS Health Dashboard with AWS Enterprise On-Ramp Support

questions.explanation:
AWS Trusted Advisor provides comprehensive checks for cost optimization, security, fault tolerance, performance, and service quotas. Full access to all Trusted Advisor checks requires AWS Business Support or higher tier; Developer Support includes only basic checks. Business Support enables the full suite of recommendations.

**Learn more:** [AWS Trusted Advisor - AWS Support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor.html) · [AWS Support plan comparison](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
An ecommerce company wants to use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to add or remove EC2 instances according to CPU utilization.  
  
Which AWS service or feature can initiate an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling action to meet this goal?
questions.explanation:
An Amazon CloudWatch alarm can monitor CPU utilization and invoke an associated Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling scaling policy when the alarm threshold is breached. The policy adjusts the Auto Scaling group's capacity by launching or terminating EC2 instances.\
\
**Learn more:** [Step and simple scaling policies for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-simple-step.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which cloud concept is demonstrated by using AWS Cost Explorer?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cost Explorer surfaces usage and cost trends and provides rightsizing recommendations that identify underutilized or oversized resources so a company can match provisioned capacity to actual demand. Reliability, resilience, and modernization describe architectural and operational qualities of a workload, not a cost-optimization practice that a cost-visualization tool demonstrates.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cost Explorer rightsizing recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-rightsizing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to use Amazon EC2 instances for a stable production workload that will run for 1 year.  
  
Which instance purchasing option meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances provide substantial discounts (up to 72%) for a 1-year commitment with a stable, predictable workload. On-Demand instances cost the most per hour, Spot instances can be interrupted unexpectedly, and Dedicated Hosts are for license compliance, not cost optimization.\
\
**Learn more:** [Reserved Instances for Amazon EC2 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company stores data in an Amazon S3 bucket.  
  
Which task is the responsibility of AWS?

options.text: Protect the infrastructure that supports S3 storage.

questions.explanation:
AWS is responsible for protecting the underlying infrastructure that runs services like S3, which falls under \"security of the cloud\" in the shared responsibility model. Configuring lifecycle policies, enabling versioning, and setting bucket policies are all customer-managed configuration tasks that fall under \"security in the cloud.\"\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company is planning a migration to the AWS Cloud. The company is using the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspectives to identify its capability gaps.  
  
Which phase of the cloud transformation journey includes these identification activities?
questions.explanation:
The AWS CAF Align phase focuses on identifying capability gaps across the six CAF perspectives, identifying cross-organizational dependencies, and surfacing stakeholder concerns to improve cloud readiness.\
\
**Learn more:** [Your cloud transformation journey – AWS Cloud Adoption Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/your-cloud-transformation-journey.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company needs to block SQL injection attacks.  
  
Which AWS service or feature provides this functionality?
questions.explanation:
AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall) is a managed firewall service that protects web applications from common attacks including SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), and DDoS attacks. Network ACLs and security groups operate at lower network layers and lack application-layer attack detection.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS WAF SQL injection rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html) · [AWS managed rule groups for SQL database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/aws-managed-rule-groups-use-case.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which option is a benefit of using AWS for cloud computing?

options.text: Trade variable expense for fixed expense
Spending money running and maintaining data centers

questions.explanation:
AWS provides pay-as-you-go pricing, allowing customers to pay for the resources they consume instead of committing to large fixed infrastructure costs.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials training](https://aws.amazon.com/training/learn-about/cloud-practitioner/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which action represents a security best practice for accessing sensitive data stored in an Amazon S3 bucket?

options.text: Enable S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) on the S3 bucket.
Use IAM roles for applications that require access to the S3 bucket.
Configure AWS WAF to prevent unauthorized access to the S3 bucket.
Configure Amazon GuardDuty to prevent unauthorized access to the S3 bucket.

questions.explanation:
IAM roles provide applications with temporary, scoped AWS credentials for Amazon S3 access, avoiding the exposure and management risks of long-term credentials. AWS recommends IAM roles for applications and AWS services that require S3 access.\
\
**Learn more:** [Security best practices for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security-best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is considering using the AWS Cloud and must prepare a cost estimate for a project before its infrastructure is provisioned.  
  
Which AWS service or feature can estimate costs prior to deployment?
questions.explanation:
AWS Pricing Calculator lets organizations configure planned AWS services, Regions, and expected usage to generate projected cost estimates before deploying infrastructure.\
\
**Learn more:** [Getting started - AWS Pricing Calculator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pricing-calculator/latest/userguide/getting-started.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs an on-premises contact center for customers. The company needs to migrate to a cloud-based solution that can deliver artificial intelligence features to improve user experience.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?

options.text: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)

questions.explanation:
Amazon Connect is the cloud-based contact center service specifically designed to meet this requirement. It provides built-in artificial intelligence capabilities including speech recognition, sentiment analysis, and contact lens for quality assurance. AWS Wavelength, IAM Identity Center, and Direct Connect are unrelated to contact center operations.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/adminguide/what-is-amazon-connect.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs an on-premises contact center for customers. The company needs to migrate to a cloud-based solution that can deliver artificial intelligence features to improve user experience.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?

options.text: Replace the EC2 instances with AWS Lambda functions.
Use AWS Infrastructure Event Management (IEM) support.
Submit a request on AWS Marketplace to monitor the event.
Review the coverage reports in the AWS Cost Management console.

questions.explanation:
AWS Infrastructure Event Management (IEM) is a planned-event support engagement for large-scale events. AWS specialists become familiar with the workload and provide architectural and operational guidance, including scaling-readiness support, before and during the event. AWS now identifies AWS Countdown as the successor to IEM for Enterprise Support customers.

**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework – Streaming Media Lens: Preparation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/streaming-media-lens/preparation.html) · [AWS Well-Architected Framework – Financial Services Industry Lens: Key AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/financial-services-industry-lens/opex-key-aws-services.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company must archive its documents by using a write-once, read-many (WORM) model to meet legal and compliance obligations.  
  
Which feature of Amazon S3 can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
S3 Glacier Vault Lock enforces Write-Once, Read-Many (WORM) protection on archived data in Glacier storage. Once locked with a retention policy, objects cannot be modified or deleted during the specified retention period, ensuring regulatory compliance for immutable archival storage.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create Write-Once-Read-Many Archive Storage with Amazon Glacier](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/glacier-vault-lock/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company has an on-premises application. The application has processing times of less than 5 minutes and is invoked only a few times each day. The company wants to move the application to the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which AWS service will support this application MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation:
AWS Lambda is the most cost-effective option for short-duration, infrequently invoked workloads. Lambda's serverless pricing model charges only for actual execution time and number of invocations. ECS, EKS, and EC2 require maintaining running infrastructure regardless of actual usage, making them less economical for this use case.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Lambda Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to run a simulation continuously for 3 years.  
  
Which Amazon EC2 instance purchasing option meets these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances reduce EC2 cost for a consistent instance configuration through a 1- or 3-year commitment, making them appropriate for predictable, continuous three-year usage. Spot Instances can be interrupted, while Dedicated Hosts address dedicated-hardware requirements and On-Demand Instances do not provide the long-term commitment discount.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html) · [Spot Instance interruptions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-interruptions.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
An ecommerce company wants to distribute traffic between the Amazon EC2 instances that host its website.  
  
Which AWS service or resource will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: An Application Load Balancer distributes incoming HTTP/HTTPS traffic across multiple EC2 instances in one or more Availability Zones, improving fault tolerance and scalability. AWS WAF filters malicious web traffic, CloudHSM manages cryptographic keys, and Direct Connect provides a dedicated network link, none of which perform traffic distribution. **Learn more:** [What Is an Application Load Balancer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
An ecommerce company wants to distribute traffic between the Amazon EC2 instances that host its website.  
  
Which AWS service or resource will meet these requirements?

options.text: Reduced or eliminated tasks for hardware troubleshooting, capacity planning, and procurement
Elimination of the need for trained IT staff
Automatic security configuration of all applications that are migrated to the cloud
Elimination of the need for disaster recovery planning
Faster deployment of new features and applications

questions.explanation:
Moving to AWS reduces or eliminates the operational burden of hardware troubleshooting, capacity planning, and procurement, and it enables faster deployment of new features and applications because infrastructure can be provisioned on demand. The cloud does not eliminate the need for trained IT staff, automatic security configuration of migrated applications, or disaster recovery planning, all of which remain customer responsibilities.

**Learn more:** [Six Advantages of Cloud Computing](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is-cloud-computing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to visualize and manage AWS Cloud costs and usage for a specific period of time.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Cost Explorer is the AWS service designed to visualize, analyze, and manage cloud costs and usage over time. It provides detailed reports, forecasting capabilities, and custom dashboards to understand spending patterns. Consolidated billing aggregates costs across accounts, AWS Organizations manages accounts, and AWS Budgets sets alerts for spending thresholds but focuses on budgeting rather than analysis and visualization.\
\
**Learn more:** [Analyzing costs and usage with AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is rolling out a machine learning (ML) research project that will need significant compute capacity for several months. The ML processing jobs are not required to run at particular times.  
  
Which Amazon EC2 instance purchasing option satisfies these requirements at the lowest cost?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances provide unused EC2 capacity at steep discounts compared with On-Demand pricing. They are a cost-effective choice for flexible workloads that do not need to run at specific times and can tolerate interruption, including batch-style ML processing.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html) · [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is building an application that will receive millions of database queries each second. The company needs the data store for the application to scale to meet these needs.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed, serverless key-value and document database built to automatically scale throughput and storage to handle millions of requests per second with consistent, low-latency performance. AWS Cloud9 is a cloud IDE, Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached is an in-memory cache rather than a durable primary data store, and Amazon Neptune is a graph database not designed as a general-purpose store for this scale of query volume.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon DynamoDB](https://aws.amazon.com/dynamodb/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which fully managed AWS service helps create, test, and manage custom Amazon EC2 images?
questions.explanation:
EC2 Image Builder is a fully managed AWS service that automates the creation, testing, management, and distribution of customized server images, including Amazon EC2 AMIs.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is EC2 Image Builder?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/what-is-image-builder.html) · [Manage build and test workflows for Image Builder images](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/manage-image-workflows.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to migrate its on-premises databases to managed cloud database services through a simplified migration process.  
  
Which AWS service or tool can help the company satisfy this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) helps migrate on-premises databases to AWS database services, supporting homogeneous and heterogeneous migrations while minimizing downtime.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Database Migration Service documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must deploy applications in the AWS Cloud as quickly as possible while also minimizing the complexity associated with managing AWS resources.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk enables rapid application deployment while automatically handling underlying infrastructure tasks such as capacity provisioning, load balancing, scaling, and health monitoring. This reduces the operational complexity of managing AWS resources.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Elastic Beanstalk Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elastic-beanstalk/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool will monitor AWS resources and applications in real time?
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudWatch is the primary AWS service for real-time monitoring of resources and applications. It collects metrics, logs, and events from EC2, Lambda, RDS, and other AWS services, enabling real-time visibility into system and application performance. Trusted Advisor performs best-practice assessments, CloudTrail logs API calls for compliance auditing, and Cost Explorer analyzes spending—none provide real-time monitoring of resource health.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: To assist companies with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance in the cloud, AWS provides:

options.text: physical Inspections of data centers by appointment.
required PCI compliance certifications for any application running on AWS.
an AWS Attestation of Compliance (AOC) report for specific AWS services.

questions.explanation:
AWS Artifact gives customers on-demand access to AWS's compliance reports, including the PCI DSS Attestation of Compliance (AOC) and Responsibility Summary, which cover the specific AWS services included in scope. AWS does not perform ad-hoc physical inspections for individual customers, does not certify customer applications as PCI compliant, and does not offer bespoke PCI compliance consulting services.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Artifact](https://aws.amazon.com/artifact/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: To assist companies with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance in the cloud, AWS provides:

options.text: Switch from Amazon RDS to Amazon DynamoDB to accommodate NoSQL datasets.
Base the selection of Amazon EC2 instance types on past utilization patterns.
Use Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies to move objects that users access infrequently to lower-cost storage tiers.
Use Multi-AZ deployments for Amazon RDS.
Replace existing Amazon EC2 instances with AWS Elastic Beanstalk.

questions.explanation:
Rightsizing uses observed utilization and access patterns to match resources to workload needs. Historical Amazon EC2 utilization helps select an appropriately sized instance type, and Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies can transition infrequently accessed objects to more cost-effective storage classes. AWS documents EC2 rightsizing as evaluating resource usage to find cost-saving instance changes, and S3 Lifecycle as automating transitions to more cost-effective storage classes.

**Learn more:** [Optimizing your cost with rightsizing recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-rightsizing.html) · [Cost optimization - Amazon Simple Storage Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cost-optimization.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to estimate the cost for its AWS architecture solution before migration.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Pricing Calculator is the tool designed for estimating costs of AWS resources before deployment or migration. It allows organizations to model their architecture and calculate projected costs, enabling informed budgeting and cost planning decisions.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Pricing Calculator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pricing-calculator/latest/userguide/what-is-pricing-calculator.html) · [AWS Pricing Calculator](https://calculator.aws/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to estimate the cost for its AWS architecture solution before migration.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet this requirement?

options.text: Maximize utilization of Amazon EC2 instances.
Minimize utilization of Amazon EC2 instances.
Force frequent application reinstallations by users.
Reduce the need for users to reinstall applications.

questions.explanation:
AWS sustainability guidance recommends maximizing utilization by right-sizing resources and maintaining efficient use of underlying hardware. It also recommends reducing the downstream impact of workloads by lowering the energy and resources users require to use the service; avoiding unnecessary application reinstallations supports that objective.

**Learn more:** [Design principles for sustainability in the cloud — AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/sustainability-pillar/design-principles-for-sustainability-in-the-cloud.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to add a conversational chatbot to its website.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Lex is AWS's conversational AI service for building chatbots and voice assistants. Textract extracts text from documents, Glue is an ETL service, and Rekognition analyzes images and videos. Lex provides natural language understanding and dialogue management for conversational interfaces.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Lex V2?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lexv2/latest/dg/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services or features allow users to connect on-premises networks to a VPC? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS Site-to-Site VPN provides IPsec connectivity between a VPC and a remote, on-premises network. AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network connection from an on-premises environment to AWS and supports private virtual interfaces for VPC access.\
\
**Learn more:** [Connect your VPC to remote networks using AWS Virtual Private Network](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html) · [What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following are advantages of using AWS Trusted Advisor? (Choose two.)

options.text: Detecting underutilized resources to save costs
Improving security by proactively monitoring the AWS environment
Implementing enforced tagging across AWS resources

questions.explanation:
AWS Trusted Advisor provides cost-optimization recommendations that highlight unused or underutilized resources and opportunities to reduce costs. It also provides security recommendations that identify security-setting issues and help make AWS workloads more secure.\
\
**Learn more:** [Get started with Trusted Advisor Recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/get-started-with-aws-trusted-advisor.html) · [AWS Trusted Advisor check reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor-check-reference.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
To lower costs, a company plans to migrate a NoSQL database to AWS.  
  
Which fully managed AWS service can automatically scale throughput capacity to satisfy database workload demands?
questions.explanation:
Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database service. Its on-demand capacity mode automatically scales read and write throughput to accommodate workload demand without capacity planning, and DynamoDB auto scaling can dynamically adjust provisioned throughput in response to traffic patterns.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon DynamoDB?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html) · [DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/on-demand-capacity-mode.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services or tools can be used to identify rightsizing opportunities for Amazon EC2 instances? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS Cost Explorer identifies cost-saving opportunities for idle or underutilized Amazon EC2 instances through rightsizing recommendations. AWS Compute Optimizer generates Amazon EC2 rightsizing recommendations from resource utilization data and configurable performance preferences.\
\
**Learn more:** [Optimizing your cost with rightsizing recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-rightsizing.html) · [Rightsizing recommendation preferences](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/rightsizing-preferences.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must run a pre-installed third-party firewall on an Amazon EC2 instance.  
  
Which AWS service or feature can deliver this solution?
questions.explanation:
AWS Marketplace provides third-party, AMI-based software products that can be launched on Amazon EC2 with the software already installed, including security software such as firewalls. Network ACLs and security groups filter network traffic but do not install or run a third-party firewall appliance; AWS Trusted Advisor supplies best-practice recommendations.\
\
**Learn more:** [AMI-based products in AWS Marketplace](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/buyerguide/buyer-server-products.html) · [What is AWS Marketplace?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/what-is-marketplace.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to use application stacks to run a workload in the AWS Cloud. The company wants preconfigured instances.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Lightsail provides virtual private server instances that can be launched from preconfigured application and development-stack blueprints, including WordPress, LAMP, and Nginx.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Lightsail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lightsail/latest/userguide/what-is-amazon-lightsail.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A development team needs to deploy multiple test environments for an application quickly and repeatedly.  
  
Which AWS service should the team use?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudFormation uses templates to model and provision collections of AWS resources as stacks. Reusing a template enables consistent, repeatable deployment of infrastructure across multiple environments, including test environments.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudFormation Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudformation/) · [CloudFormation best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to convert video files and audio files to a format that will play on smartphones.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Elastic Transcoder converts media files from one format to another, enabling content to be played on various devices including smartphones. It processes files stored in S3 and outputs in multiple codecs and resolutions. Amazon Comprehend performs text analysis, Amazon Rekognition analyzes images/videos for recognition, and Amazon Polly converts text to speech.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon Elastic Transcoder](https://aws.amazon.com/elastictranscoder/details/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company intends to use an Amazon Snowball Edge device to move files to the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which Snowball Edge device-related activity can the company perform at no cost?

options.text: Use of the Snowball Edge appliance for a 10-day period
The transfer of data out of Amazon S3 and to the Snowball Edge appliance
The transfer of data from the Snowball Edge appliance into Amazon S3
Daily use of the Snowball Edge appliance after 10 days

questions.explanation:
Data transfer into Amazon S3 from a Snowball Edge device is charged at $0.00 per GB for data transfer. Standard Amazon S3 charges, such as storage and PUT request charges, can still apply. Data transferred out of Amazon S3 is chargeable, and Snowball device use is subject to job and, where applicable, additional daily fees.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Snowball Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/snowball/pricing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool provides users with a graphical interface that they can use to manage AWS services?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Management Console is the web-based graphical interface used to access and manage AWS services. AWS Copilot and the AWS CLI are command-line tools, and AWS SDKs are code libraries for programmatic access, none of which provide a graphical interface.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Management Console](https://aws.amazon.com/console/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to use automated video analysis to identify employees that are accessing its offices.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Rekognition is the AWS service for automated video and image analysis. It uses deep learning technology to identify objects, faces, text, and other elements in images and videos without requiring machine learning expertise. This makes it ideal for analyzing office access video footage. Amazon Polly does text-to-speech, Amazon Cognito manages user authentication, and AWS Lambda is a compute service.\
\
