**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Rekognition?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/what-is.html) · [Detecting and analyzing faces](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/faces.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature gives users the ability to provision AWS infrastructure programmatically?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) is an infrastructure-as-code framework that enables programmatic provisioning of AWS infrastructure. Developers can define cloud infrastructure using familiar programming languages and deploy it via CloudFormation. Amazon CodeGuru analyzes code for quality issues, AWS Config tracks resource compliance, and AWS CodeCommit is a version control service.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is the AWS CDK?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/home.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A cloud practitioner wants to use a highly available and scalable DNS service for its AWS workload.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Route 53 is AWS's managed DNS service offering high availability and scalability across global infrastructure. Lightsail is a virtual private server platform, Amplify Hosting is for web app deployment, and S3 is object storage—only Route 53 provides authoritative DNS resolution.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Route 53?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to reduce costs by archiving data that end users no longer access frequently.  
  
Which Amazon S3 feature meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 Lifecycle rules can automatically transition objects to less-expensive storage classes and archive them, reducing storage costs after the data becomes infrequently accessed.\
\
**Learn more:** [Managing the lifecycle of objects - Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud benefit enables a company to rapidly deploy cloud resources and access compute, storage, and database infrastructure within minutes?
questions.explanation:
Agility provides rapid, on-demand access to cloud technologies, including compute, storage, and databases, allowing technology services to be deployed in minutes. Elasticity specifically concerns scaling capacity as demand changes.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Cloud Computing? – AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is-cloud-computing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to gain insights from its data and build interactive data visualization dashboards.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon QuickSight is a serverless business intelligence service designed specifically for creating interactive dashboards and gaining insights from data. It supports ad-hoc analysis, paginated reports, and embedded analytics. Amazon SageMaker is for machine learning, Amazon Rekognition analyzes images/videos, and Amazon Kinesis processes real-time data streams.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon QuickSight?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/what-is.html) · [Amazon QuickSight (business intelligence)](https://aws.amazon.com/quick/quicksight/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can search for and identify AWS resources that are shared externally?
questions.explanation:
AWS IAM Access Analyzer identifies supported resources whose resource-based policies grant access to external principals outside the configured account or organization zone of trust, and generates external-access findings for those resources.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using AWS IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/what-is-access-analyzer.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to add natural language processing (NLP) to its business intelligence (BI) dashboards. It wants to ask questions and receive answers with relevant visualizations.  
  
Which AWS service or tool meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon QuickSight Q enables business users to ask natural-language questions about their data and automatically produces answers with relevant visualizations in a BI context.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon QuickSight in AWS big data analytics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/big-data-analytics-options/amazon-quicksight.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs an AWS service that delivers product recommendations using its customer data.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Personalize is a managed AWS machine-learning service for creating personalized product recommendations from customer and interaction data.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Personalize?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/personalize/latest/dg/what-is-personalize.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company has a compliance requirement to record and evaluate configuration changes, as well as perform remediation actions on AWS resources.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use?
questions.explanation:
AWS Config records configuration changes to AWS resources, evaluates compliance against policies, and enables automated remediation of non-compliant resources. AWS CloudTrail logs API activity, AWS Secrets Manager manages secrets, and AWS Trusted Advisor provides optimization recommendations—none address configuration change management.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Config Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/) · [Track configuration changes with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/TrackingChanges.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to provision and manage its AWS infrastructure by using the common programming languages TypeScript, Python, Java, and .NET.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) lets teams define and manage AWS infrastructure as code using supported languages including TypeScript, Python, Java, and C#/.NET. CDK applications synthesize infrastructure definitions that AWS CloudFormation deploys.\
\
**Learn more:** [Supported programming languages for the AWS CDK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/languages.html) · [What is the AWS CDK?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/home.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to provision and manage its AWS infrastructure by using the common programming languages TypeScript, Python, Java, and .NET.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?

options.text: AWS Enterprise Support at no additional cost

questions.explanation:
AWS's consumption-based (pay-as-you-go) pricing model eliminates the need to over-provision or pay for unused capacity, and AWS's massive aggregated customer base creates economies of scale that translate into lower prices over time — both are core, well-documented economic benefits of cloud computing. Perpetual licenses and bring-your-own-hardware describe traditional on-premises models, not cloud benefits, and enterprise support is a paid add-on rather than a free economic benefit.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html) · [AWS Cloud Economics](https://aws.amazon.com/economics/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants a fully managed service that centralizes and automates data protection across AWS services and hybrid workloads.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Backup is a fully managed service that centralizes and automates data protection across AWS services and hybrid workloads. It provides a single, centralized policy-based solution for protecting backups across multiple services.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is hosting a web application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to implement custom conditions to filter and control inbound web traffic.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS WAF enables creation of custom rules to filter and control web traffic, protecting applications from web exploits, bots, and unwanted requests. It integrates with load balancers and CloudFront to inspect and block traffic based on defined conditions before reaching the application.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configuring protection in AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to use a centralized AWS service to enforce compliance with the organizational business standards. The company wants to use an AWS service that can govern and control who can deploy, manage, and decommission AWS resources.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Service Catalog lets administrators create and manage curated catalogs of approved IT services and configurations, centrally governing which resources users are permitted to deploy, manage, and decommission in line with organizational standards. CloudWatch and Security Hub focus on monitoring and security findings rather than deployment governance, and GuardDuty is a threat-detection service, not a resource-provisioning control.\
**Learn more:** [AWS Service Catalog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company must transfer 75 petabytes of data from its on-premises data centers to AWS.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to satisfy these requirements in the MOST cost-effective manner?
questions.explanation:
AWS Snowmobile is intended for multi-petabyte and exabyte-scale data migrations and can transfer up to 100 PB per Snowmobile. It is therefore the appropriate cost-effective offline transfer service for a 75 PB on-premises migration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Move Exabyte-Scale Data Sets with AWS Snowmobile](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2016/11/move-exabyte-scale-data-sets-with-aws-snowmobile/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which advantage of cloud computing allows users to scale resources up and down based on the amount of load that an application supports?

options.text: Benefit from massive economies of scale
Trade fixed expense for variable expense

questions.explanation:
The phrase \"Stop guessing capacity\" is one of AWS's six main advantages of cloud computing. It refers to the ability to scale resources elastically based on actual demand, rather than purchasing fixed infrastructure upfront. This flexibility eliminates over-provisioning and under-provisioning problems inherent in on-premises deployments.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company has developed a new In-house application. The company does not have a way to determine or predict the usage demand that the application will create.  
  
Which AWS Cloud computing benefit is the company seeking?
questions.explanation:
When a company cannot predict its usage demand, the cloud benefit it needs is elasticity: the ability to automatically scale compute and other resources up or down to match actual load instead of provisioning for a guessed peak capacity in advance. This is the \"scalable and high performance\" benefit of AWS, distinct from ease of use, cost-effectiveness, or security, which address different concerns.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company has developed a new In-house application. The company does not have a way to determine or predict the usage demand that the application will create.  
  
Which AWS Cloud computing benefit is the company seeking?
questions.explanation:
IAM user groups let a company attach permissions once for users with similar roles or responsibilities. Moving an employee from the old group to the new group automatically replaces the employee’s group-derived permissions, avoiding per-user policy maintenance.

**Learn more:** [IAM user groups — AWS Identity and Access Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_groups.html) · [Create IAM groups — AWS Identity and Access Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_groups_create.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs durable storage for static content and infinitely scalable data-storage infrastructure at the lowest cost.  
  
Which AWS service should the company select?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 is durable, scalable object storage designed to store and retrieve virtually any amount of data. It is suitable for static-content hosting and uses pay-as-you-go pricing, supporting a low-cost storage design.\
\
**Learn more:** [Getting started with Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/gsg/GetStartedWithS3.html) · [Hosting Static Websites on AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/build-static-websites-aws/build-static-websites-aws.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective focuses on organizing an inventory of data products in a data catalog?
questions.explanation:
The Governance perspective in AWS CAF addresses data curation and cataloging—organizing an inventory of data products in a data catalog for discovery and self-service analytics. Operations focuses on service delivery, Business on outcomes and strategy, and Platform on technical infrastructure rather than data governance and metadata management.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF: Governance Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-governance-perspective/aws-caf-governance-perspective.html) · [Data curation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-governance-perspective/data-curation.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective focuses on organizing an inventory of data products in a data catalog?

options.text: Control access to AWS service APIs and to other specific resources.
Provide intelligent threat detection and continuous monitoring.
Protect the AWS environment using multi-factor authentication (MFA).
Grant users access to AWS data centers.
Provide firewall protection for applications from common web attacks.

questions.explanation:
IAM controls two key aspects: access to AWS service APIs and specific resources (A is correct), and authentication mechanisms including multi-factor authentication (C is correct). GuardDuty (not IAM) provides threat detection; WAF protects against web attacks; and data center access is a physical security concern, not an IAM function.

**Learn more:** [Security best practices in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html) · [Multi-factor authentication in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_mfa.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to develop an accessibility application that will convert text into audible speech.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Polly is a text-to-speech service that turns text into lifelike synthesized audio, making it well suited to building accessibility applications for users who need audible content. Amazon MQ is a message broker, Neptune is a graph database, and Timestream is a time-series database, none of which handle speech synthesis.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon Polly](https://aws.amazon.com/polly/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to develop an accessibility application that will convert text into audible speech.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
The People perspective in the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework serves as the bridge between technology and business, accelerating cultural evolution and organizational change. It emphasizes continuous learning, leadership alignment, and workforce development—key drivers for businesses to adopt cloud at scale. Governance, Operations, and Security perspectives address policies, infrastructure management, and risk control but lack this bridge function.

**Learn more:** [AWS CAF People Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-people-perspective/aws-caf-people-perspective.html) · [People perspective overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/people-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective focuses on real-time insights and answers questions about strategy?
questions.explanation:
The Business perspective of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework includes a Business Insights capability that uses analytics to deliver real-time insights, track performance metrics, and answer strategic business questions to support data-driven decisions. The Operations, People, and Platform perspectives instead focus on operational health, workforce readiness, and technical architecture, respectively.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF: Business Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/business-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service provides users with AWS issued reports, certifications, accreditations, and third-party attestations?
questions.explanation:
AWS Artifact is the compliance and attestation service providing on-demand access to AWS security and compliance reports (PCI, ISO, SOC, etc.). Trusted Advisor provides optimization recommendations, Health Dashboard shows service status, and Config tracks configuration changes—none provide compliance certifications and third-party attestations.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Artifact?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/what-is-aws-artifact.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company hosts its website on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs to ensure that the website reaches a global audience and provides minimum latency to users.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network that caches and serves content from edge locations worldwide, reducing latency for global users. It distributes both static and dynamic content, ensuring fast delivery to end users regardless of geographic location.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A user requires a relational database but lacks the resources to manage the hardware, resiliency, and replication.  
  
Which AWS service option satisfies the user's requirements?

options.text: Run MySQL on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).

questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS for MySQL is a managed relational database service. AWS handles underlying hardware provisioning and operational tasks such as backups, software patching, failure detection, recovery, and high-availability or replication capabilities, while MySQL remains the relational database engine.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon RDS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to track the monthly cost and usage of all Amazon EC2 instances in a specific AWS environment.  
  
Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Budgets allows you to track and monitor monthly costs and usage of AWS services including EC2 instances, with the ability to set custom alerts. AWS Cost Anomaly Detection identifies unusual spending patterns; AWS Compute Optimizer recommends instance type improvements; AWS Trusted Advisor provides optimization recommendations.\
\
**Learn more:** [Managing your costs with AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature enables a user to create a dedicated network connection between a company’s on-premises data center and the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation:
AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network connection between an on-premises network and AWS, enabling private connectivity to AWS resources without relying on the public internet path.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Direct Connect Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services can an organization use to implement a loosely coupled architecture? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Amazon SQS decouples distributed application components by placing a durable queue between message producers and consumers. AWS Step Functions coordinates components through managed workflows, which can decouple application dependencies. AWS Well-Architected guidance identifies Amazon SQS queues and AWS Step Functions as ways to introduce an intermediate layer for loose coupling.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework: Implement loosely coupled dependencies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2023-10-03/framework/rel_prevent_interaction_failure_loosely_coupled_system.html) · [Amazon SQS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sqs/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A developer needs to interact with AWS by using the AWS CLI.  
  
Which security feature or AWS service must be provisioned in the developer's account to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS CLI requires programmatic access credentials, specifically an AWS access key ID and secret access key. Username and password are for AWS Management Console access, not CLI programmatic access. AWS Systems Manager is a management service, and there is no such thing as a root password in AWS.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage access keys for IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_access-keys.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which task is the customer's responsibility, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Patch a guest operating system that is deployed on an Amazon EC2 instance.
Control physical access to an AWS data center.
Control access to AWS underlying hardware.
Patch a host operating system that is deployed on Amazon S3.

questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, customers are responsible for security \"in\" the cloud, which includes patching and maintaining the guest operating system on EC2 instances they manage. AWS handles physical data center access, control of the underlying hardware, and the infrastructure of managed services like S3, which have no customer-managed host OS.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A food delivery company needs to block users in certain countries from accessing its website.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS WAF supports geographic match conditions that let a company block or allow web requests based on the country the request originates from, making it well suited to blocking users in specific countries. AWS Control Tower governs multi-account setup, Amazon Fraud Detector identifies fraudulent activity, and Amazon Pinpoint is a customer engagement/messaging service, none of which perform geographic access control.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS WAF geographic match rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-geo-match.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company intends to migrate its database to a managed AWS service that is compatible with PostgreSQL.  
  
Which AWS services meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS supports PostgreSQL database instances as a managed service. Amazon Aurora provides a fully managed relational database engine that is compatible with PostgreSQL.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_PostgreSQL.html) · [What is Amazon Aurora?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective includes capabilities for configuration management and patch management?
questions.explanation:
The AWS CAF Operations perspective includes configuration management and patch management capabilities for maintaining workload configurations and systematically applying software updates.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF Operations perspective: configuration management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-operations-perspective/configuration-management.html) · [AWS CAF Operations perspective: patch management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-operations-perspective/patch-management.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which activity is AWS responsible for under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Configure identity and access management for applications.
Manage encryption options for data that is stored on AWS.
Configure security groups for Amazon EC2 instances.
Maintain the physical hardware of the infrastructure.

questions.explanation:
AWS maintains the underlying infrastructure that operates AWS services, including its physical hardware. Customers remain responsible for security in the cloud, such as IAM configuration, data-encryption choices, and security-group configuration. [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-risk-and-compliance/shared-responsibility-model.html)\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-risk-and-compliance/shared-responsibility-model.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: A company wants to learn more about the benefits of cloud computing and understand the operational advantage of agility. How does AWS deliver agility to users?

options.text: The ability the ensure high availability by deploying workloads to multiple regions
A pay-as-you-go model for many services and resources
The ability to transfer infrastructure management to the AWS Cloud
The ability to provision and deprovision resources quickly with minimal effort

questions.explanation:
AWS provides agility by enabling users to provision and deprovision resources rapidly with minimal effort, so they can adapt infrastructure to changing needs quickly.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which of the following is solely AWS's responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Development of an IAM password policy
Patching of the guest operating system

questions.explanation:
AWS fully manages the physical infrastructure and facilities that support its cloud services. Physical and environmental controls are inherited controls managed by AWS, whereas customers manage IAM policies, user training, and guest operating-system patching.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared responsibility — AWS Well-Architected Framework Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following AWS managed services is specifically used for extract, transform, and load (ETL) data?
questions.explanation:
AWS Glue is a fully managed ETL service that moves data between sources and targets while performing data transformations.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Glue concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/components-key-concepts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company deployed an application in multiple AWS Regions around the world. The company wants to improve the application’s performance and availability.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Global Accelerator improves application performance and availability for global users by routing traffic through AWS's optimized network infrastructure. Amazon DataZone (B) manages data governance, AWS Cloud Map (C) is for service discovery, and Auto Scaling (D) adjusts capacity but doesn't improve geographic performance.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html) · [AWS Global Accelerator](https://aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs a unified tool that offers a consistent way to interact with AWS services.  
  
Which AWS service or tool satisfies this requirement?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) is a unified tool that provides a consistent interface for interacting with AWS services from a command-line shell, including through scripts and automation.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Command Line Interface Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: A systems administrator created a new IAM user for a developer and assigned that user an access key rather than a username and password. What is the access key used for?

options.text: To access the AWS account as the AWS account root user
To access the AWS account through the AWS Management Console
To access the AWS account through a CLI
To access all of a company’s AWS accounts

questions.explanation:
IAM user access keys are programmatic credentials used to sign requests to AWS services, including requests made through the AWS CLI. Their permissions are limited by the IAM policies assigned to that user.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage access keys for IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_access-keys.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must track activity across its AWS accounts and determine when an API call is made against its AWS resources.  
  
Which AWS tool or service can fulfill these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records AWS account activity and events, including API calls made to AWS services and resources.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudTrail documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudtrail/) · [Understanding CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-events.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service provides one centralized location to track application-migration progress?
questions.explanation:
AWS Migration Hub provides a single place to discover servers, plan migrations, and track the status of each application migration, including progress reported by supported migration tools.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Migration Hub?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/migrationhub/latest/ug/whatishub.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A global company needs a managed security service to protect against SQL injection attacks. The service must also provide detailed logging information about access to the company’s ecommerce applications.  
  
Which AWS service satisfies these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS WAF protects web applications by inspecting web requests for malicious SQL code using SQL injection match rules. Its web ACL logging records detailed request and rule-match information for traffic accessing protected applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [SQL injection attack rule statement - AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html) · [Logging AWS WAF protection pack (web ACL) traffic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/logging.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate unstructured data to AWS. The data must be moved securely with in-transit encryption and end-to-end data validation.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS DataSync securely transfers unstructured data to AWS storage services. It encrypts transfer traffic in transit and validates data integrity using checksums, including configurable end-of-transfer verification.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html) · [Configuring how AWS DataSync verifies data integrity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/configure-data-verification-options.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services or features enable users to establish a network connection between two VPCs? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
VPC peering provides a direct private connection that routes traffic between two VPCs. AWS Transit Gateway acts as a central routing hub; attaching two VPCs to it and configuring routes enables connectivity between them.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is VPC peering?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/what-is-vpc-peering.html) · [Tutorial: Create an AWS Transit Gateway using the Amazon VPC Console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-getting-started-console.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company is designing workloads in the AWS Cloud. The company wants the workloads to perform their intended function correctly and consistently throughout their lifecycle.  
  
Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework does this goal represent?
questions.explanation:
The Reliability pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework focuses on the ability of a workload to perform its intended function correctly and consistently throughout its lifecycle. Operational excellence addresses building software correctly; Security addresses protecting workloads; Performance Efficiency addresses optimal resource utilization.\
\
**Learn more:** [Reliability - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/reliability.html) · [Reliability Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is designing workloads in the AWS Cloud. The company wants the workloads to perform their intended function correctly and consistently throughout their lifecycle.  
  
Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework does this goal represent?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is purpose-built for archival data that is accessed rarely (roughly quarterly or less) but must still be retrievable in milliseconds when needed, giving it the lowest storage cost among these options for infrequently accessed data such as an annual audit review. S3 Standard is priced for frequent access, S3 Outposts targets on-premises deployments, and Intelligent-Tiering starts objects in a higher-cost frequent-access tier (plus a monitoring fee) before they age into cheaper tiers, so it does not guarantee the lowest cost for data whose infrequent access pattern is already known.
**Learn more:** [S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/glacier/instant-retrieval/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to test a new application.  
  
Which AWS principle will help the company test the application?

options.text: Make long-term commitments in exchange for a cost discount.
Scale up and down when needed without any long-term commitments.
Have total control over the application infrastructure.
Manage all of the maintenance tasks associated with the cloud.

questions.explanation:
This describes the principle of elasticity—the ability to scale cloud resources up and down on-demand without long-term commitment. Elasticity is fundamental to cloud testing as it allows companies to provision resources for testing and tear them down afterward without financial penalty.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company needs to confirm whether multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for every user in its AWS accounts.  
  
Which AWS service or resource satisfies this requirement?
questions.explanation:
IAM credential reports provide a CSV inventory of IAM users and their credential status, including the `mfa_active` field, which is `TRUE` when an MFA device is enabled for a user.\
\
**Learn more:** [Generate credential reports for your AWS account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_getting-report.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company is learning about the perspectives of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF).  
  
Which perspective of the AWS CAF addresses the strategy management capability?
questions.explanation:
Strategy Management is one of the capabilities defined under the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework's Business Perspective, which focuses on ensuring cloud investments align with and accelerate an organization's business strategy and desired outcomes. The Governance Perspective instead covers capabilities such as portfolio management, program and project management, and risk/compliance oversight, not strategy formulation itself.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF: Strategy Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-business-perspective/strategy-management.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can be used to send both text and email messages from distributed applications?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) provides publisher-to-subscriber messaging for distributed applications and supports both email and SMS (text-message) delivery endpoints.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company is migrating its applications from on premises to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to ensure that the applications receive only the minimum permissions required to perform all operations.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) uses policies and roles to control application access to AWS resources. IAM supports least-privilege permissions by allowing only the actions on specific resources that an application needs to perform its tasks.\
\
**Learn more:** [Prepare for least-privilege permissions - AWS Identity and Access Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/getting-started-reduce-permissions.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is migrating its applications from on premises to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to ensure that the applications receive only the minimum permissions required to perform all operations.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?

options.text: Add EC2 instances in another Availability Zone.
Change the size and type of the EC2 instances based on utilization.
Convert the payment method from On-Demand to Savings Plans.
Reprovision the EC2 instances with a larger instance type.

questions.explanation:
Rightsizing means matching EC2 instance size and type to actual utilization patterns, which can be done directly through instance modification without re-architecting anything. Adding instances in another AZ addresses availability, not sizing; switching to Savings Plans changes the pricing model but not the instance configuration; and simply moving to a larger type without utilization data is the opposite of rightsizing.

**Learn more:** [AWS Compute Optimizer](https://aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/) · [Rightsizing recommendation preferences](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/rightsizing-preferences.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service provides DNS resolution?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Route 53 provides DNS resolution services across AWS infrastructure. CloudFront is a content delivery network, VPC is a virtual networking service, and Direct Connect enables dedicated network connections—only Route 53 performs DNS resolution.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Route 53?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company needs to generate a list of IAM users and view the status of credentials associated with those users, including passwords, access keys, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) devices.  
  
Which AWS service or feature meets these requirements?

options.text: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer

questions.explanation:
An IAM credential report lists all IAM users in an AWS account and shows the status of their IAM-managed credentials, including passwords, access keys, and MFA devices.\
\
**Learn more:** [Generate credential reports for your AWS account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_getting-report.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool provides rightsizing recommendations for Amazon EC2 resources at no extra cost?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cost Explorer provides rightsizing recommendations for idle and underutilized Amazon EC2 instances, including potential downsizing or termination actions and estimated savings.\
\
**Learn more:** [Optimizing your cost with rightsizing recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-rightsizing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following services can be used to prevent network traffic from reaching an instance? (Choose two.)

options.text: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) flow logs

questions.explanation:
Security groups control allowed inbound and outbound traffic for associated instances, while network ACLs control allowed and denied traffic at the subnet boundary. VPC Flow Logs, Amazon CloudWatch, and AWS CloudTrail record or monitor activity; they do not block network packets.\
\
**Learn more:** [Control traffic with security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-security-groups.html) · [Control subnet traffic with network ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service provides a relational database that is compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Aurora is a managed relational database service built for compatibility with MySQL and PostgreSQL.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon Aurora documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: When a user wants to use existing per-socket, per-core, or per-virtual-machine software licenses for a Microsoft Windows Server running on AWS, which Amazon EC2 instance type is required?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 Dedicated Hosts support bring-your-own-license use for existing per-socket, per-core, and per-VM software licenses, including Windows Server. They provide the dedicated physical host and socket/core visibility needed for those licensing models.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 Dedicated Hosts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-overview.html) · [Bring your own software licenses to Amazon EC2 Dedicated Hosts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-BYOL.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: What is the recommended use case for Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances?

options.text: A steady-state workload that requires a particular EC2 instance configuration for a long period of time
A workload that can be interrupted for a project that requires the lowest possible cost
An unpredictable workload that does not require a long-term commitment
A workload that is expected to run for longer than 1 year

questions.explanation:
On-Demand instances are ideal for unpredictable workloads without long-term commitments, with per-hour pricing and no upfront costs. Steady-state workloads (A) benefit from Reserved instances, interruptible workloads (B) use Spot instances for lower cost, and longer commitments (D) should use Reserved instances or Savings Plans for better pricing.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchasing On-Demand Instances for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-on-demand-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: What is the recommended use case for Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances?
questions.explanation:
Elasticity lets the company automatically scale compute resources up and down to match highly variable demand, and the pay-as-you-go model means it only pays for the resources it actually consumes, avoiding the cost of idle on-premises capacity sized for peak load. Reliability, security, and high availability are valuable cloud attributes but are not what specifically drives cost-effectiveness for a dynamic, spiky workload.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html) · [AWS Cloud Economics](https://aws.amazon.com/economics/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A user requires programmatic access to AWS resources by using the AWS CLI or AWS API.  
  
Which option provides the user with the appropriate access?

options.text: AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys

questions.explanation:
Access keys provide an access key ID and secret access key used to authenticate and sign programmatic requests to the AWS CLI or AWS API. AWS recommends temporary credentials where possible, but among these choices, access keys are the applicable credential type.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage access keys for IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_access-keys.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is planning to migrate a monolithic application to AWS. The company wants to modernize the application by splitting it into microservices. The company will deploy the microservices on AWS.  
  
Which migration strategy should the company use?
questions.explanation:
Refactor (re-architecting) involves redesigning and modernizing application architecture. Splitting a monolithic application into microservices is the definition of refactoring. Rehost means lift-and-shift migration without changes, Repurchase involves replacing with commercial software, and Replatform moves to cloud infrastructure without architectural changes.\
\
**Learn more:** [About the migration strategies (7 Rs)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/large-migration-guide/migration-strategies.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company is planning to migrate a monolithic application to AWS. The company wants to modernize the application by splitting it into microservices. The company will deploy the microservices on AWS.  
  
Which migration strategy should the company use?

options.text: Use the AWS account root user for daily access.
Use access keys and secret access keys on Amazon EC2.
Rotate credentials on a regular basis.
Create a shared set of access keys for system administrators.

questions.explanation:
AWS best practices for IAM include rotating credentials regularly to minimize the risk of unauthorized access if credentials are compromised, and enabling multi-factor authentication (MFA) for additional security layers. Using the root user for daily work, embedding keys in EC2 instances, and sharing credentials violate security principles.

**Learn more:** [Security best practices in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html) · [Multi-factor authentication in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_mfa.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to run CPU-intensive workload across multiple Amazon EC2 instances.  
  
Which EC2 instance type should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Compute optimized instances (the C-family) are built with a high ratio of vCPUs to memory and are designed for CPU-intensive workloads such as batch processing, high-performance computing, and media transcoding. General purpose, memory optimized, and storage optimized instance families are tuned for balanced workloads, memory-intensive applications, and high-throughput storage I/O, respectively, not raw compute demand.\
\
**Learn more:** [Specifications for Amazon EC2 compute optimized instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/instancetypes/co.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS security service automatically detects and classifies sensitive data or intellectual property?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Macie automatically discovers and classifies sensitive data in Amazon S3 using machine learning, pattern matching, and managed or custom data identifiers. Custom identifiers can detect intellectual property and proprietary data.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Macie?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html) · [Discovering sensitive data with Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/data-classification.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to integrate its online shopping website with social-media login credentials.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use for this integration?

options.text: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)

questions.explanation:
Amazon Cognito provides customer identity and access management for web applications and supports federation with social identity providers, allowing users to sign in with existing social-media accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configuring identity providers for your user pool – Amazon Cognito](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate data backups to the AWS Cloud. It must replace on-premises storage with cloud-based storage that is cached locally.  
  
Which AWS service satisfies these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Storage Gateway provides hybrid cloud storage by linking an on-premises appliance to AWS storage. Its cached volumes keep primary data in Amazon S3 while retaining frequently accessed data locally for low-latency access.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Volume Gateway? - AWS Storage Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company plans to launch an ecommerce website that contains many images for a product catalog. The company wants to keep the cost of running the website within a specific budget.  
  
Which AWS service or tool should the company use to monitor the ongoing costs of the website?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cost Explorer provides detailed cost visibility, analysis, and forecasting capabilities to monitor spending and ensure budgets are maintained. It visualizes costs by service, time period, and other dimensions, making it ideal for ongoing budget monitoring and cost optimization.\
\
**Learn more:** [Analyzing your costs and usage with AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS feature offers AWS users a no-cost platform to join community groups, ask questions, find answers, and read community-created articles about best practices?
questions.explanation:
AWS re:Post is a community-driven AWS service in the AWS Free Tier where users can interact with community experts, ask and answer technical questions, and access community-generated articles containing guidance and best practices.\
\
**Learn more:** [Introducing AWS re:Post, a new, community-driven questions-and-answers service](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2021/12/aws-repost-community-question-answer-service/) · [AWS re:Post introduces community-generated articles](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2022/07/aws-re-post-community-generated-articles/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company plans to adopt Amazon EC2 infrastructure and needs to scale several stateless services for short-term use.  
  
Which EC2 pricing model is **MOST** cost-efficient for these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances provide discounted spare EC2 capacity and are well suited to flexible, stateless workloads that can tolerate interruption and replacement. They are therefore the most cost-efficient option for short-term scaling of stateless services.\
\
**Learn more:** [Best practices for Amazon EC2 Spot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature enables users to capture information about network traffic in a VPC?
questions.explanation:
VPC Flow Logs captures information about IP traffic traveling to and from network interfaces in a VPC. The flow-log records can be used to monitor and troubleshoot network traffic patterns.\
\
**Learn more:** [Logging IP traffic using VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature enables users to capture information about network traffic in a VPC?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Aurora Serverless provides a PostgreSQL-compatible managed database that automatically adjusts compute capacity to workload demand and can scale down to zero ACUs with automatic pause when idle. This avoids provisioning and managing database server capacity for an infrequently used database.

**Learn more:** [How Aurora Serverless works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.how-it-works.html) · [Scaling to Zero ACUs with automatic pause and resume for Aurora Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2-auto-pause.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following AWS services are considered serverless? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS Lambda runs code without provisioning or managing servers, and AWS Fargate runs containers without requiring management of the underlying servers or EC2 instances.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Fargate or AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/decision-guides/latest/fargate-or-lambda/fargate-or-lambda.html) · [AWS Fargate](https://aws.amazon.com/fargate/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to create Amazon QuickSight dashboards each week using its billing data.  
  
Which AWS feature or tool can the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cost and Usage Report delivers detailed AWS billing and usage data to Amazon S3 and can be configured for integration with Amazon QuickSight, making it suitable for recurring cost dashboards.\
\
**Learn more:** [What are AWS Cost and Usage Reports?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html) · [Creating a cost and usage dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/dataexports-create-dashboard.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company requires an automated process that continuously scans its Amazon EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Inspector automatically discovers workloads and continually scans Amazon EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities, producing findings when vulnerabilities are detected.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html) · [Scanning Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ec2.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company requires an automated process that continuously scans its Amazon EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Trusted Advisor inspects AWS environments and provides recommendations for optimization, security, fault tolerance, and cost efficiency. It enables ongoing monitoring to prevent regression after rightsizing and security reviews. AWS Health Dashboard tracks service status; Amazon Connect is for customer support; AWS Systems Manager manages operations.

**Learn more:** [Get started with AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/get-started-with-aws-trusted-advisor.html) · [AWS Trusted Advisor check reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor-check-reference.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to use Amazon S3 to store audio files that are each 5 megabytes in size. The company will rarely access the files, but the company must be able to retrieve the files immediately.  
  
Which S3 storage class will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation:
S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) is cost-optimized for infrequently accessed data that requires immediate retrieval. It has lower storage costs than S3 Standard but can be retrieved instantly. S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval has 1–5 minute retrieval time and is suited for archival, not immediate access. Standard is too expensive for infrequent data.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can a company use to manage encryption keys in the cloud?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudHSM provides a cloud-based hardware security module for generating, storing, and managing encryption keys with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 validation. Organizations maintain exclusive control over encryption keys without AWS access, meeting stringent compliance and key management requirements. AWS Certificate Manager is for managing digital certificates, not encryption keys.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS CloudHSM?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudhsm/latest/userguide/introduction.html) · [Keys in AWS CloudHSM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudhsm/latest/userguide/whatis-hsm-keys.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS service can a company use to manage encryption keys in the cloud?

options.text: AWS trains the company's staff on the use of all the AWS services.
AWS manages all security in the cloud.
AWS offers free support from technical account managers (TAMs).

questions.explanation:
AWS infrastructure and Availability Zones enable highly available workload architectures, while the aggregated demand of AWS customers produces economies of scale and lower variable costs. Security remains a shared responsibility between AWS and the customer.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html) · [Shared Responsibility Model for Resiliency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/shared-responsibility-model-for-resiliency.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company's employees are working from home. The company wants its employees to use their personal devices to connect to a managed workstation in the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to provide the remote environment?
questions.explanation:
Amazon WorkSpaces is a Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) solution that provides managed cloud desktops accessible from personal devices via web or client application. AWS Cloud9 is a cloud IDE, AWS Outposts brings AWS infrastructure on-premises, and Amazon Lightsail is lightweight compute—none provide managed virtual desktop environments.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon WorkSpaces?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces/latest/adminguide/amazon-workspaces.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or resource can be used to identify services that a user has used within a specified date range?

options.text: AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer

questions.explanation:
AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer analyzes AWS CloudTrail logs to identify the actions and services that an IAM entity, such as a user, used during a specified date range.\
\
**Learn more:** [Using AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/what-is-access-analyzer.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or resource can be used to identify services that a user has used within a specified date range?
questions.explanation:
AWS Auto Scaling monitors applications and automatically adjusts EC2 capacity up or down to maintain steady, predictable performance in response to demand changes, at the lowest possible cost since you only pay for the capacity you actually need at any given time. AWS Compute Optimizer only recommends sizing, Cost Explorer only analyzes spend, and the Well-Architected Framework is a set of guidance, not an operational scaling mechanism.

**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/plans/userguide/what-is-aws-auto-scaling.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has launched an Amazon EC2 instance using the latest Amazon Linux 2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI).  
  
Which actions can a system administrator use to connect to the EC2 instance? (Choose two.)

options.text: Use a Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) connection.
Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.

questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 Instance Connect provides SSH access to supported Linux instances, including current Amazon Linux 2 AMIs. AWS Systems Manager Session Manager can also open an interactive shell on a managed EC2 instance when the required SSM agent and IAM configuration are present. RDP is a Windows connection method, while AWS Batch and Amazon Connect do not provide administrative logon to EC2 instances.

**Learn more:** [Connect to your EC2 instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/connect.html) · [Connect your Amazon EC2 instance using Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/connect-with-systems-manager-session-manager.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which recommendation can AWS Cost Explorer provide to help reduce cost?

options.text: Change the programming language for an application.

questions.explanation:
AWS Cost Explorer's rightsizing and usage recommendations identify underutilized or idle EC2 instances and recommend terminating or downsizing them to reduce spend. It does not make recommendations about database engines, programming languages, or operating systems, since those are architectural decisions outside its cost-analysis scope.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Cost Explorer](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/aws-cost-explorer/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service can generate information that can be used by external auditors?
questions.explanation:
AWS Config records and tracks AWS resource configuration changes over time, providing audit trails and compliance information for external auditors. It generates detailed inventory and change history. Amazon Cognito handles authentication, FSx is a file system, and Inspector performs vulnerability assessments.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to configure its workloads to carry out their intended functions and recover rapidly from failures.  
  
Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar corresponds to these objectives?
questions.explanation:
The Reliability pillar focuses on workloads performing their intended functions correctly and consistently, including designing for resilience and recovery from failures.\
\
**Learn more:** [Reliability - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/reliability.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service enables you to manage infrastructure as code?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudFormation lets you define AWS resources in templates and provision or manage them as stacks, treating infrastructure as code.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudFormation Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudformation/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) capability is part of the people perspective?
questions.explanation:
Cloud fluency is a People perspective capability in AWS CAF. It focuses on developing the organization’s digital acumen and workforce capability to confidently and effectively use the cloud to accelerate business outcomes.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF People perspective: culture and change](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/people-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is migrating an on-premises server to an Amazon EC2 instance. The server must remain running continuously for the next 12 months.  
  
Which EC2 pricing option is the **MOST** cost-effective for the company’s workload?
questions.explanation:
Reserved Instances reduce Amazon EC2 costs through a one- or three-year commitment to a consistent instance configuration. A continuously running server with predictable 12-month usage fits this commitment model, while Spot Instances do not guarantee uninterrupted operation.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html) · [How billing works with Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts-reserved-instances-application.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to improve employee productivity by providing a way for employees to search for questions and retrieve specific answers. The company wants to use a single intelligent search interface.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Kendra is an intelligent enterprise search service powered by machine learning that enables natural language queries and extracts precise answers from documents, PDFs, and unstructured content. It improves employee productivity by simplifying information retrieval through a unified search interface.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Kendra?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kendra/latest/dg/what-is-kendra.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following can be components of a VPC in the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
A VPC comprises networking components that segments and isolates resources. Subnets are address segments within the VPC where resources are deployed, and Internet Gateways enable communication between VPC instances and the internet. API Gateway is a standalone service, S3 buckets exist at the account level outside VPCs, and Storage Gateway connects on-premises infrastructure to AWS storage.\
\
**Learn more:** [How Amazon VPC works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/how-it-works.html) · [Enable internet access using an internet gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company has an AWS Business Support plan. The company needs to gain access to the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to help mitigate DDoS events.  
  
Which AWS service or resource must the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Shield Advanced provides enhanced DDoS protection and, when combined with Business or Enterprise Support, includes access to the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) for assistance during active attacks. AWS Shield Standard is automatically included for all customers but does not provide DRT access, and WAF and Enterprise Support alone do not grant this capability.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shield Advanced](https://aws.amazon.com/shield/features/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company has an AWS Business Support plan. The company needs to gain access to the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to help mitigate DDoS events.  
  
Which AWS service or resource must the company use to meet these requirements?

options.text: Use inline policies instead of customer managed policies.
Grant maximum privileges to IAM users.
Use groups to assign permissions to IAM users.

questions.explanation:
IAM best practices emphasize creating individual user accounts rather than sharing credentials (eliminating option A), and using IAM groups to manage permissions at scale (making group-based assignment far more maintainable than individual policy assignments). Customer-managed policies are also preferred over inline policies for reusability, and the principle of least privilege—not maximum privileges—is fundamental to secure access control.

**Learn more:** [Security best practices in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html) · [IAM user groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_groups.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to manage its AWS Cloud resources by using a web interface.  
  
Which AWS service fulfills this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Management Console is the browser-based interface for viewing, configuring, and managing AWS resources and services.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Management Console](https://aws.amazon.com/console/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which tasks are the responsibility of AWS according to the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)

options.text: Configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).
Configure security groups on Amazon EC2 instances.
Secure the access of physical AWS facilities.
Patch applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances.

questions.explanation:
AWS responsibilities include securing physical data center access (C) and performing infrastructure patching and maintenance (E). Customers are responsible for IAM configuration, security group settings, and patching their own applications running on AWS.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company is moving to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to understand and identify potential security misconfigurations or unexpected behaviors. The company also wants to prioritize any protective controls it may require.  
  
Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) security perspective capability meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS CAF threat detection uses logging and monitoring to understand and identify potential security misconfigurations, threats, and unexpected behaviors. Understanding security threats enables an organization to prioritize protective controls.\
\
**Learn more:** [Security control recommendations for logging and monitoring](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/security-controls-by-caf-capability/logging-and-monitoring-controls.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which design principles align with the reliability pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Choose two.)

options.text: Deploy resources globally to improve response time.

questions.explanation:
The Reliability Pillar calls for automated recovery when failures occur and for adapting capacity to demand so resource saturation does not cause failures. AWS describes this capacity approach as monitoring demand and utilization, then automatically adding or removing resources to maintain the appropriate capacity level.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework — Reliability Pillar design principles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/design-principles.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can manage permissions for AWS resources by using policies?
questions.explanation:
AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) lets administrators create and attach policies that grant or deny permissions to access AWS resources for users, groups, and roles. Amazon Inspector, Amazon Detective, and Amazon GuardDuty are security assessment and threat-detection services, not services for defining resource permissions.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Identity and Access Management](https://aws.amazon.com/iam/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can manage permissions for AWS resources by using policies?
questions.explanation:
AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway provides cloud-backed virtual tape storage and exposes tape drives and a media changer to existing client backup applications as iSCSI devices. This lets the company continue its existing tape-backup workflow while moving backup capacity to AWS.

**Learn more:** [What is Tape Gateway? - AWS Storage Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html) · [Requirements for setting up Tape Gateway - AWS Storage Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/Requirements.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to store its files in the AWS Cloud. Users need to be able to download these files directly using a public URL.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 enables storing files and generating public URLs for direct downloads. Users can configure bucket policies and object permissions to make files publicly accessible. S3 is the appropriate service for file storage with URL-based access. Redshift is a data warehouse, EBS provides block storage, and EFS provides file system storage without public URL capabilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is Amazon S3?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to gather information about its on-premises data center.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Application Discovery Service collects usage and configuration data about on-premises servers and databases to help plan cloud migration. It provides insights into dependencies and resource utilization. DataSync transfers data; Storage Gateway bridges on-premises storage; and DMS migrates databases specifically.\
\
