**Learn more:** [What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company intends to migrate to the AWS Cloud. As part of its cloud transformation journey, the company wants to use the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) to define and track business outcomes.  
  
Which AWS CAF governance perspective capability meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Benefits management is the AWS CAF Governance perspective capability for defining and tracking business outcomes. It incorporates business-aligned metrics and KPIs to measure value realization throughout the cloud transformation journey.\
\
**Learn more:** [Benefits management – AWS Cloud Adoption Framework: Governance Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-governance-perspective/benefits-management.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company requires a central user portal through which users can sign in to third-party business applications that support Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0.  
  
Which AWS service satisfies this requirement?

options.text: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)

questions.explanation:
AWS IAM Identity Center provides a central AWS access portal for workforce users and supports federated single sign-on to assigned SAML 2.0 third-party applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [Single sign-on access to SAML 2.0 and OAuth 2.0 applications - AWS IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/customermanagedapps-saml2-oauth2.html) · [Customer managed applications - AWS IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/customermanagedapps.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service gives on-premises applications low-latency access to data stored in the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation:
AWS Storage Gateway integrates on-premises applications with AWS storage using standard storage protocols and local caching, enabling low-latency access to frequently used cloud data.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Storage Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS tool enables users to plan their service usage, service costs, and instance reservations, while also letting them configure custom alerts when costs or usage exceed defined thresholds?
questions.explanation:
AWS Budgets lets users create cost, usage, Reserved Instance utilization, and Reserved Instance coverage budgets, with notifications when actual or forecasted amounts cross configured thresholds.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Billing and Cost Management API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html) · [Best practices for AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Who enables encryption for data at rest on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)?
questions.explanation:
AWS customers enable Amazon EBS encryption either when creating a volume or by enabling encryption by default for their account and Region. Amazon EBS uses AWS KMS keys for the encryption, but AWS KMS is not the entity that enables the setting.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html) · [Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
An administrator observed that multiple AWS resources were deleted yesterday.  
  
Which AWS service will help identify the cause and determine which user deleted the resources?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records all API calls and actions within an AWS account, creating an audit trail that includes who performed each action, what action was performed, when it occurred, and from where. This enables administrators to investigate resource deletions and identify responsible users. Amazon Inspector assesses vulnerabilities, Amazon GuardDuty detects threats, and AWS Trusted Advisor provides recommendations.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which choice describes an environment made up of one or more data centers?
questions.explanation:
An Availability Zone consists of one or more discrete data centers in an AWS Region, with redundant power, networking, and connectivity.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Regions and Availability Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-infrastructure/latest/regions/aws-regions-availability-zones.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which choice describes an environment made up of one or more data centers?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Detective specializes in security investigation and uses machine learning, statistical analysis, and graph theory to analyze logs from EC2 instances, VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, and GuardDuty findings. It builds interactive visualizations to identify root causes of security issues, making it ideal for forensic analysis. Inspector performs vulnerability scanning, QuickSight is a BI tool, and GuardDuty detects threats but does not provide detailed investigation capabilities.

**Learn more:** [Amazon Detective](https://aws.amazon.com/detective/) · [What is Amazon Detective?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/what-is-detective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which of the following describes a characteristic of the AWS account root user?

options.text: The root user is the only user that can be configured with multi-factor authentication (MFA).
The root user is the only user that can access the AWS Management Console.
The root user is the first sign-in identity that is available when an AWS account is created.
The root user has a password that cannot be changed.

questions.explanation:
The AWS account root user is the single initial sign-in identity created with an AWS account and has complete access to the account’s AWS services and resources.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS Support plans provide access to an AWS technical account manager (TAM)? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Technical Account Managers (TAMs) are provided as part of AWS Enterprise On-Ramp Support and Enterprise Support plans. Both higher-tier support levels include dedicated TAM resources to help optimize AWS usage and architecture. Developer and Business Support plans do not include TAM access.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Support Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/aws-support-plans.html) · [Compare AWS Support Plans](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company requires a content delivery network that securely delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs to users worldwide with low latency and high transfer speeds.  
  
Which AWS service fulfills these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudFront is AWS’s global CDN. It uses edge locations to securely deliver content, video, applications, and APIs close to users, reducing latency and improving transfer speed.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html) · [Amazon CloudFront](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company needs to set up a schedule to rotate database user credentials.  
  
Which AWS service supports this requirement with the **LEAST** operational overhead?
questions.explanation:
AWS Secrets Manager centrally stores database credentials and can automatically rotate them on a configured schedule, updating both the stored secret and the database credentials. This built-in rotation capability minimizes operational overhead.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html) · [Set up automatic rotation for database secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_turn-on-for-db.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to set up a schedule to rotate database user credentials.  
  
Which AWS service supports this requirement with the **LEAST** operational overhead?
questions.explanation:
AWS Budgets tracks historical cost and usage data and generates automated reports for quarterly planning. Amazon Detective (A) is for security investigation, AWS Pricing Calculator (B) estimates future costs rather than tracking historical data, and AWS Savings Plans (D) is a cost optimization purchasing option without reporting capabilities.

**Learn more:** [Reporting your metrics with AWS Budgets Reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/reporting-cost-budget.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following are benefits of moving to the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)

options.text: Users can implement all AWS services in seconds.
AWS assumes all responsibility for the security of infrastructure and applications.
Users experience increased speed and agility.
Users benefit from massive economies of scale.
Users can move hardware from their data center to the AWS Cloud.

questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud customers can provision IT resources quickly, increasing organizational speed and agility. Aggregated demand across many AWS customers also creates massive economies of scale, which can reduce variable costs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature enhances network performance by routing traffic through the AWS global network infrastructure?
questions.explanation:
AWS Global Accelerator routes traffic over the AWS global network to optimal endpoints, improving application performance by using AWS’s worldwide network infrastructure rather than multiple public-internet hops.\
\
**Learn more:** [How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service uses speech-to-text conversion to help users create meeting notes?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Transcribe converts speech audio to text, enabling automated transcription of meeting recordings for note creation. Amazon Polly does the opposite (text-to-speech); Amazon Textract extracts text from images/documents; and Amazon Rekognition analyzes image and video content.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon Transcribe - Speech to Text](https://aws.amazon.com/transcribe/) · [Generate meeting notes using Amazon Transcribe and Amazon Comprehend](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/generate-high-quality-meeting-notes-using-amazon-transcribe-and-amazon-comprehend/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A user is moving a workload from a local data center to an architecture that is distributed between the local data center and the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which type of migration is this?
questions.explanation:
Migration from a pure on-premises environment to a hybrid architecture distributes workloads between the local data center and the AWS Cloud. This represents the transition to a hybrid cloud model, enabling organizations to gradually adopt cloud services while maintaining on-premises infrastructure.\
\
**Learn more:** [Types of Cloud Computing](https://aws.amazon.com/types-of-cloud-computing/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can organizations use to create infrastructure from code?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudFormation uses JSON or YAML templates to model and provision AWS resources as infrastructure as code, creating and managing them together as stacks.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudFormation Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudformation/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service can organizations use to create infrastructure from code?

options.text: Create an IAM user account for the auditor, granting the auditor administrator permissions.
Take a screenshot of each user's page in the AWS Management Console, then provide the screenshots to the auditor.
Download the IAM credential report, then provide the report to the auditor.
Download the AWS Trusted Advisor report, then provide the report to the auditor.

questions.explanation:
An IAM credential report provides a downloadable list of all IAM users in an AWS account and the status of their credentials, including passwords, access keys, MFA devices, and signing certificates. It is intended to support auditing and compliance activities.

**Learn more:** [Generate credential reports for your AWS account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_getting-report.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool provides recommendations to help users get rightsized Amazon EC2 instances based on historical workload usage data?
questions.explanation:
AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes EC2 instance configuration and historical utilization metrics to provide rightsizing recommendations that reduce costs and improve performance. AWS Pricing Calculator (A) estimates costs without analyzing usage, AWS App Runner (C) deploys containerized applications, and AWS Systems Manager (D) manages resources but doesn't provide rightsizing analysis.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Compute Optimizer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/what-is-compute-optimizer.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to consolidate its call centers to improve the customer voice and chat experience with call center agents.  
  
Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Connect is a cloud-based contact center service that consolidates voice and chat channels into a unified platform. It allows companies to efficiently manage multiple call centers with advanced routing, IVR, and agent tools while reducing operational complexity.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/adminguide/what-is-amazon-connect.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Where can users find examples of AWS Cloud solution designs?
questions.explanation:
AWS Architecture Center is the dedicated resource where users can discover, explore, and learn from AWS solution designs and reference architectures. It provides best practices and real-world examples for building cloud-based applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Architecture Center](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/) · [AWS Reference Architecture Diagrams](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/reference-architecture-diagrams/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS offering can analyze a company’s AWS environment to discover security vulnerabilities on Amazon EC2 instances?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Inspector is a vulnerability management service that automatically scans EC2 instances, ECR container images, and Lambda functions to identify security vulnerabilities and compliance issues. It's the primary tool for discovering software vulnerabilities in EC2 environments.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which benefit of the AWS Cloud helps companies achieve lower usage costs because of the aggregate usage of all AWS users?

options.text: Ability to go global in minutes

questions.explanation:
Economies of scale enable AWS to distribute infrastructure costs across millions of customers, reducing per-unit costs and allowing price reductions passed to end users. No capacity guessing addresses predictability, going global in minutes addresses speed, and increased agility addresses responsiveness—none relate to aggregate usage savings.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has data lakes designed for high performance computing (HPC) workloads.  
  
Which Amazon EC2 instance type should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Compute optimized EC2 instances are designed for compute-intensive workloads and are the standard choice for high-performance computing (HPC) applications including batch processing, scientific modeling, and data analysis. General purpose (A) lacks specialized compute power, memory optimized (C) is for in-memory workloads, and storage optimized (D) is for data-intensive operations—not the primary HPC requirement.\
\
**Learn more:** [Specifications for Amazon EC2 compute optimized instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/instancetypes/co.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet. The company needs to initiate an internet connection to download operating system updates while preventing internet traffic from accessing the EC2 instance.  
  
Which AWS managed service enables this?
questions.explanation:
A public NAT gateway lets instances in a private subnet initiate outbound connections to the internet, such as for operating-system updates, while preventing the internet from initiating unsolicited connections to those instances.\
\
**Learn more:** [NAT gateways - Amazon VPC User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company has a test AWS environment and plans to test an application in AWS. The application testing may be interrupted and does not need to run continuously.  
  
Which Amazon EC2 purchasing option will satisfy these requirements **MOST** cost-effectively?
questions.explanation:
Spot Instances provide discounted spare Amazon EC2 capacity and are specifically cost-effective for workloads that are flexible about when they run and can tolerate interruptions, including test and development workloads.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html) · [Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective focuses on managing identities and permissions at scale?
questions.explanation:
The Security perspective of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework focuses on protecting information, systems, and assets while managing identities and permissions at scale. Identity and Access Management is a core responsibility of this perspective.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF: Security Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-security-perspective/aws-caf-security-perspective.html) · [AWS Cloud Adoption Framework](https://aws.amazon.com/cloud-adoption-framework/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective focuses on managing identities and permissions at scale?

options.text: Use EC2 instances in multiple edge locations.
Use EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone but in different AWS Regions.
Use Amazon CloudFront with the EC2 instances configured as the source.
Use EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone but in different AWS accounts.

questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudFront can use an Amazon EC2 instance as its origin and cache the static website at globally distributed edge locations. Viewer requests are routed to a nearby CloudFront point of presence, reducing latency.

**Learn more:** [How CloudFront delivers content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/HowCloudFrontWorks.html) · [Origin - Amazon CloudFront API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/latest/APIReference/API_Origin.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which resource is best for a user to locate AWS compliance-related information and reports?
questions.explanation:
AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS security and compliance documents, including compliance reports and certifications such as SOC, ISO, and PCI reports.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Artifact?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/what-is-aws-artifact.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A developer needs to deploy an application rapidly on AWS without manually provisioning the necessary resources.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk lets developers upload an application while AWS automatically handles capacity provisioning, load balancing, scaling, and health monitoring, eliminating the need to manually create the underlying resources.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Elastic Beanstalk Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elastic-beanstalk/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs a petabyte-scale data warehouse to analyze its data. The company requires a solution that does not need manual hardware or software management.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Redshift is a fully managed, petabyte-scale cloud data warehouse designed for analytics, so AWS manages the underlying infrastructure and software administration.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which Amazon S3 feature or storage class uses the AWS backbone network and edge locations to reduce latency between the end user and Amazon S3?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration routes transfers through globally distributed edge locations and then over an optimized AWS network path to Amazon S3, minimizing latency caused by geographic distance.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configuring fast, secure file transfers using Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to deploy some of its resources in the AWS Cloud. To satisfy regulatory requirements, data must stay local and on premises. Low latency is required between AWS and the company's resources.  
  
Which AWS service or feature can meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Outposts extends AWS infrastructure and services to a customer’s on-premises location. It supports local data processing and data residency while placing compute and storage close to on-premises applications for low latency.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool can capture information about inbound and outbound traffic within an Amazon VPC?
questions.explanation:
VPC Flow Logs captures information about IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in an Amazon VPC, subnet, or network interface.\
\
**Learn more:** [Logging IP traffic using VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to connect its supported AWS services and VPCs. The company does not want to expose its internal traffic to the public internet.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS PrivateLink enables secure, private network connectivity between VPCs and AWS services without exposing traffic to the public internet. It uses private IP addresses and AWS internal networks, providing a secure alternative to internet gateway-based communication.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS PrivateLink?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/what-is-privatelink.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service offers highly durable object storage?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 is AWS object storage, designed to store and retrieve objects with very high durability. Amazon EFS and Amazon FSx are file-storage services, and Amazon EBS is block storage.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon S3 User Guide — What is Amazon S3?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to give users in one AWS account access to resources in a different AWS account. The users currently lack permission to access those resources.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
An IAM role can be configured with a cross-account trust policy, allowing authorized users or roles from another AWS account to assume it and receive the permissions required for the target resources.\
\
**Learn more:** [IAM roles for cross-account access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html) · [Cross account resource access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies-cross-account-resource-access.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature allows users to securely store encrypted credentials and retrieve these credentials when required?
questions.explanation:
AWS Secrets Manager enables secure storage and management of sensitive credentials such as database passwords, API keys, and other secrets. It provides fine-grained access control through IAM policies and supports automatic secret rotation.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud service can notify customers when custom spending thresholds are exceeded?
questions.explanation:
AWS Budgets lets customers define custom cost or usage budgets and configure notifications when actual or forecasted spending exceeds a specified threshold.\
\
**Learn more:** [Creating a usage budget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/create-usage-budget.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: In what ways does AWS Cloud computing help businesses lower costs? (Choose two.)

options.text: AWS charges the same prices for services in every AWS Region.
AWS enables capacity to be adjusted on demand.
AWS offers discounts for Amazon EC2 instances that remain idle for more than 1 week.
AWS does not charge for data sent from the AWS Cloud to the internet.
AWS eliminates many of the costs of building and maintaining on-premises data centers.

questions.explanation:
AWS provides on-demand capacity that can scale up or down as demand changes, helping avoid overprovisioned and idle infrastructure costs. Using AWS also removes many expenses associated with building, operating, powering, and maintaining on-premises data centers.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company requires an AWS service that provides a clear baseline of what it runs in its on-premises data centers. The company also needs projected costs for running its on-premises workloads in the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which AWS service or tool meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Migration Evaluator creates a baseline of an organization’s on-premises environment and projects AWS costs based on measured on-premises provisioning and utilization, supporting a migration business case.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Migration Evaluator features](https://aws.amazon.com/migration-evaluator/features/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service offers command-line access to AWS tools and resources directly through a web browser?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudShell is a browser-based shell for managing AWS services with the AWS CLI and preinstalled development tools.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudShell Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudshell/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service offers command-line access to AWS tools and resources directly through a web browser?
questions.explanation:
AWS Managed Services (AMS) is designed to help enterprises adopt and operate AWS at scale, and a core part of that operational scope is establishing and managing the landing zone and network foundation — accounts, connectivity, security controls, and governance — before any workloads are onboarded. Custom application development and DevSecOps pipeline configuration are outside AMS's operational-support scope, and application log monitoring is only one narrow monitoring capability rather than the feature that defines AMS's overall scope.

**Learn more:** [AWS Managed Services Now Offers Managed Landing Zones](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2019/10/aws-managed-services-now-offers-managed-landing-zones/) · [AMS Network architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/managedservices/latest/userguide/ams-net-arch.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants a solution that will automatically adjust the number of Amazon EC2 instances that are being used based on the current load.  
  
Which AWS offering will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups automatically launch or terminate instances based on demand or defined scaling policies, keeping the number of running instances aligned with current load. Dedicated Hosts and Reserved Instances are billing and hardware-allocation options, and placement groups only control how instances are physically arranged, none of which adjust instance count automatically.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/autoscaling/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants a solution that will automatically adjust the number of Amazon EC2 instances that are being used based on the current load.  
  
Which AWS offering will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store provides centralized, hierarchical storage for configuration data and passwords. Passwords can be stored as KMS-encrypted `SecureString` parameters, and the standard parameter tier has no additional charge. AWS Secrets Manager is preferable when advanced capabilities such as automatic secret rotation are required, but those requirements are not stated.

**Learn more:** [AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html) · [Understanding Parameter Store parameter types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/what-is-a-parameter.html)

Which AWS service or resource can identify and provide reports on IAM resources in one AWS account that is shared with another AWS account?

options.text: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer

questions.explanation:
AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer identifies and reports on IAM resources and policies shared across AWS accounts, providing visibility into cross-account access and external resource sharing. It analyzes resource-based policies to determine what access is permitted outside the account. IAM Credential Report displays user credentials and access keys, IAM Identity Center (SSO) manages workforce access, and Cognito handles app authentication—none analyze cross-account resource sharing.

**Learn more:** [Using AWS IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/what-is-access-analyzer.html) · [IAM Access Analyzer](https://aws.amazon.com/iam/access-analyzer/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company is migrating its public website to AWS. The company wants to host the domain name for the website on AWS.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Route 53 is AWS's managed Domain Name System (DNS) service. It allows companies to register and manage domain names, configure DNS routing policies, and perform health checks. Lambda is serverless compute, CloudFront is a content delivery network, and Direct Connect provides dedicated network connectivity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Registering and managing domains using Amazon Route 53](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/registrar.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company migrated to the AWS Cloud. Now the company pays for services on an as-needed basis.  
  
Which advantage of cloud computing is the company benefiting from?

options.text: Stop spending money running and maintaining data centers
Trade fixed expense for variable expense

questions.explanation:
Trading fixed expense for variable expense directly describes the pay-as-you-go model. By using cloud services, the company converts upfront capital investments in data centers into ongoing operational expenses that scale with usage. The other options describe other cloud benefits (reduced operational burden, faster time to market, global reach) but don't address the payment model.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company's compliance officer wants to review the AWS Service Organization Control (SOC) reports.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should the compliance officer use to complete this task?
questions.explanation:
AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS compliance reports, including Service Organization Control (SOC), PCI DSS, and ISO certifications. AWS Support and Concierge Support can assist with general questions but do not provide direct access to compliance documents. AWS Trusted Advisor focuses on optimization recommendations.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Artifact?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/what-is-aws-artifact.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company stores a large volume of data in AWS and wants to determine whether any of that data should be classified as sensitive.  
  
Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Macie discovers and helps classify sensitive data, including through automated sensitive-data discovery and targeted discovery jobs for Amazon S3 data. It uses machine learning and pattern matching to identify sensitive information.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Macie?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which capabilities are benefits of the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)

options.text: Trade variable expenses for capital expenses.
Plan capacity in advance of deployments.
Take advantage of economies of scale.

questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud enables applications to be deployed across multiple Regions globally in minutes and delivers lower variable costs through massive economies of scale. AWS instead trades fixed capital expenses for variable expenses, reduces the need to forecast capacity, and still relies on network connectivity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing – Overview of Amazon Web Services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
An AWS user wants to proactively detect when an instance or account might be compromised or if there are threats from attacks.  
  
Which AWS service should the user choose?
questions.explanation:
Amazon GuardDuty is a managed threat detection service that continuously monitors AWS environments for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior. AWS WAF protects web applications, AWS Shield defends against DDoS attacks, and Amazon Inspector scans for vulnerabilities—none provide proactive threat detection like GuardDuty.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: At which support level do users gain access to a support concierge?
questions.explanation:
Enterprise Support includes concierge-style, white-glove billing assistance; Basic, Developer, and Business Support do not include that Enterprise-level concierge benefit.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Support plan comparison](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to deliver managed Windows virtual desktops and applications to its remote employees through secure network connections.  
  
Which AWS services can the company use to fulfill these requirements? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Amazon AppStream 2.0 provides fully managed streaming access to desktop applications, while Amazon WorkSpaces provisions managed virtual cloud desktops that can run Microsoft Windows. These services address application delivery and managed Windows desktop access for remote users.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon WorkSpaces?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces/latest/adminguide/amazon-workspaces.html) · [What Is Amazon WorkSpaces Applications?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/what-is-appstream.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company intends to migrate to AWS and needs to produce cost estimates for its AWS use cases.  
  
Which AWS service or tool can the company use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Pricing Calculator lets organizations model planned AWS services and usage for specific use cases, then generate projected cost estimates. It is suitable for planning a migration before the workloads are running.\
\
**Learn more:** [Generate an estimate in AWS Pricing Calculator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pricing-calculator/latest/userguide/generate-estimate.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, who is responsible for managing IAM user access and secret keys?

options.text: IAM access and secret keys are static, so there is no need to rotate them.
The customer is responsible for rotating keys.
AWS will rotate the keys whenever required.
The AWS Support team will rotate keys when requested by the customer.

questions.explanation:
Customers are responsible for securing and managing IAM users and their long-term access keys, including rotating them. IAM user access keys remain valid until they are manually revoked or rotated; AWS does not automatically rotate them.\
\
**Learn more:** [Secure access keys - AWS Identity and Access Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/securing_access-keys.html) · [Manage access keys for IAM users - AWS Identity and Access Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_access-keys.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is using multiple AWS accounts for different business teams. The finance team wants to receive one bill for all of the company's accounts.  
  
Which AWS service or tool should the finance team use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Organizations provides consolidated billing, allowing a company to combine usage across all member accounts into a single bill and take advantage of pooled volume discounts. Trusted Advisor gives recommendations, Cost Explorer and Budgets analyze and alert on spend, but neither aggregates multiple accounts into one bill the way Organizations does.\
\
**Learn more:** [Consolidated Billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_consolidated-billing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company requires a web application to interact with multiple AWS services.  
  
Which AWS service or resource meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Management Console is a web-based application that provides centralized access to individual AWS service consoles, enabling users to interact with and manage AWS services through a graphical interface.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is the AWS Management Console?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsconsolehelpdocs/latest/gsg/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has applications that control on-premises factory equipment.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to run these applications with the LEAST latency?
questions.explanation:
AWS Outposts extends AWS infrastructure and services directly onto customer on-premises hardware, allowing applications that control local factory equipment to run with local, low-latency access rather than reaching back to a distant AWS Region. EC2, Lambda, and Fargate as standard offerings run in AWS Regions and would introduce network latency to on-premises equipment.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Outposts](https://aws.amazon.com/outposts/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to store data in Amazon S3. The company accesses the data rarely, and the data can be regenerated if needed. The company wants to use the most cost-effective storage class.  
  
Which S3 storage class meets this requirement?

options.text: S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

questions.explanation:
S3 One Zone-IA is intended for infrequently accessed, recreatable data. It stores objects in a single Availability Zone, making it less expensive than S3 Standard-IA; the reduced Availability Zone resilience is acceptable because the data can be regenerated.\
\
**Learn more:** [Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to store data in Amazon S3. The company accesses the data rarely, and the data can be regenerated if needed. The company wants to use the most cost-effective storage class.  
  
Which S3 storage class meets this requirement?

options.text: Create an Amazon S3 bucket for each user. Mount each bucket by using an S3 file system mounting utility.
Configure and deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Connect each user’s workstation to the file gateway.
Move each user’s working environment to Amazon WorkSpaces. Set up an Amazon WorkDocs account for each user.
Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance and attach an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Provisioned IOPS volume. Share the EBS volume directly with the users.

questions.explanation:
AWS Storage Gateway File Gateway provides an SMB or NFS file share backed by Amazon S3 and maintains a local cache for frequently accessed data. It extends storage capacity into AWS while preserving low-latency local access and avoiding the operational overhead of managing individual buckets or a self-managed file server.

**Learn more:** [What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html) · [AWS Storage Gateway FAQs](https://aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/faqs/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A developer must manage infrastructure for both a development environment and a production environment in a repeatable manner.  
  
Which AWS service should the developer use to satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudFormation uses templates to model and provision AWS resources consistently and repeatedly. Reusable templates can create separate development and production stacks while allowing environment-specific configuration through parameters, mappings, and conditions.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS CloudFormation?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html) · [CloudFormation best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company needs to identify IAM access keys that have not been rotated recently.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to fulfill this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Trusted Advisor provides security checks that identify IAM access keys that have not been rotated within the recommended time period.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Trusted Advisor check reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor-check-reference.html) · [Security checks - AWS Support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/security-checks.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company needs to identify IAM access keys that have not been rotated recently.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Grant everyone access to increase AWS service quotas.
Design applications to run in a single Availability Zone.
Plan to increase AWS service quotas first in a secondary AWS Region.

questions.explanation:
The AWS Well-Architected Framework lists five design principles for the Reliability pillar: test recovery procedures, automatically recover from failure, scale horizontally to increase aggregate workload availability, stop guessing capacity, and manage change in automation. "Automatically recover from failure" and "Stop guessing capacity" are two of these official principles, while planning to increase service quotas in a secondary Region is a specific implementation tactic, not one of the named design principles, and single-AZ design directly contradicts the pillar.

**Learn more:** [Reliability Pillar - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/reliability-pillar/design-principles.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which task is the responsibility of a company that is using Amazon RDS?

options.text: Create IAM policies to control administrative access to the service.
Install the cables to connect the hardware for compute and storage.
Install and patch the RDS operating system.

questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, AWS manages the undifferentiated heavy lifting for a managed service like RDS — provisioning hardware, cabling, and patching the underlying operating system — while the customer remains responsible for controlling access to the service, such as creating IAM policies that govern who can administer the database. Installing/patching the OS and provisioning infrastructure are AWS's job for RDS, not the customer's.\
**Learn more:** [Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to allow its employees to work remotely from home. The company's employees use Windows or Linux desktops. The company's employees need access from anywhere and at anytime by using any supported devices.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon WorkSpaces is a managed DaaS solution supporting Windows and Linux desktops accessible from anywhere, anytime, via multiple device types including PCs, tablets, and web browsers. AppStream 2.0 streams individual applications rather than complete desktops.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon WorkSpaces?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces/latest/adminguide/amazon-workspaces.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to use AWS technology to deploy a static website.  
  
Which solution meets this requirement with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.text: Deploy the website on Amazon EC2.
Host the website on AWS Elastic Beanstalk.
Deploy the website with Amazon Lightsail.
Host the website on Amazon S3.

questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 static website hosting provides the lowest operational overhead for serving static content. It requires no server management, auto-scales, and is highly cost-effective. EC2 demands instance management, Elastic Beanstalk requires application deployment setup, and Lightsail still involves server management overhead.\
\
**Learn more:** [Hosting a static website using Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company must be able to quickly develop, test, and launch an application in the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which cloud-computing advantage meets these requirements?

options.text: Trade fixed expense for variable expense

questions.explanation:
Increasing speed and agility makes IT resources available on demand, reducing the time needed to provision environments for development, testing, experimentation, and application launches from weeks to minutes.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing — AWS Overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company must be able to quickly develop, test, and launch an application in the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which cloud-computing advantage meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Budgets lets a customer set a custom cost or usage threshold, such as a monthly allocation, and automatically sends an alert as soon as actual or forecasted spending exceeds that threshold. Cost Explorer only visualizes historical and forecasted spend and does not provide proactive alerting against a custom budget, while cost allocation tags and cost categories are used to organize and group costs rather than to trigger notifications.

**Learn more:** [AWS Budgets](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/aws-budgets/)

A company runs an uninterruptible Amazon EC2 workload on AWS 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The company will require the same instance family and instance type to run the workload for the next 12 months.  
  
Which combination of purchasing options should the company choose to MOST optimize costs? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
For a 24/7 predictable workload running for exactly 12 months with the same instance family and type, Standard Reserved Instances provide significant cost savings over On-Demand. Choosing the All Upfront payment option further maximizes the discount compared to partial upfront or no upfront payment plans. Spot Instances would not work for an uninterruptible workload.

**Learn more:** [Reserved Instances for Amazon EC2 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A cloud practitioner needs to acquire AWS compliance reports before migrating an environment to the AWS Cloud.  
  
How can these reports be obtained?

options.text: Download the reports from AWS Artifact.
Open a case with AWS Support.
Generate the reports with Amazon Macie.

questions.explanation:
AWS Artifact provides on-demand downloads of AWS security and compliance documents, including ISO, PCI, and SOC reports. Authorized users can access and download these reports from the AWS Artifact console.\
\
**Learn more:** [Downloading reports in AWS Artifact](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/downloading-documents.html) · [What is AWS Artifact?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/what-is-aws-artifact.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service is designed for users running workloads that include a NoSQL database?
questions.explanation:
Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database service that handles key-value and document data models. Amazon RDS provides managed relational databases, Amazon S3 is object storage, and Amazon Redshift is a data warehouse for analytics.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon DynamoDB?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which Amazon EC2 pricing model delivers the **MOST** cost savings for a right-sized database server that will remain running throughout a 1-year project?
questions.explanation:
Standard Reserved Instances provide the most significant discount among EC2 Reserved Instance offering classes. They fit predictable, continuously running, right-sized workloads with a known one-year term; Convertible Reserved Instances provide a lower discount in exchange for flexibility, while Spot Instances are interruptible.\
\
**Learn more:** [Reserved Instances for Amazon EC2 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_us/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/blended-rates.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
An independent software vendor wants to deliver and share its custom Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) to prospective customers.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Marketplace is the platform where independent software vendors can publish, deliver, and sell their software products, including custom AMIs. It provides a standardized channel for ISVs to reach customers and manage licensing. AWS Data Exchange is for third-party data subscriptions, Amazon EC2 is the compute service itself, and AWS Organizations manages AWS accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [AMI-based products in AWS Marketplace](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/ami-products.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which action can a company take by using security groups in the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Allow access to an Amazon EC2 instance through only a specific port.
Deny access to malicious IP addresses at a subnet level.
Protect data that is cached by Amazon CloudFront.
Apply a stateless firewall to an Amazon EC2 instance.

questions.explanation:
AWS security groups control allowed inbound and outbound traffic for associated resources such as Amazon EC2 instances. Their rules can specify a protocol and port range, so they can restrict instance access to a particular port. Security groups are stateful and allow-only; subnet-level deny rules are provided by network ACLs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Infrastructure security in Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/infrastructure-security.html) · [Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company has an AWS account and needs to audit password and access-key rotation details for compliance purposes.  
  
Which AWS service or tool meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
An IAM credential report provides IAM credential status for all users in an AWS account, including password rotation fields and access-key last-rotated dates. It is designed to support audits of credential lifecycle requirements and compliance.\
\
**Learn more:** [Generate credential reports for your AWS account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_getting-report.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool can be used to configure a firewall that controls traffic entering and leaving an Amazon VPC subnet?
questions.explanation:
A network access control list (network ACL) is associated with an Amazon VPC subnet and uses inbound and outbound rules to allow or deny traffic at the subnet level.\
\
**Learn more:** [Control subnet traffic with network access control lists](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has temporary workload that is also variable. The company needs to use Amazon EC2 instances for the workload. The EC2 instances need to handle short bursts of work that cannot stop before finishing.  
  
Which purchase option will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
On-Demand Instances provide the flexibility needed for temporary, variable workloads that cannot tolerate interruption. They can be launched immediately, run for the required duration, and terminated when no longer needed. Spot Instances are unsuitable because they can be interrupted by AWS when capacity is needed, violating the requirement that work cannot stop before completion.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchasing On-Demand Instances for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-on-demand-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which benefits does consolidated billing provide for AWS Cloud services? (Choose two.)

options.text: A minimal additional fee for use
Custom cost and usage budget creation

questions.explanation:
AWS consolidated billing aggregates usage across member accounts, allowing applicable volume-pricing discounts, and provides a single bill for multiple accounts. It is available at no additional cost. [AWS: Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)\
\
**Learn more:** [Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which activities are customer responsibilities under the AWS shared responsibility model? *(Choose two.)*

options.text: Configure the AWS provided security group firewall.
Classify company assets in the AWS Cloud.
Determine which Availability Zones to use for Amazon S3 buckets.
Select Amazon EC2 instances to run AWS Lambda on.

questions.explanation:
Customers are responsible for security *in* the cloud, including configuring AWS-provided security group firewalls and classifying their company assets. AWS operates the underlying platform for Amazon DynamoDB; Amazon S3 does not require customers to select Availability Zones; and AWS Lambda infrastructure does not use customer-selected EC2 instances.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework – Shared responsibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to use a managed service to identify and protect sensitive data that is stored in Amazon S3.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Macie is a managed service that uses machine learning to automatically discover, classify, and protect sensitive data stored in S3. IAM Access Analyzer checks access permissions, GuardDuty detects security threats, and Inspector scans for application vulnerabilities. Macie is specifically designed for data discovery and protection in S3.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Macie?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS service is available at no additional charge?
questions.explanation:
AWS Organizations is offered at no additional charge; charges apply only to the AWS resources used by users and roles in its member accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Billing and pricing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_en/organizations/latest/userguide/pricing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to maintain bandwidth throughput and provide a more consistent network experience than public internet-based connections.  
  
Which AWS service should the company choose?
questions.explanation:
AWS Direct Connect establishes a dedicated private network connection from on-premises to AWS, providing consistent bandwidth, low latency, and more reliable throughput than public internet connections. VPN still uses the internet, CloudFront is a CDN for content distribution, and Amazon Connect is a contact center service.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Direct Connect](https://aws.amazon.com/directconnect/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service should users use to obtain information about AWS service availability and operations?
questions.explanation:
AWS Health Dashboard provides service-health information, including public events about AWS service availability and operational issues across AWS Regions.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Health Dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/aws-health-dashboard-status.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company stores 5 TB of data in Amazon S3 and plans to run occasional analytical queries against the data.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to run these queries in the **MOST** cost-effective way?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Athena runs ad hoc SQL queries directly on data in Amazon S3. Its serverless, pay-per-query model avoids paying for continuously provisioned data warehouse or database capacity when analysis is only occasional.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company stores 5 TB of data in Amazon S3 and plans to run occasional analytical queries against the data.  
  
Which AWS service should the company use to run these queries in the **MOST** cost-effective way?
questions.explanation:
Because the workload runs only briefly once a week and once a month with instances shut down otherwise, paying only for the seconds/hours actually used under On-Demand pricing is cheapest overall. Reserved Instance options require a long-term commitment that isn't justified by such sparse usage, and On-Demand Capacity Reservations incur charges for reserved capacity regardless of whether the instance is actually running.

**Learn more:** [Purchasing On-Demand Instances for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-on-demand-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services or features offer disaster-recovery solutions for Amazon EC2 instances? (Choose two.)

options.text: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots

questions.explanation:
Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) provide instance-level backups that can be used to launch replacement EC2 instances. Amazon EBS snapshots provide point-in-time volume backups that can be restored to new EBS volumes. AWS identifies both AMIs and EBS snapshots as EC2 backup and recovery mechanisms.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 backup and recovery with snapshots and AMIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/backup-recovery/ec2-backup.html) · [Amazon EBS snapshots](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-snapshots.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants to migrate critical on-premises production systems to Amazon EC2 instances. The production instances will be used for at least 3 years. The company wants a pricing option that will minimize cost.  
  
Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
For a steady-state production workload with a known runtime of three years or more, Reserved Instances provide a substantial discount over On-Demand pricing in exchange for a 1- or 3-year term commitment, making them the lowest-cost option for this always-on workload. Spot Instances are unsuitable for critical production systems because capacity can be reclaimed with little notice, and the AWS Free Tier only covers a small amount of usage for a limited period.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to host its workloads on AWS.  
  
Which AWS service requires the company to maintain and patch the guest operating system?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 provides virtual servers whose guest operating systems are managed by the customer. Under the AWS shared responsibility model, the customer is responsible for guest operating system updates and security patches on EC2 instances.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework – Shared responsibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance

options.text: Share root user credentials with team members.
Create multiple root users for the account, separated by environment.
Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) on the root user.
Create an IAM user with administrator privileges for daily administrative tasks, instead of using the root user.
Use programmatic access instead of the root user and password.

questions.explanation:
An AWS account has a single, highly privileged root user. AWS recommends enabling MFA to protect that identity and using a separate administrative IAM user for everyday administrative work, reserving root credentials only for tasks that specifically require them.

**Learn more:** [Root user best practices for your AWS account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html) · [AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)

Which of the following are characteristics of network ACLs when used in the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)

options.text: They evaluate all rules before allowing traffic.
They process rules in order, starting with the lowest numbered rule, when deciding whether to allow traffic.
They operate at the instance level.

questions.explanation:
AWS network ACLs are stateless, so return traffic must be explicitly allowed. They evaluate rules in numerical order, beginning with the lowest-numbered rule, and stop when a rule matches. Network ACLs operate at the subnet level, whereas security groups are stateful, evaluate all rules, and operate at the instance level.

**Learn more:** [Control subnet traffic with network access control lists](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html) · [Infrastructure security in Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/infrastructure-security.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which encryption types can protect objects at rest in Amazon S3? (Choose two.)

options.text: Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3)
Server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (SSE-KMS)

questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 protects stored objects with server-side encryption, including SSE-S3, which uses Amazon S3 managed keys, and SSE-KMS, which uses AWS Key Management Service keys. TLS and SSL secure data in transit rather than data at rest; Transparent Data Encryption is not an S3 object-encryption method.\
\
**Learn more:** [Protecting data with encryption - Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryption.html) · [Using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) - Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to use third-party software for an AWS workload.  
  
Which AWS service or feature can the company use to buy the software?
questions.explanation:
AWS Marketplace is a curated digital catalog for finding, purchasing, deploying, and managing third-party software, data, and services on AWS.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Marketplace?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/what-is-marketplace.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate its on-premises relational databases to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use infrastructure located as near as possible to its existing geographical location.  
  
Which AWS service or resource should the company use to choose its Amazon RDS deployment area?
questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS is deployed in an AWS Region, and the selected Region determines the geographical area in which the DB instance runs. Choosing the Region nearest to the existing environment helps meet the location requirement. AWS documents that RDS activity runs in the current AWS Region and that a DB instance can be created in a chosen Region.\
\
**Learn more:** [Regions, Availability Zones, and Local Zones - Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.RegionsAndAvailabilityZones.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can migrate Amazon EC2 instances from one AWS Region to another?
questions.explanation:
AWS Application Migration Service (formerly Server Migration Service) is specifically designed to migrate EC2 instances across AWS regions. AWS DMS is for database migrations, DataSync is for data transfer, and Migration Hub is a tracking tool. Application Migration Service handles server instance migration between regions.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Application Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/what-is-application-migration-service.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, which of the following are AWS responsibilities? (Choose two.)

options.text: Network infrastructure and virtualization of infrastructure

questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, AWS is responsible for network infrastructure/virtualization and physical security of data centers. Customers are responsible for application data security, guest operating systems, and user credentials/policies. This division ensures both parties focus on their respective security domains.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS shared responsibility model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service transforms text into lifelike voices?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Polly is AWS’s text-to-speech service, converting written text into natural-sounding speech using lifelike voices.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon Polly documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following benefits do users experience when moving on-premises workloads to the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Elimination of expenses for running and maintaining data centers
Price discounts that are identical to discounts from hardware providers
Distribution of all operational controls to AWS

questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud adoption removes the need for an organization to operate and maintain its own physical data centers, including the associated infrastructure work and expenses. It does not eliminate all operational expenses or transfer every operational control to AWS.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing — AWS Overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A user needs to review, in the Amazon S3 console, all Amazon S3 buckets that have ACLs and S3 bucket policies.  
  
Which AWS service or resource meets this requirement?

options.text: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)

questions.explanation:
IAM Access Analyzer for S3 provides findings for S3 buckets whose bucket ACLs or bucket policies grant public or shared access. In the Amazon S3 console, its **Shared through** information identifies whether the access is provided through a bucket ACL or bucket policy.\
\
**Learn more:** [Reviewing bucket access using IAM Access Analyzer for S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-analyzer.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has an application that produces unstructured data continuously. The company needs to store the data so that the data is durable and easy to query.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database designed for unstructured and semi-structured data with high durability and queryability. RDS and Aurora are relational databases optimized for structured data, and QuickSight is a business intelligence tool for visualization only. DynamoDB provides both durability and easy querying for continuous unstructured data.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon DynamoDB?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service lets users download security and compliance reports about the AWS infrastructure on demand?
questions.explanation:
AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS security and compliance documents, including certifications and audit reports such as SOC, ISO, and PCI reports.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Artifact?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/what-is-aws-artifact.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company needs to categorize and track AWS usage cost based on business categories.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Cost allocation tags are key-value pairs applied to AWS resources to categorize and track spending by business dimensions (project, department, cost center, environment). AWS Cost and Usage Report aggregates usage data tagged with these values, enabling cost tracking by business category. AWS Organizations manages account hierarchy, Security Hub is for compliance monitoring, and Billing Conductor manages multi-account billing but does not provide allocation tracking.\
\
**Learn more:** [Organizing and tracking costs using AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company plans to run its workload continuously on Amazon EC2 instances for longer than 1 year.  
  
Which option provides a discounted hourly rate relative to the hourly rate for On-Demand Instances?
questions.explanation:
EC2 Instance Savings Plans provide discounted Amazon EC2 pricing in exchange for a commitment to a consistent hourly amount of usage for a one- or three-year term. They are designed for sustained EC2 use and can save up to 72% compared with On-Demand rates.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Savings Plans: Compute Savings Plans and Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-ris.html) · [AWS Savings Plans: What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service enables the deployment and management of applications in the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk deploys applications to AWS resources and handles operational tasks such as capacity provisioning, load balancing, scaling, and application health monitoring.\
\
**Learn more:** [Getting started with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/GettingStarted.html) · [AWS Elastic Beanstalk](https://aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service is a hybrid-cloud storage offering that gives on-premises users access to virtually unlimited cloud storage?
questions.explanation:
AWS Storage Gateway is a hybrid cloud storage service that connects on-premises environments to AWS cloud storage and enables on-premises applications to access virtually unlimited cloud storage.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Storage Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html) · [AWS Storage Gateway Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/optimize-costs-microsoft-workloads/storage-main-storage-gateway.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
