A company wants to build graph queries for real-time fraud pattern detection.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Neptune is a fully managed graph database optimized for querying highly connected data and relationships, making it ideal for fraud detection patterns that involve entity interactions and connections. Amazon DynamoDB (B) is a key-value store, Amazon Timestream (C) specializes in time-series data, and Amazon Forecast (D) focuses on predictive analytics.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is Amazon Neptune?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/intro.html) · [Fraud graphs on AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/neptune/fraud-graphs-on-aws/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service uses AWS Compute Optimizer to deliver sizing recommendations based on workload metrics?
questions.explanation:
AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes the configuration and CloudWatch utilization metrics of Amazon EC2 instances, such as CPU, network, and disk activity, to generate rightsizing recommendations for EC2 instance types and sizes.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Compute Optimizer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/what-is-compute-optimizer.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool gives a company the ability to release application changes in an automated way?
questions.explanation:
AWS CodeDeploy automates application deployments across EC2 instances, on-premises servers, Lambda functions, and ECS services. It handles the complexity of releasing application updates in a consistent, automated manner.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS CodeDeploy?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following describes a way to use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to scale capacity in the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Scale the number of EC2 instances in or out automatically, based on demand.
Scale the size of EC2 instances up or down automatically, based on demand.
Transfer unused CPU resources between EC2 instances.

questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling can use scaling policies to automatically launch EC2 instances as application demand increases and terminate instances as demand decreases, scaling the number of instances in the group.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html) · [Choose your scaling method](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/scaling-overview.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is moving some of its on-premises IT services to the AWS Cloud. The finance department wants to see the entire bill so it can forecast spending limits.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to set spending limits and receive notifications if those limits are exceeded?
questions.explanation:
AWS Budgets allows users to set customized spending limits and receive notifications via email or SNS when spending approaches or exceeds thresholds. It provides proactive cost management and forecasting capabilities. Cost Explorer is for visualization only; Cost and Usage Reports provide detailed data but lack alert functionality; Consolidated Billing shows combined costs but not alerts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Managing Your Costs with AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is moving some of its on-premises IT services to the AWS Cloud. The finance department wants to see the entire bill so it can forecast spending limits.  
  
Which AWS service can the company use to set spending limits and receive notifications if those limits are exceeded?

options.text: The company will be charged the standard pay-as-you-go service rates for the usage that exceeds the Free Tier usage.
AWS Support will contact the company to set up standard service charges.
The company will be charged for the services it consumed during the Free Tier period, plus additional charges for service consumption after the Free Tier period.
The company's AWS account will be frozen and can be restarted after a payment plan is established.

questions.explanation:
AWS charges standard pay-as-you-go rates for usage that exceeds AWS Free Tier limits or continues after Free Tier eligibility expires. Usage that was within the applicable Free Tier allowance remains free.

**Learn more:** [Avoiding unexpected charges after Free Tier](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/avoid-charges-after-free-tier.html) · [AWS Free Tier FAQs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/free-tier-FAQ.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to centrally manage its employee's access to multiple AWS accounts.  
  
Which AWS service or feature should the company use to meet this requirement?

options.text: AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer

questions.explanation:
AWS IAM Identity Center (formerly AWS Single Sign-On) is the correct solution for centrally managing employee access across multiple AWS accounts. It enables single sign-on and provides centralized permission management. AWS Secrets Manager is for credential storage, IAM Access Analyzer is for access analysis, and AWS STS is for temporary credentials.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to update its online data processing application by implementing container-based services that run for 4 hours at a time. The company does not want to provision or manage server instances.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Fargate is the container-based, serverless compute service. It runs containerized applications without requiring server management and supports workloads running for hours. AWS Lambda is unsuitable due to its 15-minute execution limit. EC2 requires instance management, and Elastic Beanstalk is better suited for web application deployment.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A user wants to invoke an AWS Lambda function when an Amazon EC2 instance enters the “stopping” state.  
  
Which AWS service is appropriate for this use case?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EventBridge (and its predecessor CloudWatch Events) can detect EC2 instance state-change notifications, such as an instance entering the \"stopping\" state, and route that event to a target such as an AWS Lambda function. AWS Config tracks configuration compliance history, SNS only handles pub/sub notifications without native EC2 state-change triggers, and CloudFormation is for provisioning infrastructure, not reacting to runtime state changes.\
**Learn more:** [Automate Amazon EC2 using EventBridge](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/start-stop-lambda-eventbridge)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which tool should a developer use to integrate AWS service capabilities directly into an application?
questions.explanation:
The AWS Software Development Kit (SDK) supplies language-specific APIs and service clients that application code uses to access AWS service features programmatically. AWS CodeDeploy manages deployments, AWS Lambda runs code without provisioning servers, and AWS Batch schedules batch-computing workloads.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS SDKs and Tools: Authentication and access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/access.html) · [AWS SDK for Go API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-go/api/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service is a key-value database that delivers sub-millisecond latency at large scale?
questions.explanation:
Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database that supports key-value and document data models and is designed to scale while maintaining low-latency performance. AWS documents DynamoDB as providing single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale; its optional DAX caching layer can provide microsecond latency for supported reads.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon DynamoDB?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html) · [In-memory acceleration with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service helps simplify the monitoring and troubleshooting of application logs and cloud resources?
questions.explanation:
Amazon CloudWatch provides real-time monitoring of AWS resources and applications and works with metrics, logs, and events to support operational visibility and troubleshooting. Amazon EC2 provides compute capacity, IAM manages access permissions, and AWS CloudTrail records API activity for auditing.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudTrail or Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pdfs/decision-guides/latest/cloudtrail-or-cloudwatch/cloudtrail-or-cloudwatch.pdf)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which cloud-computing benefit enables a company to deploy applications to users worldwide through a network of AWS Regions, Availability Zones, and edge locations?
questions.explanation:
Global reach enables applications and content to be delivered to users around the world by using AWS’s worldwide infrastructure of Regions, Availability Zones, and edge locations.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Global Infrastructure](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS services are eligible for Savings Plans? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS offers Savings Plans for Amazon EC2 through Compute Savings Plans and EC2 Instance Savings Plans, as well as dedicated SageMaker Savings Plans for Amazon SageMaker. These provide discounted rates for committed usage. RDS (B), Redshift (D), and DynamoDB (E) do not have individual Savings Plans in the scope of this question, though AWS has since introduced Database Savings Plans for some services.\
\
**Learn more:** [Services eligible for Savings Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-services.html) · [What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which of the following is a customer responsibility according to the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Apply security patches for Amazon S3 infrastructure devices.
Provide physical security for AWS datacenters.
Install operating system updates on Lambda@Edge.
Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for IAM user accounts.

questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, customers are responsible for identity and access management practices such as enabling MFA on IAM accounts, since this is part of \"security in the cloud.\" Patching S3 infrastructure, physical datacenter security, and OS updates on the managed Lambda@Edge runtime are all AWS's responsibility as part of \"security of the cloud.\"\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company plans to use the AWS Cloud to deploy an application globally.  
  
Which architecture deployment model should the company choose to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
A Multi-Region deployment places application resources in multiple geographically separate AWS Regions, enabling global reach. Multi-AZ deployment spans Availability Zones only within a single AWS Region.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS multi-Region fundamentals](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/aws-multi-region-fundamentals/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company plans to use the AWS Cloud to deploy an application globally.  
  
Which architecture deployment model should the company choose to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
For a 1-year stable workload that cannot tolerate interruption, Partial Upfront Reserved Instances offer the best cost-effectiveness among the options, providing significant discounts through a combination of upfront payment and reduced hourly rates. On-Demand instances are more expensive per hour, Spot instances can be terminated, and while No Upfront Reserved Instances require no upfront payment, Partial Upfront provides greater overall savings for a committed 1-year term.

**Learn more:** [Reserved Instances overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html) · [How billing works with Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts-reserved-instances-application.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company uses Amazon Aurora as its database service. The company wants to encrypt its databases and database backups.  
  
Which party manages the encryption of the database clusters and database snapshots, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation:
Under the AWS shared responsibility model, AWS secures the underlying infrastructure and provides the encryption tooling (such as AWS KMS integration) for Aurora, but it is the customer's responsibility to enable and configure encryption on their database clusters and on the snapshots derived from them. AWS does not automatically encrypt customer data at rest unless the customer turns encryption on and manages the associated keys.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service can companies use to subscribe to RSS feeds for updates about all AWS service issues?
questions.explanation:
AWS Health Dashboard provides RSS feed subscriptions that notify users of AWS service health events, maintenance windows, and issue updates affecting their infrastructure. This centralized dashboard allows organizations to monitor service status across all AWS regions and services.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Health Dashboard – Service health](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/aws-health-dashboard-status.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service can companies use to subscribe to RSS feeds for updates about all AWS service issues?

options.text: Create an IAM user and provide AWS Management Console access only.
Create an IAM user and provide programmatic access only.
Create an IAM role and provide AWS Management Console access only.
Create an IAM policy with administrator access and attach it to the IAM user.
Create an IAM policy with Amazon RDS access and attach it to the IAM user.

questions.explanation:
Meeting the requirement involves creating an IAM user with programmatic access only (CLI and SDK), and attaching an RDS-specific policy for least privilege. Management Console access is unnecessary and violates least privilege. Using a role is inappropriate for individual users. Administrator access violates least privilege by granting excessive permissions.

**Learn more:** [Programmatic access with AWS security credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/security-creds-programmatic-access.html) · [Security best practices in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service allows for file sharing between multiple Amazon EC2 instances?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) is a shared, networked file system that multiple EC2 instances can mount and access simultaneously. This enables file sharing across instances. Direct Connect is for network connectivity, Snowball Edge is for data transfer, and AWS Backup is for backup operations.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Elastic File System?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which task necessitates that a user sign in as the AWS account root user?

options.text: The deletion of an AWS account
The creation of an organization in AWS Organizations
The deletion of Amazon EC2 instances

questions.explanation:
Closing a standalone AWS account requires AWS account root-user credentials. IAM users or roles with appropriate permissions can delete IAM users, terminate EC2 instances, and create an AWS Organization.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html) · [Creating an organization with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_org_create.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which task necessitates that a user sign in as the AWS account root user?
questions.explanation:
AWS DataSync is specifically designed for transferring large amounts of data quickly and securely between on-premises storage systems and AWS. It handles millions of files efficiently in one-time migration scenarios. AWS DMS targets database migration, Migration Hub orchestrates overall migration strategy, and Application Migration Service focuses on lift-and-shift application migration.

**Learn more:** [What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html) · [Performing a large data migration with AWS DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/datasync-large-migration.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company using AWS must transfer 2 TB of data.  
  
Which type of data transfer would incur no cost for the company?

options.text: Inbound data transfer from the internet
Outbound data transfer to the internet

questions.explanation:
AWS does not charge for data transfer from the internet into AWS, commonly called data ingress. A 2 TB inbound transfer therefore has no AWS data-transfer charge; the other listed transfer directions can incur charges.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Global Network FAQs](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/global-network/faqs/) · [Understanding data transfer charges](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-data-transfers-charges.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS service is always available free of charge to users?
questions.explanation:
AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) is always available at no charge. IAM allows secure management of access to AWS services and resources. Amazon Athena (A), AWS Secrets Manager (C), and Amazon ElastiCache (D) all incur costs based on usage.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is IAM?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/introduction.html) · [AWS IAM FAQs](https://aws.amazon.com/iam/faqs/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate its application to the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which AWS tool or resource set should the company use to analyze and evaluate its migration readiness?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) provides guidance across six organizational perspectives—business, people, governance, platform, security, and operations—to evaluate cloud readiness, identify capability gaps, and plan a migration transformation roadmap.\
\
**Learn more:** [Assess phase - AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/strategy-migration/assess-phase.html) · [Organizational readiness - Migration Launch Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transform/latest/launchguide/organizational-readiness.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to rapidly implement a continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.  
  
Which AWS service satisfies this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS CodeStar was designed to provision a software project with integrated development resources, including a source repository and a continuous delivery toolchain, enabling rapid CI/CD setup. AWS Config, Amazon Cognito, and AWS DataSync serve configuration-compliance, identity, and data-transfer purposes, respectively.\
\
**Learn more:** [Getting started with AWS CodeStar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/es_es/codestar/latest/userguide/getting-started.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company's cloud environment includes Amazon EC2 instances and Application Load Balancers. The company wants to improve protections for its cloud resources against DDoS attacks. The company also wants to have real-time visibility into any DDoS attacks.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Shield Advanced provides enhanced DDoS protection along with real-time attack visibility, diagnostics, and reporting through CloudWatch metrics and the Shield console/API. Shield Standard offers baseline protection but no advanced reporting, while Firewall Manager and GuardDuty address firewall policy management and threat detection rather than DDoS-specific real-time visibility. **Learn more:** [AWS Shield Advanced](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which task is the responsibility of the customer, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Patch the Amazon DynamoDB operating system.
Secure Amazon CloudFront edge locations by allowing physical access according to the principle of least privilege.
Protect the hardware that runs AWS services.
Use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) according to the principle of least privilege.

questions.explanation:
Customers are responsible for implementing least-privilege access controls via AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). AWS is responsible for patching managed services (DynamoDB), securing physical infrastructure, and controlling CloudFront edge locations—only D reflects a customer responsibility.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS shared responsibility model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/) · [Security best practices in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following are pillars in the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
The AWS Well-Architected Framework includes Reliability and Operational Excellence among its six pillars. Availability and scalability can contribute to reliable systems, but they are not named framework pillars; responsive design is also not a pillar.\
\
**Learn more:** [The pillars of the framework — AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2024-06-27/framework/the-pillars-of-the-framework.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company runs many Amazon EC2 instances in its VPC. The company wants to use a native AWS security resource to control network traffic between certain EC2 instances.  
  
Which AWS service or feature will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Security groups function as instance-level virtual firewalls that control inbound and outbound traffic for specific EC2 instances. They allow fine-grained control between certain instances. Network ACLs operate at the subnet level for broader traffic filtering, not instance-specific control.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EC2 Security Groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-security-groups.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service provides encryption for Amazon EBS?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EBS uses AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt EBS volumes and snapshots. The default key is the AWS managed key for EBS, or a symmetric customer managed KMS key can be used.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html) · [How Amazon Elastic Block Store uses AWS KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/services-ebs.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services or features enable failover across separate AWS Regions to provide high availability and low latency? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Amazon Route 53 can use latency-based routing for resources in multiple AWS Regions and health checks with failover routing to direct DNS queries to healthy regional resources. AWS Global Accelerator routes client traffic over the AWS global network to optimal healthy endpoints in one or more Regions, providing lower latency and cross-Region failover.\
\
**Learn more:** [Choosing a routing policy - Amazon Route 53](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html) · [How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS services or features form the AWS Cloud global infrastructure? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
The AWS Cloud global infrastructure is built from geographically distributed AWS Regions, each containing multiple isolated Availability Zones. Amazon S3, ElastiCache, and VPC are services that run on top of that infrastructure rather than constituting it.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Global Infrastructure](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company uses a central data platform to manage several types of customer data. The company wants to use AWS services to discover, transform, and visualize that data.  
  
Which combination of AWS services should the company use to satisfy these requirements? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS Glue provides centralized data discovery and cataloging plus ETL capabilities to prepare and transform data from multiple sources. Amazon QuickSight provides interactive business-intelligence analysis, visualizations, and dashboards.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Glue?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_en/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html) · [What is Amazon Quick?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company is learning about its responsibilities that are related to the management of Amazon EC2 instances.  
  
Which tasks for EC2 instances are the company’s responsibility, according to the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)

options.text: Install and patch the machine hypervisor.
Encrypt data at rest on associated storage.
Install the physical hardware and cabling.
Provide physical security for the EC2 instances.

questions.explanation:
Customers are responsible for patching the guest operating system within EC2 instances and encrypting data at rest on storage volumes. AWS manages the hypervisor, physical hardware, and data center security. CloudTrail configuration is also a customer responsibility, but it is not listed as an option.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS shared responsibility model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company seeks to transform its workforce by attracting and developing a digitally fluent, high-performance workforce. The company also wants to attract a diverse and inclusive workforce with an appropriate mix of technical and non-technical skills.  
  
Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective will satisfy these requirements?
questions.explanation:
The AWS CAF People perspective covers workforce transformation: enabling and modernizing talent to attract, develop, and retain a digitally fluent, high-performing workforce. It also calls for a diverse and inclusive workforce with the appropriate mix of technical and non-technical skills.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF People perspective: Workforce transformation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-people-perspective/workforce-transformation.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which complimentary AWS service or tool creates data-driven business cases for cloud planning?
questions.explanation:
AWS Migration Evaluator (formerly TSO Logic) is a complimentary service that analyzes on-premises infrastructure and costs to create detailed, data-driven business cases for cloud migration. It provides ROI calculations and cost comparisons, making it the primary AWS tool for migration planning. Billing Conductor manages multi-tenant billing, Billing Console displays costs, and Forecast predicts time-series data—none create business cases.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Migration Evaluator](https://aws.amazon.com/migration-evaluator/) · [Migration Evaluator features](https://aws.amazon.com/migration-evaluator/features/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which of the following are capabilities in the governance perspective of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
The AWS CAF Governance perspective includes cloud financial management, which plans, measures, and optimizes cloud spend, and application portfolio management. Identity and access management is a Security perspective capability.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CAF Governance perspective: control and oversight](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/governance-perspective.html) · [AWS CAF Governance Perspective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-governance-perspective/aws-caf-governance-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs an event history of which AWS resources the company has created.  
  
Which AWS service will provide this information?
questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records a history of API calls and account activity, including which principal created, modified, or deleted which resources and when. CloudWatch monitors metrics and logs rather than an audit trail of resource creation, Aurora is a database engine, and EventBridge routes events between services but does not itself provide a historical event log.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS CloudTrail User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants a report that lists the status of multi-factor authentication (MFA) devices that all users in the company's AWS account use.  
  
Which AWS feature or service will meet this requirement?

options.text: Detailed Billing Reports -D AWS Cost Explorer reports

questions.explanation:
IAM credential reports provide detailed information about all users' access credentials including MFA device status and activation. Cost and Usage Reports track billing, Detailed Billing Reports show costs, and Cost Explorer analyzes spending—none report on MFA device status.\
\
**Learn more:** [Generate credential reports for your AWS account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_getting-report.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company wants a report that lists the status of multi-factor authentication (MFA) devices that all users in the company's AWS account use.  
  
Which AWS feature or service will meet this requirement?

options.text: Access the AWS Cost Management console to organize resources, set an AWS budget, and receive notifications of unintentional usage.
Use tags to organize the resources. Activate cost allocation tags to track AWS costs on a detailed level.
Create Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visually organize and track costs individually.
Access the AWS Billing and Cost Management dashboard to organize and track resource consumption on a detailed level.

questions.explanation:
AWS tags provide the business metadata needed to organize resources by department, environment, and application. Activating those tags as cost allocation tags makes AWS cost data available and grouped by the active tag keys for detailed cost tracking and reporting.

**Learn more:** [Organizing and tracking costs using AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html) · [Activating user-defined cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/activating-tags.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A developer has joined a large company and requires AWS credentials.  
  
Which security best practices should be followed? (Choose two.)

options.text: Grant the developer access to only the AWS resources needed to perform the job.
Share the AWS account root user credentials with the developer.
Add the developer to the administrator’s group in AWS IAM.
Configure a password policy that ensures the developer’s password cannot be changed.
Ensure the account password policy requires a minimum length.

questions.explanation:
AWS IAM follows the principle of least privilege: grant only the permissions and resource access required to perform a task. A strong IAM account password policy should also enforce a minimum password length. Root user credentials must be protected rather than shared, and administrative permissions should not be granted when they are unnecessary.

**Learn more:** [Security best practices in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html) · [Set an account password policy for IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: What can a user do with AWS CloudTrail?

options.text: Generate an IAM user credentials report.
Record API calls made to AWS services.
Assess the compliance of AWS resource configurations with policies and guidelines.
Ensure that Amazon EC2 instances are patched with the latest security updates.

questions.explanation:
AWS CloudTrail records AWS API calls and other account activity as events for auditing, monitoring, and investigation.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which type of workload should a company run on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances?

options.text: A steady-state workload that requires a particular EC2 instance configuration for a long period of time
A workload that can be interrupted and can control costs
A steady-state workload that does not require a long-term commitment
A workload that cannot be interrupted and can control costs

questions.explanation:
Spot Instances are designed for workloads that can tolerate interruptions and prioritize cost savings. They can be reclaimed by AWS with minimal notice, making them unsuitable for mission-critical but ideal for flexible, cost-sensitive workloads.\
\
**Learn more:** [How Spot Instances work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-spot-instances-work.html) · [Spot Instance interruptions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-interruptions.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which task is AWS responsible for under the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation:
AWS secures the underlying infrastructure that runs AWS services, including the physical networking infrastructure and facilities. Customers are responsible for their applications, data protection choices, user authentication, and configuration of AWS-provided firewalls or security groups.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which statements represent the cost-effectiveness of the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)

options.text: Users can trade fixed expenses for variable expenses.
Users can deploy all over the world in minutes.
AWS offers increased speed and agility.
AWS is responsible for patching the infrastructure.
Users benefit from economies of scale.

questions.explanation:
AWS reduces costs through two key mechanisms: trading fixed capital expenses for variable operating expenses (pay-as-you-go pricing model), and benefiting from economies of scale where AWS spreads infrastructure investments across millions of customers. Options B and C describe speed and agility benefits rather than cost-effectiveness. Option D, while true about AWS responsibility, is an operational feature not a cost advantage.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to deploy a web application as a containerized application. The company wants to use a managed service that can automatically create container images from source code and deploy the containerized application.  
  
Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS App Runner is a fully managed service that automatically builds container images directly from source code and deploys them without infrastructure management. Elastic Beanstalk (A) requires platform configuration, Amazon ECS (B) requires pre-built container images, and EC2 (D) demands manual management of all aspects including image building and deployment.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS App Runner?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apprunner/latest/dg/what-is-apprunner.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS solution gives companies the ability to use protocols such as NFS to store and retrieve objects in Amazon S3?
questions.explanation:
AWS Storage Gateway file gateway specifically enables NFS and SMB protocol access to objects stored in S3, bridging file-based applications with S3 storage. FSx for Lustre is optimized for high-performance computing, not general NFS-to-S3 access; Storage Gateway volume gateway uses iSCSI protocol, and EFS is a separate managed NFS service not integrated with S3.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS solution gives companies the ability to use protocols such as NFS to store and retrieve objects in Amazon S3?
questions.explanation:
On-Demand Instances incur charges only while the instances run and require no long-term commitment, making them cost-effective for a workload used only 2 months per year. They are the appropriate option for short-term workloads that cannot tolerate interruption; Spot Instances can be interrupted, while Reserved Instances require 1- or 3-year commitments.

**Learn more:** [Purchasing On-Demand Instances for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-on-demand-instances.html) · [Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses a third-party identity provider (IdP). The company wants to provide its employees with access to AWS accounts and services without requiring another set of login credentials.  
  
Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS IAM Identity Center (formerly AWS SSO) enables employees to access AWS accounts using an existing third-party identity provider via federation protocols like OIDC and SAML 2.0, eliminating the need for separate AWS credentials. This centralized identity management service is purpose-built for workforce identity federation, unlike Amazon Cognito which is primarily for application-level user authentication.

**Learn more:** [AWS IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/) · [External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is configuring AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) for an AWS account.  
  
Which recommendation follows IAM security best practices?

options.text: Use the account root user access keys for administrative tasks.
Grant broad permissions so that all company employees can access the resources they need.
Turn on multi-factor authentication (MFA) for added security during the login process.
Avoid rotating credentials to prevent issues in production applications.

questions.explanation:
IAM recommends requiring multi-factor authentication (MFA) to add a second authentication factor and strengthen protection of AWS identities. IAM best practices also call for least-privilege permissions, avoiding root-user access keys, and updating long-term access keys when they are needed.

**Learn more:** [Security best practices in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html) · [Use multi-factor authentication with your identities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/gs-identities-mfa.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company uses Amazon DynamoDB.  
  
Which task is the company responsible for under the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation:
For Amazon DynamoDB, AWS operates and secures the underlying infrastructure, hosts, and operating system. The customer is responsible for managing access to DynamoDB resources by using IAM policies and permissions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared responsibility - AWS Well-Architected Framework Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html) · [Identity and Access Management for Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/security-iam.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company intends to run a compute-intensive workload that uses graphics processing units (GPUs).  
  
Which Amazon EC2 instance type should the company choose?
questions.explanation:
Amazon EC2 accelerated computing instances use hardware accelerators, including GPUs, for workloads that require graphics or parallel-processing acceleration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Accelerated computing EC2 instance types](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/instance-types/accelerated-computing/) · [Amazon EC2 accelerated computing specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/instancetypes/ac.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) capabilities belong to the governance perspective? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
AWS CAF groups its foundational capabilities into six perspectives, and the Governance perspective comprises program and project management, benefits management, risk management, cloud financial management, application portfolio management, data governance, and data curation. Program and project management and risk management match Governance capabilities by name, while portfolio management and product management are Business-perspective capabilities and event management belongs to the Operations perspective.\
\
**Learn more:** [Governance perspective: control and oversight](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/governance-perspective.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service enables users to create copies of resources across AWS Regions?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudFormation lets users define infrastructure as templates that can be deployed repeatedly to create identical copies of resources in different AWS Regions. ElastiCache, CloudTrail, and Systems Manager serve caching, auditing, and operational management purposes respectively and do not replicate resource stacks across Regions. **Learn more:** [What Is AWS CloudFormation?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service enables users to create copies of resources across AWS Regions?

options.text: Sign up for AWS Enterprise Support

questions.explanation:
AWS Enterprise Support delivers strategic planning assistance via a Technical Account Manager (TAM), Infrastructure Event Management (IEM) for critical launches, and 24/7 real-time access to senior support engineers. AWS Professional Services provides consulting but lacks ongoing operational support and IEM.

**Learn more:** [AWS Enterprise Support plan](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/enterprise/) · [AWS Support Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/aws-support-plans.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service lets users model and provision AWS resources by using common programming languages?
questions.explanation:
AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) enables infrastructure to be defined using familiar programming languages and provisions the resulting resources through AWS CloudFormation.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is the AWS CDK?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_en/cdk/v2/guide/home.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service integrates with other AWS services to provide the ability to encrypt data at rest?
questions.explanation:
AWS Key Management Service (KMS) integrates with AWS services to enable encryption of data at rest, generating and managing encryption keys. AWS Certificate Manager handles encryption in transit via SSL/TLS; IAM manages access; and Security Hub aggregates security findings.\
\
**Learn more:** [Data protection in AWS Key Management Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/data-protection.html) · [Using AWS KMS encryption with AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/service-integration.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company is moving to the AWS Cloud and intends to run experimental workloads on AWS for 3 to 6 months.  
  
Which pricing model meets these requirements?

options.text: Use Savings Plans for a 3-year term.

questions.explanation:
On-Demand Instances charge only for the compute capacity used and do not require a long-term commitment, making them suitable for short-lived experimental workloads with uncertain usage.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchasing On-Demand Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-on-demand-instances.html) · [EC2 On-Demand Instance Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/on-demand/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company runs a workload in the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which AWS best practice helps ensure the MOST cost-effective architecture for the workload?
questions.explanation:
Rightsizing matches AWS resource types and sizes to actual workload requirements, preventing overprovisioning and reducing cost while maintaining the needed performance. AWS identifies selecting the appropriate resource type, size, and number as a Cost Optimization best practice.\
\
**Learn more:** [Select the correct resource type, size, and number — AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/cost-optimization-pillar/select-the-correct-resource-type-size-and-number.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service is a fully managed NoSQL database service?
questions.explanation:
Amazon DynamoDB is AWS's fully managed, serverless key-value and document NoSQL database service. RDS and Aurora are managed relational (SQL) database services, and Redshift is a managed data warehouse for analytics, not a NoSQL database.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon DynamoDB](https://aws.amazon.com/dynamodb/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which task is AWS responsible for when using AWS services?

options.text: Creation of security group rules for outbound access
Maintenance of physical and environmental controls
Application of Amazon EC2 operating system patches

questions.explanation:
AWS is responsible for security **of** the cloud, including the physical infrastructure and the facilities that operate it. Physical and environmental controls are therefore managed by AWS. IAM permissions, security-group configuration, and Amazon EC2 guest operating system patches are customer responsibilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service supports MySQL database engines?
questions.explanation:
Amazon RDS is the managed relational database service supporting MySQL along with PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, and SQL Server. It handles automatic backups, patching, and scaling—unlike DynamoDB (NoSQL), DocumentDB (MongoDB-compatible), or ElastiCache (in-memory).\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon RDS for MySQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_MySQL.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service or resource answers the security-related questions most commonly asked by AWS users?
questions.explanation:
AWS Knowledge Center publishes answers to frequently asked AWS questions, including security topics. AWS Artifact is used to access compliance reports and agreements, whereas Amazon Connect is a contact-center service and AWS Chatbot supports chat-based operational notifications and commands.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Knowledge Center](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/knowledge-center/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS design principle emphasizes the reduction of interdependencies between components of an application?
questions.explanation:
Loose coupling is an AWS Well-Architected Framework design principle that emphasizes reducing direct dependencies between application components. This allows individual components to be updated, scaled, or replaced independently without cascading failures, improving system resilience and flexibility.\
\
**Learn more:** [REL04-BP02 Implement loosely coupled dependencies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/rel_prevent_interaction_failure_loosely_coupled_system.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS design principle emphasizes the reduction of interdependencies between components of an application?

options.text: The ability to turn over the responsibility for all security to AWS.
The ability to use the pay-as-you-go model.
The ability to have full control over the physical infrastructure.
No longer having to guess what capacity will be required.
No longer worrying about users access controls.

questions.explanation:
AWS provides pay-as-you-go pricing, so customers pay for the resources and services they use. Its on-demand, elastic capacity lets workloads scale as needed, eliminating the need to forecast infrastructure capacity precisely. Security and access controls remain shared customer responsibilities, and AWS owns and operates the physical infrastructure.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html) · [What is cloud computing?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/what-is-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Well-Architected Framework concept represents a system's ability to remain functional when the system encounters operational problems?
questions.explanation:
Durability in the AWS Well-Architected Framework represents a system's ability to remain functional when encountering operational problems or failures. Consistency (A) concerns data accuracy, elasticity (B) addresses scaling capability, and latency (D) measures response time—none capture the concept of continuous operation through failures.\
\
**Learn more:** [Durability - AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://wa.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2020-07-02T19-33-23/wat.concept.durability.en.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS Well-Architected Framework concept represents a system's ability to remain functional when the system encounters operational problems?

options.text: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory

questions.explanation: AWS IAM Identity Center (successor to AWS Single Sign-On) provides a central portal where end users can access assigned AWS accounts as well as third-party SaaS and cloud applications using a single set of credentials. Cognito targets customer-facing app authentication, IAM manages account-level permissions without a user portal, and Directory Service provides directory hosting rather than an application access portal. **Learn more:** [What Is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question:
A company wants to migrate its on-premises infrastructure to the AWS Cloud.  
  
Which advantage of cloud computing will help the company reduce upfront costs?

options.text: Benefit from massive economies of scale
Trade fixed expense for variable expense

questions.explanation:
Trading fixed expense for variable expense is one of AWS's core cloud economics advantages: instead of investing heavily upfront in data centers and servers, a company pays only for the compute and storage it consumes, reducing initial capital expenditure. The other options describe benefits of scale, speed, and global reach rather than upfront cost reduction.\
\
**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company wants to improve its security by launching a third-party ISP intrusion detection system from its AWS account.  
  
Which AWS service or resource should the company use to satisfy this requirement?
questions.explanation:
AWS Marketplace is AWS’s curated catalog for finding, purchasing, and deploying third-party software and services, including security software, into an AWS environment. It is the appropriate resource for launching a third-party intrusion detection product.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Marketplace?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/what-is-marketplace.html) · [Software and services on AWS Marketplace](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/buyerguide/buyer-software-and-services.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which option represents a customer responsibility when using Amazon DynamoDB under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model?

options.text: Encryption of data at rest in DynamoDB

questions.explanation:
For abstracted services such as Amazon DynamoDB, AWS operates the underlying infrastructure, operating system, and platform. Customers are responsible for managing their data and applying appropriate IAM permissions, including controlling access to DynamoDB tables.\
\
**Learn more:** [Shared responsibility - AWS Well-Architected Framework Security Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html) · [Security and compliance in Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/security.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which of the following is a fully managed database compatible with MySQL?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Aurora provides a fully managed relational database engine that is compatible with MySQL. AWS manages routine operational tasks such as provisioning, patching, backups, recovery, failure detection, and repair.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Aurora?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service provides machine learning capability to detect and analyze content in images and videos?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Rekognition uses machine learning to detect objects, people, text, scenes, and activities in images and videos, including face recognition and celebrity identification. Connect is a contact center service, Lightsail is a virtual private server, and Personalize delivers ML-based recommendations—only Rekognition analyzes visual content.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon Rekognition?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company wants to query its server logs to gain insight into its customers’ experiences.  
  
Which AWS service will store this data in the MOST cost-effective way?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 is scalable object storage suited to storing large volumes of log data for analytics. Its storage classes and lifecycle features support cost optimization as access patterns change, unlike database, file-system, and block-storage services designed for other workloads.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cost optimization - Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cost-optimization.html) · [What is Amazon S3?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature gives users the ability to connect VPCs and on-premises networks to a central hub?
questions.explanation:
AWS Transit Gateway acts as a central hub that simplifies network connectivity between multiple VPCs and on-premises networks. It eliminates the need for complex point-to-point peering by enabling transitive routing across thousands of networks in a hub-and-spoke topology.\
\
**Learn more:** [What Is AWS Transit Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must rapidly and securely transfer files over long distances between its client and an Amazon S3 bucket.  
  
Which S3 feature meets this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration provides fast, secure transfers over long geographic distances between a client and an S3 bucket. It uses globally distributed CloudFront edge locations to route data to S3 over an optimized network path.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configuring fast, secure file transfers using Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS service or resource can offer discounts on certain AWS service costs in return for a spending commitment?
questions.explanation:
Savings Plans provide discounted pricing for eligible AWS usage in exchange for a commitment to a consistent amount of usage or spend for a one- or three-year term.\
\
**Learn more:** [What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html) · [Compute Savings Plans and Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-ris.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, what is the customer **ALWAYS** responsible for managing?
questions.explanation:
AWS customers are always responsible for their own data as part of security **in** the cloud. Responsibilities for other controls can vary with the AWS service and configuration, while AWS manages the underlying cloud infrastructure. [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-risk-and-compliance/shared-responsibility-model.html)\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-risk-and-compliance/shared-responsibility-model.html) · [AWS Prescriptive Guidance: Distribute security ownership](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/vulnerability-management/distribute-ownership.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question: Which AWS resource can help a company reduce its costs in exchange for a usage commitment when using Amazon EC2 instances?
questions.explanation:
Compute Savings Plans offer discounted pricing on EC2 instances (typically 20-50% savings) in exchange for a one- or three-year usage commitment. This is the standard AWS mechanism for reducing compute costs through commitment. Auto Scaling adjusts capacity dynamically, On-Demand Instances are full-price hourly billing, and EC2 instance store is temporary attached storage with no cost reduction benefit.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Compute Savings Plans](https://aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/compute-pricing/) · [Savings Plans user guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service supports user sign-up functionality and authentication to mobile and web applications?
questions.explanation: Amazon Cognito provides user sign-up, sign-in, and access control functionality specifically for web and mobile applications, including support for social and enterprise identity providers. AWS Config, GuardDuty, and Systems Manager handle resource compliance tracking, threat detection, and operational management, not end-user application authentication. **Learn more:** [What Is Amazon Cognito?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/what-is-amazon-cognito.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company must connect its on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. It requires a dedicated, low-latency connection with consistent network performance.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network connection between an on-premises environment and AWS, supporting more consistent network performance and potentially lower latency than internet-based connectivity.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html) · [AWS Direct Connect](https://aws.amazon.com/directconnect/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which task is a customer responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Maintain the security of the AWS Cloud.
Patch the operating system of Amazon RDS instances.

questions.explanation:
Customers are responsible for security *in* the cloud, including configuring AWS-provided security-group firewalls and their network settings. AWS is responsible for security *of* the cloud, including the underlying infrastructure and physical and environmental controls; standard Amazon RDS includes AWS-managed operating-system patching.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-risk-and-compliance/shared-responsibility-model.html) · [What is Amazon RDS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to track tags, buckets, and prefixes for its Amazon S3 objects.  
  
Which S3 feature satisfies this requirement?
questions.explanation:
Amazon S3 Inventory reports provide a scheduled inventory of objects and their metadata. The reports identify the bucket and object key, can include object tags, and can be scoped to objects with a specified prefix.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cataloging and analyzing your data with S3 Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud benefit is demonstrated by an architecture that can withstand failures with minimal downtime?
questions.explanation:
High availability is the ability of a workload to remain available, or to recover quickly, when components fail. AWS guidance links workloads designed to withstand component failures and achieve low recovery times with high-availability requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework: Design your workload to withstand component failures](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/rel-11.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company runs its production workload in the AWS Cloud. The company needs to choose one of the AWS Support Plans.  
  
Which of the AWS Support Plans will meet these requirements at the LOWEST cost?
questions.explanation:
AWS Business Support is the minimum recommended plan for production workloads and also represents the lowest-cost option that meets this requirement. While Developer Support is cheaper overall, it is not recommended for production use. Business provides 1-hour response time for production system impairment and access to AWS Trusted Advisor best practice checks.\
\
**Learn more:** [Compare AWS Support plans](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/) · [AWS Support plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/aws-support-plans.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company runs its production workload in the AWS Cloud. The company needs to choose one of the AWS Support Plans.  
  
Which of the AWS Support Plans will meet these requirements at the LOWEST cost?

options.text: Patching the operating system on Amazon EC2 instances
Enforcing a strict password policy for IAM users
Patching the operating system on Amazon RDS instances
Configuring security groups and network ACLs

questions.explanation:
AWS secures the cloud infrastructure, including the virtualization layer. Amazon RDS is a managed service, so AWS manages and patches its underlying operating system. Customers remain responsible for EC2 guest operating-system patches, IAM password policies, and security-group and network ACL configuration.

**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework – Shared responsibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html) · [AWS Risk and Compliance – Shared Responsibility Model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-risk-and-compliance/shared-responsibility-model.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question: Which AWS service allows users to identify vulnerabilities on Amazon EC2 instances using predefined assessment templates?
questions.explanation:
Amazon Inspector assesses Amazon EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities and exposures. Amazon Inspector Classic used assessment templates to define and run those assessments.\
\
**Learn more:** [Amazon Inspector Classic assessment templates and assessment runs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/v1/userguide/inspector_assessments.html) · [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs a threat detection service that will continuously monitor its AWS accounts, workloads, and Amazon S3 buckets for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior.  
  
Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service that continuously monitors AWS accounts, workloads, and S3 buckets for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior. It analyzes VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail events, and S3 data events to identify threats. AWS Shield protects against DDoS attacks, AWS Firewall Manager manages firewall rules, and Amazon Inspector performs vulnerability assessments.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company will run a predictable compute workload on Amazon EC2 instances for the next 3 years. The workload is critical for the company. The company wants to optimize costs to run the workload.  
  
Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Savings Plans provide significant discounts over On-Demand pricing in exchange for a commitment to a consistent amount of usage over a 1- or 3-year term, which fits a predictable, business-critical workload that must run reliably. Spot Instances are unsuitable because the workload is critical and cannot tolerate interruption, and Dedicated Hosts address licensing/compliance needs rather than cost optimization.\
**Learn more:** [Savings Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-what-is.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 4: Billing, Pricing, and Support
questions.question:
A company plans to migrate its on-premises workloads to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to separate workloads for chargeback across different departments.  
  
Which AWS services or features meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
Multiple AWS accounts isolate each department’s workloads and costs. Consolidated billing centralizes payment across those accounts while retaining account-level billing information that can be used for departmental chargeback.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS consolidated billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html) · [AWS Organizations concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 1: Cloud Concepts
questions.question: Which architecture design principle describes the need to isolate failures among dependent components in the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Design for single points of failure.

questions.explanation:
Loosely coupled components reduce dependency between services, so a failure in one component is isolated rather than propagating to components that depend on it. This improves resiliency.\
\
**Learn more:** [REL04-BP02 Implement loosely coupled dependencies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/rel_prevent_interaction_failure_loosely_coupled_system.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question: Which AWS service can a cloud practitioner use to retrieve AWS security and compliance documents and submit them as evidence to an auditor or regulator?
questions.explanation:
AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS security and compliance documents, such as ISO certifications and SOC reports. These documents can be submitted to auditors or regulators as audit artifacts.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is AWS Artifact?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/what-is-aws-artifact.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 2: Security and Compliance
questions.question:
A company has deployed an Amazon EC2 instance.  
  
Which option is AWS responsible for under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Installing updates and security patches of guest operating system
Configuration of security groups on each instance

questions.explanation:
AWS is responsible for security of the cloud, including maintaining the configuration of the underlying infrastructure devices. For Amazon EC2, the customer manages and patches the guest operating system, configures security groups, and manages application data and its encryption.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Framework: Shared responsibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/security-pillar/shared-responsibility.html)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company has deployed an Amazon EC2 instance.  
  
Which option is AWS responsible for under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Use EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions.
Use EC2 instances in multiple edge locations.
Use EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone but in different AWS Regions.
Use Amazon CloudFront with the EC2 instances configured as the source.

questions.explanation:
Running EC2 instances across multiple AWS Regions provides geographic redundancy so the application stays available even if an entire Region is affected by a natural disaster, since Regions are physically isolated from one another. Availability Zones within a single Region (or edge locations, which serve cached content rather than run EC2 instances) do not protect against a Region-wide disaster.
**Learn more:** [AWS Global Infrastructure](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/)

questions.domain: Content Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services
questions.question:
A company needs to create and publish interactive business intelligence dashboards. The dashboards require insights that are powered by machine learning.  
  
Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation:
Amazon QuickSight is AWS's serverless business intelligence service purpose-built for creating interactive dashboards with built-in machine learning capabilities. AWS Glue Studio is for data integration and ETL, Redshift is a data warehouse, and Athena is a query service—none are designed for interactive dashboards with ML-driven insights.\
\
**Learn more:** [ML Insights in Amazon QuickSight](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/user/making-data-driven-decisions-with-ml-in-quicksight.html)
